AI.result: 实验表明，自我编写技能的影响是混合的。nanobot模型在某些情况下性能提升，但DeepSeek-V4-Pro等模型在使用技能后性能反而大幅下降；OpenClaw表现同样不稳定，存在性能崩溃现象。
AI.conclusion: 从自身运行中学习可重用技能并不是自动获益的，其效果高度依赖于模型、运行环境及任务类型，具有选择性和成本敏感性。
AI.translation: 现有的智能体基准测试主要侧重于测试任务完成情况、工具使用或技能效用，但未能分离出智能体运行环境是否能将自身运行过程中的证据转化为可重用的技能，从而在克服编写开销后改善新的执行效果。我们引入了EvoClawBench，这是一个针对重复、基于固件任务的闭环技能学习问题的基准测试。EvoClawBench对比了直接执行（无技能）、执行前编写技能（PreSkill）以及基于首次运行证据进行总结后再次执行（PostSkill）这几种模式。该套件包含100个任务和502个子问题，涵盖编码、数据、办公、安全、运维和领域文档工作流，并支持多种智能体运行环境。在本地执行下对OpenClaw和nanobot进行的实验表明，直接执行的基线性能强烈依赖于运行环境：OpenClaw在所有模型中均低于20%，而nanobot的成功率在56.45%到96.13%之间。自编写技能的影响不尽相同。nanobot GPT-5.4在所有模式下均保持在96%以上，MiniMax-M2.7在PostSkill模式下从90.97%提升至94.50%，但nanobot DeepSeek-V4-Pro在使用PreSkill时从77.77%降至4.80%，使用PostSkill时降至0.99%。OpenClaw表现出类似的非单调行为，部分技能运行接近基线，而另一些则出现性能崩溃。这些结果表明，从智能体自身运行中学习可重用技能具有选择性和成本敏感性，而不是在智能体循环中添加技能编写功能的自动获益点。
AI.summary: EvoClawBench是一个旨在评估智能体能否从自身运行经验中提取并复用技能的闭环基准测试。研究发现，通过自我总结或预设技能并不总是能带来性能提升，不同模型在不同运行环境下的表现差异巨大，有时甚至会导致性能急剧下降。
AI.keywords: 智能体基准测试, 自我学习技能, 闭环学习, 任务执行, 技能复用
AI.comments: 该研究通过一个创新的基准测试，揭示了智能体“自我学习”技能的复杂性。其重要性在于打破了“增加技能学习机制必然提升性能”的迷思，强调了技能学习在不同模型和运行环境下的不稳定性。局限性在于当前实验结果表现出高度的非单调性，未来需要进一步研究哪些因素决定了技能学习的成败。

title: ERP Data Provisioning Financial Control Testing
summary: Financial control testing increasingly depends on representative enterprise resource planning (ERP) data in quality environments, yet direct production copies expose personal, supplier, banking, and commercially sensitive records. This work presents Secure ERP Quality Provisioning for Financial Control Testing (SEQ-FCT), a governed data-provisioning framework that combines deterministic masking, synthetic scenario expansion, referential tokenization, policy-based release approval, and automated validation for reconciliation, fraud-rule testing, and audit analytics. A single synthetic dataset is used for evaluation. It contains 186,000 finance-process records from six subsidiaries over 2022-2025, including accounts payable invoices, payments, general-ledger journals, accounts receivable receipts, and bank-statement lines. The dataset includes entity relationships, monetary values, approval paths, tax attributes, banking markers, exception labels, fraud-rule triggers, and control-failure outcomes. Because the dataset is synthetic, reported results demonstrate controlled internal consistency rather than production validation. Against a production-clone upper bound, static masking, rules-only synthesis, conditional tabular generative synthesis, and a hybrid baseline, SEQ-FCT achieved 0.932 reconciliation F1, 0.887 fraud-trigger recall, 0.914 control-failure F1, and an estimated leakage-risk score of 0.018. The analysis indicates that financial process behavior can be preserved more reliably when masking, synthetic data, and governance checks are evaluated as a single release pipeline instead of independent utilities.

title: Closed-Loop Control with Rule-Aligned Small Language Models and Multi-Agent Self-Correction
summary: A key step toward autonomous industrial operation is the ability to create and reconfigure control policies from natural-language requirement specifications, with minimal or no manual redesign. In this setting, policy generation by AI agents can be a credible path when paired with a plant-aware validator (e.g., a digital twin) that can check generated candidate actions before execution. However, practical deployment is constrained by inference latency and compute footprint: large cloud-based models are often too slow, opaque, or data-sensitive for edge closed-loop use. This work investigates whether a compact Small Language Model (SLM) can be retrained for control reasoning and embedded in a validator-guided correction loop. We use a Qwen2.5-1.5B model aligned via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), combined with (i) an action agent, (ii) a symbolic/digital-twin-style validation layer, and (iii) a reprompting agent that iteratively steers outputs toward valid actions. In randomized thermal-control simulations (30 experiments with 500 steps each), the framework achieves 91.5% average action-alignment accuracy (86.3%--100% across cases) at 3.84\,s mean inference latency. Under symbolic re-mapping, it maintains a 95% in-range rate, indicating robust physical regulation despite reduced token-level agreement. These results support SLM+validator architectures as a practical path toward reconfigurable autonomous control at the edge.

AI.title_translation: 基于规则对齐小型语言模型与多智能体自我修正的闭环控制
AI.tldr: 通过使用小型语言模型配合多智能体修正与数字孪生验证，实现了工业边缘侧的高效、低延迟自主闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决大模型在工业边缘闭环控制中存在的推理延迟高、计算开销大及数据敏感等问题，实现从自然语言需求到控制策略的自主生成与重构。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-1.5B模型，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行对齐，并构建包含动作智能体、符号/数字孪生验证层以及迭代重提示智能体的闭环控制框架。
AI.result: 在热控制模拟实验中，该框架实现了91.5%的动作对齐准确率，平均推理延迟仅为3.84秒，并在符号重映射下保持了95%的范围内调节率。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，结合验证器引导的SLM架构能够在保持高控制精度的同时，实现轻量化、低延迟的工业自主闭环控制。
AI.translation: 迈向自主工业操作的一个关键步骤是能够根据自然语言需求规范创建和重构控制策略，且几乎无需人工重新设计。在这种设置下，当AI智能体生成的策略与能够检查候选动作的验证器（如数字孪生）配对时，是一种可信的路径。然而，实际部署受到推理延迟和计算开销的限制：大型云端模型通常太慢、不透明或对边缘闭环使用而言数据敏感。这项工作研究了小型语言模型（SLM）是否可以通过重新训练进行控制推理，并嵌入到验证器引导的修正循环中。我们使用了通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）对齐的Qwen2.5-1.5B模型，结合（i）动作智能体，（ii）符号/数字孪生风格的验证层，以及（iii）将输出迭代引导至有效动作的重提示智能体。在随机热控制模拟（30次实验，每次500步）中，该框架在3.84秒的平均推理延迟下实现了91.5%的平均动作对齐准确率（各案例在86.3%至100%之间）。在符号重映射下，它保持了95%的范围内调节率，表明尽管标记级一致性降低，但仍具有稳健的物理调节能力。这些结果支持SLM+验证器架构作为实现边缘可重构自主控制的实用路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于小型语言模型（SLM）的工业控制框架，通过结合多智能体自我修正与数字孪生验证机制，实现了低延迟、高可靠的自主闭环控制，为工业边缘环境下的策略重构提供了高效解决方案。
AI.keywords: 小型语言模型, 工业自主控制, 多智能体自修正, 闭环控制, 边缘计算
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将小型语言模型（SLM）与多智能体自我修正机制及数字孪生验证层结合，成功解决了大模型在工业边缘侧部署的延迟与计算资源限制问题，为工业自动化控制提供了一条轻量化且高可靠的路径。

title: Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems in Continuous Time
comments: 19 pages, 4 figures. Extends arXiv:2603.11560 to continuous time. Code: github.com/stevefatz95/fcms-continuous
summary: The Feedback-Coupled Memory Systems (FCMS) architecture formalizes closed-loop coordination through four abstract operators, two of which - the agent update operator $f_i$ and the environmental update operator $Ψ$ - are left axiomatically undefined in the original framework. To address this, $f_i$ is defined by Mechanism-Based Intelligence (MBI), where agents update locally through a decentralized price mechanism and economic principles, and $Ψ$ is defined by the Coupled Memory Graph Process (CMGP), a non-Markovian framework where the environment is treated as a physical substrate that records and responds to trajectory history coherently without external forcing. The resulting continuous-time FCMS instantiation achieves Lyapunov global dissipativity governed by the computable threshold $4β^2 < 2ημγ^2$. This generalizes both the discrete FCMS stability condition $4ηβ^2 < γ$ and CMGP's physical bifurcation threshold $α_c = 1/K$, confirming that memory dissipation must outpace feedback gain as a universal organizing principle. Numerical simulation with $N=2$ agents and mean-field validation at $N=10^6$ confirm the stability threshold and the self-reinforcing coordination cascade that emerges when it is violated.
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures. Extends arXiv:2603.11560 to continuous time. Code: github.com/stevefatz95/fcms-continuous

AI.title_translation: 连续时间下的反馈耦合记忆系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了连续时间反馈耦合记忆系统模型，证明了记忆耗散超过反馈增益是系统实现全局稳定性的核心条件。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决原始FCMS架构中智能体更新算子（f_i）和环境更新算子（Ψ）定义模糊的问题，并探索连续时间下复杂系统的稳定性机制。
AI.method: 利用机制性智能（MBI）定义智能体更新算子，采用耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）定义环境更新算子，构建连续时间FCMS架构，并通过李雅普诺夫分析导出系统稳定性阈值。
AI.result: 证明了连续时间FCMS满足由不等式 4β^2 < 2ημγ^2 定义的李雅普诺夫全局耗散性，并验证了当违反该阈值时会产生自增强的协调级联现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究得出结论，记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益是复杂系统实现全局稳定性的普适组织原则，并给出了明确的连续时间稳定性阈值。
AI.translation: 反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）架构通过四个抽象算子实现了闭环协调，其中智能体更新算子 $f_i$ 和环境更新算子 $Ψ$ 在原始框架中未作定义。为了解决这一问题，本文通过机制性智能（MBI）定义了 $f_i$，即智能体通过去中心化的价格机制和经济原则进行局部更新；并通过耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）定义了 $Ψ$，这是一种非马尔可夫框架，环境被视为一种物理基质，能够记录并连贯地响应轨迹历史而无需外部强制。由此产生的连续时间FCMS实例化实现了由可计算阈值 $4β^2 < 2ημγ^2$ 控制的李雅普诺夫全局耗散性。该结果推广了离散FCMS稳定性条件 $4ηβ^2 < γ$ 和CMGP的物理分叉阈值 $α_c = 1/K$，证实了记忆耗散必须超过反馈增益是普遍的组织原则。通过 N=2 个智能体的数值模拟和 N=10^6 的均场验证，确认了该稳定性阈值以及在违反该阈值时出现的自增强协调级联现象。
AI.summary: 本文通过引入机制性智能和耦合记忆图过程，为反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）提供了具体的连续时间数学定义。研究推导出了一个普适的稳定性阈值，指出记忆耗散速度必须快于反馈增益，并通过数值模拟和均场理论验证了该结论。
AI.keywords: 反馈耦合记忆系统, 机制性智能, 耦合记忆图过程, 全局耗散性, 稳定性阈值
AI.comments: 该论文通过将机制性智能（MBI）与耦合记忆图过程（CMGP）相结合，为反馈耦合记忆系统（FCMS）提供了具体的数学实现。其创新点在于将抽象的闭环系统转化为具有物理意义的连续时间动力学模型，并推导出了一个普适的稳定性判据。该研究在理论上连接了经济学机制与物理系统动力学，对于理解复杂系统中的记忆耗散与反馈增益之间的权衡具有重要意义。

title: How to program a never-losing chess engine
summary:
This article proposes a model, based on graph theory, to represent a variety of two-player games of perfect information, such as chess and checkers. I then provide a backtracking minimax algorithm to find, if it exists, a perfect game strategy (game resolution), and subsequently a variant of that algorithm which is required to determine a weaker condition: the existence of a strategy to never lose (always reach at least a draw).
  Of course, this does not mean that in practice the algorithm can find such a strategy in a short time, but here we are only concerned with formally proving that this is possible, at least theoretically.

AI.title_translation: 如何编写一个永不输棋的国际象棋引擎
AI.tldr: 本文从理论上证明了利用图论模型和回溯极小极大算法，可以找到确保在完美信息博弈中永不输棋的策略。
AI.motivation: 旨在从理论上形式化证明在完美信息博弈（如国际象棋、跳棋）中，寻找“永不输棋”策略的可能性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于图论的博弈表示模型，并设计了回溯极小极大算法（backtracking minimax algorithm）及其变体，用于寻找完美策略或确保不输的策略。
AI.result: 证明了在理论层面，可以通过回溯极小极大算法的变体来确定是否存在一种确保玩家至少达成平局的策略。
AI.conclusion: 作者从理论上证明了在完美信息博弈中，存在一种能够确保“永不输棋”（至少平局）的策略，并通过算法形式化了这一过程。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种基于图论的模型，用于表示国际象棋和跳棋等各种完美信息双人博弈。我随后提供了一种回溯极小极大算法来寻找完美博弈策略（如果存在），并提供了一种该算法的变体，用于确定一个较弱的条件：永不输棋（始终至少达到平局）的策略存在性。当然，这并不意味着该算法在实践中可以在短时间内找到这样的策略，但我们这里仅关注从理论上证明其可能性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于图论的完美信息博弈模型，并利用回溯极小极大算法及其变体，从理论上证明了在国际象棋等游戏中寻找“永不输棋”策略的可行性。
AI.keywords: 图论, 完美信息博弈, 极小极大算法, 游戏求解, 策略分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用图论模型形式化地定义了完美信息博弈，并从理论上证明了“永不输棋”策略的存在性。局限性在于算法的时间复杂度极高，仅具有理论意义，无法在实际应用中解决复杂博弈。

title: RoboNav-Arm: Agentic AI-Driven Navigation and Obstacle Avoidance for Robotic Manipulator in Cluttered Environments
summary: Robotic manipulators operating in unstructured environments face significant challenges in safely executing goal-directed tasks due to dynamic and unforeseen obstacles, while traditional methods rely on prior knowledge or fixed perception pipelines, limiting adaptability. We propose a framework for safe task execution with effective obstacle avoidance. The environment module performs real-time obstacle detection, 3D localization, and ground surface geometry estimation. It then generates a structured semantic report that includes obstacle positions, object geometry and shape, and whether obstacles lie inside, outside, or within critical interaction zones. A central coordination module manages the overall system by handling tool invocation (e.g., memory and MoveIt collision scene updates), facilitating communication between modules, and continuously monitoring task progress until completion. Furthermore, a planning module selects an appropriate motion planning algorithm, such as RRTConnect, RRT*, or BiTRRT, based on the current environment configuration and goal requirements. The trajectory generated by the planner is further analyzed and refined to ensure safe and collision-free task execution. The proposed approach is evaluated in Gazebo Classic , demonstrating robustness in dynamic scenarios.

AI.title_translation: RoboNav-Arm：面向杂乱环境中机器人操作臂的代理AI驱动导航与避障研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种集成实时语义感知、任务协调与动态规划的机器人操作框架，显著提升了机械臂在复杂动态环境中的避障与任务执行安全性。
AI.motivation: 传统机器人操作方法过于依赖先验知识或固定的感知流程，难以应对非结构化环境中的动态及不可预见障碍物，导致任务执行的安全性受限。
AI.method: 提出一个由环境感知模块（负责实时检测、定位与几何估计）、中央协调模块（管理工具调用与系统通信）和规划模块（根据环境选择RRTConnect/RRT*/BiTRRT等算法）组成的智能框架。
AI.result: 在Gazebo Classic仿真实验中，该框架在多种动态场景下展现了出色的避障效果和任务执行鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了所提出的RoboNav-Arm框架在处理动态、复杂环境下的机器人导航与避障任务中具有高度的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.translation: 在非结构化环境中运行的机器人操作臂，由于存在动态和不可预见的障碍物，在安全执行目标导向任务时面临巨大挑战，而传统方法往往依赖先验知识或固定的感知流程，限制了其适应性。我们提出了一个用于安全任务执行和有效避障的框架。环境模块执行实时障碍物检测、3D定位和地面几何估计，随后生成包含障碍物位置、物体几何形状以及其是否位于关键交互区域内的结构化语义报告。中央协调模块通过处理工具调用（如内存更新和MoveIt碰撞场景更新）、促进模块间通信并持续监控任务进度来管理整个系统。此外，规划模块根据当前环境配置和目标要求选择合适的运动规划算法（如RRTConnect、RRT*或BiTRRT）。生成的轨迹经过进一步分析和细化，以确保任务执行的安全且无碰撞。所提方法在Gazebo Classic中进行了评估，证明了其在动态场景下的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RoboNav-Arm的代理AI驱动框架，旨在提升机器人操作臂在杂乱环境下的导航与避障能力。该系统通过实时环境语义报告、中央任务协调以及动态路径规划算法的选择，实现了对复杂环境的有效感知与安全轨迹生成。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作臂, 代理AI, 路径规划, 避障, 动态环境
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地引入了“代理AI（Agentic AI）”架构来处理机器人操作任务，通过语义报告和动态规划模块提升了系统对非结构化环境的适应能力。其局限性在于主要在Gazebo仿真环境中进行验证，未提及在真实硬件平台上的实时性能表现。

title: Learning High-Level Decision Making with an Interaction-Aware Attention-Based Network in Autonomous Driving
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, submitted to 2026 IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC)
summary: Reliable learning-based high-level decision making for lane changes and speed control in automated driving must accommodate dynamically sized inputs due to varying scene traffic flow. DeepSet and its variants represent the state of the art among shared-encoder approaches; however, they neglect explicit traffic interaction modeling, limiting performance in negotiation-intensive scenarios such as intersections. Attention-based methods capture interactions among static and dynamic agents, but incur quadratic memory and computational complexity and provide limited control over representation granularity. Inspired by Perceiver IO, an attention-based architecture, DecisionPerceiver, is proposed to project dynamic agent features into a fixed-size latent space, where feature granularity is regulated by the number of latent queries, improving scalability for larger networks. A finer discretization of the action set is further proposed to increase the performance gain due to interaction awareness. Extensive evaluations across three driving scenarios that require different levels of interaction awareness demonstrate consistent performance gains and generalization across various navigation objectives. In addition, the proposed architecture is assessed in scenarios with an increasing number of vehicles to demonstrate scalability.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, submitted to 2026 IEEE Intelligent Transportation Systems Conference (ITSC)

title: AGM-like Paraconsistent Partial Meet Abductive Expansion Operation
summary: In his 1996 doctoral thesis, Maurice Pagnucco created the first AGM-like abductive expansion operation. Taking his operation as a basis, as well as a taxonomy -- inspired by Atocha Aliseda -- responsible for highlighting and formalizing the main components of abductive reasoning, the main aim of this paper is to present a new paraconsistent AGM-like abductive expansion operation -- capable of assimilating contradictory explanatory hypotheses without trivialization and the consequent absurd epistemic state -- with its postulates and its transitively relational partial meet construction. To a large extent, the formal development presented in this paper was only made possible by the recent creation of the paraconsistent logic RCbr, an LFI (Logics of Formal Inconsistencies) that establishes properties especially relevant to belief revision contexts, in particular, the ability to be self-extensional -- i.e., to satisfy the replacement property. This is the first of two papers: the paraconsistent abductive expansion operation announced here -- which is part of a new system called AGMpabd -- despite bringing many interesting features, does not assign any relevant epistemic role to the paraconsistent operators of negation and consistency. Only in a second paper will an analogous paraconsistent abductive expansion operation -- which is part of another new system, AGMcircabd -- be enhanced in this direction. Nevertheless, to the best of my knowledge, the operation developed in this paper is the first of its kind in the AGM literature.

title: The Individual-Targeting Assumption: A Systematic Review of Proactive Robots in Human Group Settings
comments: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN)
summary: Proactive robots are increasingly deployed in public environments where people are encountered not as isolated individuals but as members of cohesive social groups. Yet whether the prevailing design paradigm in proactive human-robot interaction (HRI) accounts for the relational structure that defines a group as a social unit remains largely unexamined. Through a systematic review of 63 proactive HRI studies in group settings from 2000 to 2025, we identify a recurring tendency, the Individual-Targeting Assumption (ITA), in which robots treat co-present people as independent engagement targets. We find that ITA is present in 60.3% of the corpus, with group-aware approaches emerging almost entirely after the robot is already embedded in an ongoing interaction. Critically, how a robot should detect and negotiate entry into a pre-formed group before initiating contact remains unaddressed across the corpus. Three failure modes, engagement misdetection, social ratification blindness, and bystander neglect, emerge as recurring patterns when proactive robots interact with human groups. These findings reframe proactive HRI in group settings not as an extension of dyadic interaction but as a qualitatively distinct design problem, and they identify the robot's approach to the group during the entry phase as a critical and understudied open challenge.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN)

AI.title_translation: 个体化假设：主动式机器人在人类群体环境中的系统综述
AI.tldr: 当前主动式机器人往往错误地将群体成员视为独立个体，而非将其视为一个社会整体，导致了常见的交互失败，特别是在机器人尝试加入人类群体时。
AI.motivation: 探讨当前主动式机器人设计范式是否充分考虑了人类群体的社会关系结构，指出当前研究普遍存在的将群体成员视为独立个体的偏差。
AI.method: 通过系统综述方法，对2000年至2025年间63项关于群体场景下的主动式人机交互研究进行了深入分析和归纳。
AI.result: 60.3%的研究存在“个体化假设”倾向；识别出三种常见的失败模式：交互检测错误、社会许可盲区以及旁观者忽视；发现机器人进入群体的交互机制在现有文献中几乎未被触及。
AI.conclusion: 主动式机器人与人类群体交互并非简单的双人交互扩展，而是一个本质上不同的设计问题；当前研究严重忽视了机器人进入群体时的社会化过程，需从个体转向群体感知与交互设计。
AI.translation: 主动式机器人越来越多地被部署在公共环境中，在这些环境中，人们不是作为孤立的个体，而是作为有凝聚力的社会群体的成员出现。然而，主动式人机交互（HRI）中流行的设计范式是否考虑了定义群体作为社会单位的关系结构，在很大程度上仍未得到审查。通过对2000年至2025年群体环境下的63项主动式HRI研究进行系统综述，我们确定了一种反复出现的倾向，即“个体化假设”（ITA），在这种倾向中，机器人将同时在场的人视为独立的交互目标。我们发现ITA存在于60.3%的语料库中，而群体感知方法几乎完全是在机器人已经嵌入正在进行的交互之后才出现的。至关重要的是，在发起接触之前，机器人应如何检测并协商进入预先形成的群体，在整个语料库中仍未得到解决。当主动式机器人与人类群体互动时，交互误检测、社会许可盲区和旁观者忽视这三种失败模式作为反复出现的模式出现。这些发现将群体环境中的主动式HRI重新定义为不是双人交互的扩展，而是一个质量上不同的设计问题，并确定了机器人在进入阶段接近群体的方式是一个关键且未被充分研究的开放挑战。
AI.summary: 本文对2000年至2025年间的63项研究进行了系统综述，发现多数主动式机器人将群体成员视为独立个体而非社会单元（即“个体化假设”）。研究指出，这种设计模式导致了多种交互失败，并强调了机器人进入群体时的交互策略是当前人机交互领域亟待解决的关键难题。
AI.keywords: 主动式机器人, 人机交互, 群体互动, 个体化假设, 社会化感知
AI.comments: 该论文通过系统综述揭示了主动式机器人领域一个被忽视的核心问题——“个体化假设（ITA）”，即机器人倾向于将群体成员视为孤立个体而非社会单位。该研究对于推动机器人从“双人交互”转向“社会化群体交互”具有重要的理论和设计指导意义，明确指出了入口阶段（entry phase）是未来研究的关键突破口。

title: Saturation-Aware Robust Trajectory Optimization for Reusable Launch Vehicles via Differentiable Physics
summary: The high-angle-of-attack flip maneuver of reusable launch vehicles presents significant challenges for robust trajectory optimization due to the combined effects of highly nonlinear dynamics, aerodynamic uncertainties, and actuator saturation. This paper presents a differentiable physics framework for saturation-aware robust trajectory optimization. At its core, a Differentiable Particle Tube Control (DPTC) scheme is developed to optimize uncertainty evolution through an ensemble-based distribution shaping strategy. State uncertainty is represented by a Lagrangian particle ensemble, while hard actuator projection operators are embedded directly into the computational graph, enabling the joint optimization of the nominal feedforward trajectory and a time-varying feedback policy via end-to-end backpropagation. The proposed framework is evaluated against an automatic differentiation-based Successive Convexification (AD-SCvx) baseline combined with a conventional covariance steering feedback strategy. Six-degree-of-freedom Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that, although the baseline achieves nominal fuel-optimal solutions, its unconstrained feedback formulation becomes susceptible to actuator saturation under aerodynamic disturbances, leading to degraded closed-loop robustness. In contrast, the proposed DPTC framework proactively performs a constraint-aware performance trade-off by relaxing spatial tracking to preserve critical control authority. These results demonstrate that integrating differentiable physics with ensemble-based optimization provides an effective and practical framework for robust guidance in highly constrained aerospace flight systems.

AI.title_translation: 基于可微物理的可重用运载火箭饱和感知鲁棒轨迹优化
AI.tldr: 通过将执行器饱和约束嵌入可微物理模型，实现运载火箭在不确定环境下的鲁棒轨迹与反馈策略联合优化。
AI.motivation: 可重用运载火箭在大攻角翻转机动时，面临高度非线性动力学、气动不确定性以及执行器饱和的挑战，传统方法在处理这些约束时往往表现出鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种可微粒子管控制（DPTC）方案。该方法利用拉格朗日粒子集成表示状态不确定性，将硬执行器投影算子直接嵌入计算图，并通过端到端反向传播联合优化标称前馈轨迹和时变反馈策略。
AI.result: 六自由度蒙特卡洛仿真显示，相比于传统的自动微分连续凸优化（AD-SCvx）基准方法，DPTC框架能够主动进行约束感知权衡，在保持关键控制权限的同时提升了闭环鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，将可微物理与基于集成的优化相结合，能够有效提升高约束航空航天飞行系统在面对执行器饱和与气动不确定性时的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 可重用运载火箭的大攻角翻转机动，由于高度非线性动力学、气动不确定性和执行器饱和的综合影响，对鲁棒轨迹优化提出了巨大挑战。本文提出了一种用于饱和感知鲁棒轨迹优化的可微物理框架。其核心是开发了一种可微粒子管控制（DPTC）方案，通过基于集成的分布整形策略来优化不确定性的演变。状态不确定性由拉格朗日粒子集成表示，而硬执行器投影算子直接嵌入到计算图中，从而通过端到端反向传播实现标称前馈轨迹和时变反馈策略的联合优化。所提出的框架与基于自动微分的连续凸优化（AD-SCvx）基准结合常规协方差转向反馈策略进行了对比评估。六自由度蒙特卡洛仿真表明，尽管基准方法实现了标称燃料最优解，但其无约束反馈公式在气动干扰下容易受到执行器饱和的影响，导致闭环鲁棒性下降。相比之下，所提出的DPTC框架通过放宽空间跟踪来主动进行约束感知的性能权衡，以保持关键的控制权限。这些结果表明，将可微物理与基于集成的优化相结合，为高约束航空航天飞行系统提供了有效且实用的鲁棒制导框架。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于可微物理的饱和感知鲁棒轨迹优化框架（DPTC）。通过将执行器饱和约束直接嵌入计算图，利用粒子集成进行分布整形，实现了标称轨迹与反馈策略的联合优化，有效提升了运载火箭在复杂环境下的飞行鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 可重用运载火箭, 轨迹优化, 可微物理, 执行器饱和, 鲁棒控制
AI.comments: 该论文通过将执行器饱和约束直接嵌入可微物理计算图，巧妙地解决了可重用运载火箭在复杂飞行状态下的鲁棒轨迹优化难题。其核心创新在于将分布整形策略与端到端反向传播结合，实现了标称轨迹与反馈策略的联合优化，为高约束航空航天系统的控制提供了新的思路。

title: Coresets Before Score Sets: Evaluation-Unsupervised Prompt Subset Selection for LLM Benchmarks
summary: We study LLM benchmark coreset selection: selecting a small subset of prompts over multiple benchmarks whose induced model scores and rankings approximate those obtained from the full benchmark suite. In evaluation-unsupervised benchmark coreset selection (our approach), the selection algorithm uses no model evaluation outcomes, and operates on a fine granularity by producing subsets of prompts over multiple benchmarks rather than producing a sub-collection of entire benchmarks. We use submodular subset selection, and we develop and evaluate many different submodular functions for this purpose, including determinantal point process (DPP) based approaches, submodular mutual information functions, and facility location-based functions. On a new large-scale suite of 35 heterogeneous benchmarks spanning five different capability categories, 18 frontier LLMs, and over 61K prompts, we find that the facility location (FL) function operating exclusively on inexpensive semantic prompt embeddings preserves LLM scores better than twelve separate score-based and diversity-based baselines, across a range of coreset budgets. Moreover, we show our proposed objective is not limited to the evaluation-unsupervised regime: in the setting where only a handful of whole benchmarks must be selected and a large amount of model scores are available, the same objective matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on the MMLU and MTEB leaderboards, while being substantially cheaper to compute. Together, our results suggest that submodularity, in general, is a strong and reliable tool for benchmark compression.

AI.title_translation: 评分集之前的核心集：面向大模型基准测试的评估无监督提示子集选择
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用次模优化技术，在不依赖模型评估结果的情况下，通过语义嵌入筛选少量代表性提示词，有效压缩大模型基准测试规模并保持高评估准确度。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM基准测试规模巨大且评估成本高昂，需要一种能够通过选择少量代表性提示词来近似完整基准测试表现的方法，以降低评估成本。
AI.method: 采用次模子集选择算法，通过评估多种次模函数（如DPP、次模互信息、设施位置函数），利用提示词的语义嵌入进行无监督选择，无需依赖模型评估结果。
AI.result: 在35个基准测试和18个模型上的实验表明，基于设施位置函数（FL）的无监督方法在保持评分准确性方面优于12个基准模型，且在有监督场景下同样能达到或超越现有最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 次模优化是进行基准测试压缩的一种强大且可靠的工具，通过简单的语义嵌入即可实现高效的提示集压缩，且该方法在有监督和无监督场景下均具有广泛适用性。
AI.translation: 我们研究了LLM基准测试核心集选择问题：即从多个基准测试中选择一小部分提示词子集，使其诱导的模型评分和排名近似于完整基准测试套件的结果。在评估无监督基准核心集选择（我们的方法）中，选择算法不使用任何模型评估结果，并以细粒度操作，通过在多个基准测试中生成提示词子集，而非选择整个基准测试集。我们使用了次模子集选择，并为此开发和评估了许多不同的次模函数，包括基于行列式点过程（DPP）的方法、次模互信息函数和基于设施位置的函数。在一个包含5个不同能力类别、18个前沿LLM和超过61K个提示词的35个异构基准测试新大规模套件上，我们发现仅基于廉价语义提示嵌入的设施位置（FL）函数，在不同核心集预算下，比十二个基于评分和基于多样性的基准线更好地保留了LLM评分。此外，我们证明了我们提出的目标函数不仅限于评估无监督机制：在仅需选择少数几个完整基准测试且有大量模型评分可用的设置中，该目标函数在MMLU和MTEB排行榜上匹配或超过了最先进的基准线，且计算成本大大降低。总之，我们的结果表明，次模性通常是基准测试压缩的一种强大且可靠的工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种大语言模型基准测试的无监督核心集（Coreset）选择方法。通过利用次模优化算法和提示词的语义嵌入，该方法能够在不使用模型评估结果的情况下，从海量提示词中筛选出最具代表性的子集，从而以低计算成本准确近似完整基准测试的评分与排名。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 基准测试压缩, 次模优化, 提示集选择, 语义嵌入
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入次模优化（Submodularity）来解决大模型基准测试压缩问题，提出了一种无需模型评估结果的无监督选择方法。其创新之处在于不仅实现了高效的基准测试精简，还通过实验证明了基于语义嵌入的设施位置函数（FL）在多种基准测试中的优越性，为高效评估LLM性能提供了有力工具。

title: A Dynamic Scene Interaction Reasoning Framework for Scene-level Lane-Change Intention and Trajectory Prediction of Multiple Interacting Vehicles
summary: Safe motion planning in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicles requires an accurate understanding of how the surrounding traffic scene is likely to evolve. However, many existing lane-change prediction methods remain centered on a single target vehicle, while multi-agent forecasting approaches often describe scene evolution only through future positions and provide limited explicit information about the maneuver associated with each vehicle. This study proposes a dynamic scene graph attention framework that predicts the lane-change intention and future trajectory of every relevant vehicle within a local traffic scene. The scene is represented as a time-varying interaction graph in which vehicles are modeled as nodes and their spatial and kinematic relationships are encoded through explicit edge features. Temporal graph-attention message passing captures evolving inter-vehicle dependencies and pre-maneuver cues, while an intention-guided decoder links each predicted maneuver to its corresponding future motion. A scene-level consistency objective further encourages compatible multi-vehicle futures. Experiments on the NGSIM I-80, NGSIM US-101, and highD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines. DSiGAT achieves intention prediction accuracies of 90.12% and 90.97% on NGSIM I-80 and US-101, respectively, and reduces trajectory RMSE by up to 52.94% relative to the strongest baseline. It also produces lower inter-agent collision rates and joint displacement errors, indicating more coherent scene-level predictions. Ablation, sensitivity, robustness, and qualitative analyses further validate the contribution of the proposed components and the effectiveness of the scene-focused formulation.

title: SWIFT: A Small-World Interaction Framework for Flow-Aware Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Driving
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: Accurate trajectory prediction in autonomous driving hinges on modeling dynamic and context-dependent interactions among traffic agents. However, most existing approaches are purely data-driven and lack structural priors, which limits their generalization under distribution shifts. In this work, interaction modeling is revisited through the structure and dynamics of traffic networks, and SWIFT (Small-World Interaction Framework for Trajectory prediction) is proposed as a unified framework that integrates small-world networks with traffic flow theory. SWIFT introduces structural inductive biases via a Small-World Interaction Network that captures both local and global dependencies, and a Flow Regime Encoder that adapts the interaction structure to scene-level traffic states. Interaction reasoning is further enhanced through a multi-relational graph module that explicitly encodes direct and higher-order agent relationships. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets, nuScenes, MoCAD, and NGSIM, show that SWIFT consistently outperforms strong baselines in prediction accuracy across diverse traffic regimes. Beyond accuracy, SWIFT exhibits improved generalization to unseen locations and regimes, robustness under noisy observations, and strong performance with limited training data, supporting the effectiveness of its structure-aware design.
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence

AI.title_translation: SWIFT：一种用于自主驾驶流感知轨迹预测的小世界交互框架
AI.tldr: SWIFT通过结合小世界网络结构和交通流理论，为轨迹预测引入结构先验，显著提升了模型在复杂交通场景下的预测精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的轨迹预测方法多为纯数据驱动，缺乏结构先验，导致其在分布偏移（distribution shifts）下的泛化能力受限，难以有效建模动态且上下文相关的交通代理间交互。
AI.method: 提出了SWIFT框架，包含：1.小世界交互网络（Small-World Interaction Network），通过捕捉局部与全局依赖引入结构归纳偏置；2.流态编码器（Flow Regime Encoder），用于根据场景交通状态调整交互结构；3.多关系图模块，用于显式编码直接与高阶代理关系。
AI.result: 在nuScenes、MoCAD和NGSIM三个真实数据集上的实验表明，SWIFT在预测准确性上优于现有强基线，且在面对未见过的场景、噪声观测以及有限训练数据时表现出更好的泛化性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT框架通过融合小世界网络结构与交通流动力学，有效提升了轨迹预测的准确性、泛化能力及鲁棒性，验证了结构感知设计在自主驾驶轨迹预测中的重要价值。
AI.translation: 自主驾驶中准确的轨迹预测依赖于对交通代理之间动态且与上下文相关的交互进行建模。然而，大多数现有方法纯粹是数据驱动的，缺乏结构先验，这限制了它们在分布偏移下的泛化能力。在这项工作中，我们通过交通网络的结构和动力学重新审视了交互建模，并提出了SWIFT（轨迹预测的小世界交互框架），这是一个将小世界网络与交通流理论相结合的统一框架。SWIFT通过一个小世界交互网络引入结构归纳偏置，该网络捕捉局部和全局依赖关系；此外，通过一个流态编码器将交互结构调整为场景级的交通状态。交互推理通过一个多关系图模块进一步增强，该模块显式编码直接和高阶代理关系。在nuScenes、MoCAD和NGSIM三个真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，SWIFT在不同交通制度下的预测准确性方面始终优于强基线。除了准确性之外，SWIFT在未见过的地点和制度下表现出改进的泛化能力、在噪声观测下的鲁棒性，以及在有限训练数据下的强大性能，支持了其结构感知设计的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SWIFT框架，旨在通过引入小世界网络和交通流理论作为结构先验，改进自主驾驶中的轨迹预测。该框架通过小世界交互网络和流态编码器，有效建模了代理间的局部与全局依赖，并增强了模型在不同交通状态下的自适应能力。实验证明，该方法在提升预测精度的同时，显著增强了模型的泛化能力与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 轨迹预测, 小世界网络, 交通流理论, 自主驾驶, 结构归纳偏置
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将交通流理论与小世界网络结构相结合，为轨迹预测引入了显式的结构归纳偏置。这种设计不仅提升了预测精度，还显著增强了模型在分布偏移下的泛化能力和鲁棒性，是解决纯数据驱动方法在复杂交通场景下局限性的一个重要尝试。

title: Chiplet3D: Pin- and Thermal-Aware 3D Chiplet Floorplanning via Convolution-Embedded MILP
summary: As traditional Moore's Law scaling slows down, 3D-ICs stack multiple active dies vertically to sustain performance scaling. However, this vertical stacking traps heat inside, making temperature a design concern. Although we can fix thermal issues at different design steps, floorplanning is the earliest and most cost-effective stage to solve it. Previous methods handle this by assuming wires connect to block centers and estimating temperature through simplistic power-based calculations, but these assumptions mislead their wirelength optimization and leave hotspots unresolved. To address these limitations, we present Chiplet3D, a pin- and thermal-aware floorplanner for two-die 3D-ICs. To achieve pin-awareness, it supports all four rotations and two flips, measuring wirelength from exact pin locations so the solver can flip or rotate blocks to pull connected pins closer. On the thermal side, Chiplet3D replaces the inaccurate power-based metrics of prior work with a fast, coarse convolution field embedded directly in a mixed-integer linear program (MILP) to accurately track the true 3D heat spread. We evaluate Chiplet3D on the ICCAD'24 ATPlace benchmarks, validating every temperature with a golden 3D-ICE simulation. Chiplet3D reduces wirelength by 39\%--43\% on average (and up to 62\% in the best case), while lowering peak temperatures by up to 45.9$^\circ$C and reducing thermal non-uniformity by up to 56\% compared to the SOTA baselines. Overall, these results demonstrate that by co-optimizing pin alignment and thermal fields, Chiplet3D establishes a stronger Pareto frontier between thermal-aware layout and interconnect efficiency.

AI.title_translation: Chiplet3D：基于卷积嵌入MILP的引脚与热感知3D芯片布局规划
AI.tldr: Chiplet3D通过改进引脚布局和嵌入式卷积热模型，在大幅缩短3D芯片布线长度的同时，显著改善了热管理性能。
AI.motivation: 传统3D IC布局方法在布线和热评估方面存在假设过于简化（如忽略引脚位置、热计算不准确）的问题，导致布线长度优化不足且难以有效解决热点问题。
AI.method: 提出Chiplet3D框架，通过引入引脚感知（支持旋转和翻转）以及将快速粗粒度卷积热场直接嵌入混合整数线性规划（MILP）模型中，实现热传导的精确建模与布局优化。
AI.result: 在ICCAD'24 ATPlace基准测试中，与现有最优（SOTA）基线相比，Chiplet3D平均降低了39%–43%的布线长度，最高降低了45.9°C的峰值温度，并将热不均匀性降低了56%。
AI.conclusion: Chiplet3D通过将热卷积场嵌入MILP布局优化，实现了引脚感知与热感知的协同设计，显著改善了3D IC的性能与热分布。
AI.translation: 随着传统摩尔定律缩放的放缓，3D集成电路通过垂直堆叠多个有源芯片来维持性能扩展。然而，这种垂直堆叠会将热量困在内部，使温度成为设计的核心关注点。尽管我们可以在不同的设计阶段解决热问题，但布局规划是解决这一问题最早且最具成本效益的阶段。以往的方法通过假设导线连接到模块中心，并使用简单的基于功耗的计算来估计温度，这些假设误导了其线长优化，且未能解决热点问题。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了Chiplet3D，这是一款针对双层3D集成电路的引脚和热感知布局规划器。为了实现引脚感知，它支持所有四种旋转和两种翻转，通过精确的引脚位置测量线长，使求解器可以通过翻转或旋转模块来拉近连接的引脚。在热方面，Chiplet3D用直接嵌入混合整数线性规划（MILP）的快速粗粒度卷积场取代了先前工作中不准确的基于功耗的指标，以准确追踪真实的3D热扩散。我们在ICCAD'24 ATPlace基准测试上评估了Chiplet3D，并使用黄金标准的3D-ICE仿真验证了每个温度结果。与当前最优（SOTA）基线相比，Chiplet3D平均减少了39%–43%的线长（最佳情况下高达62%），同时将峰值温度降低了高达45.9°C，并将热不均匀性降低了56%。总体而言，这些结果表明，通过协同优化引脚对齐和热场，Chiplet3D在热感知布局和互连效率之间建立了更优的帕累托前沿。
AI.summary: Chiplet3D是一种针对双层3D IC的布局规划工具，通过精确的引脚位置建模和嵌入式卷积热场计算，成功实现了在优化布线长度的同时有效解决3D堆叠芯片的热点和热分布不均问题。
AI.keywords: 3D IC, 芯片布局, 热感知, MILP, 芯片组设计
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将卷积运算嵌入MILP框架中，解决了传统3D芯片布局中热模型不准确的问题，并实现了引脚级精度优化。这对于后摩尔时代高性能3D IC设计具有重要的工程实用价值。

title: Scaffolding the Strategist: Architecture-Dependent Reasoning Interventions in Hotelling Spatial Markets
comments: 26 pages (11 main + 15 appendix), 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning
summary: We investigate whether structured reasoning interventions improve the strategic economic reasoning of large language models, and whether their effects depend on model architecture. Using Hotelling's linear city model as a diagnostic vehicle, we evaluate GPT-4.1-mini (a standard instruction-following model) and GPT-5-mini (a reasoning-optimized model) under five conditions - an unscaffolded baseline and four reasoning interventions - across eight questions spanning deductive and abductive reasoning, three prompt framings, and three repetitions per condition, yielding 720 individually judged responses. We find a statistically significant crossover interaction between scaffolding type and model architecture ($t(7) = 4.79$, $p = 0.002$, $d = 1.69$): commitment scaffolding improves the standard model ($+0.21$) while degrading the reasoning model ($-0.63$), and principled separation shows the opposite pattern ($-0.40$ vs. $+0.31$). Both crossovers are individually significant (commitment: $p = 0.040$; separation: $p = 0.002$) and hold across all eight questions with 7/8 directional consistency. Adversarial stress-testing harms both models, with $2.6\times$ greater degradation for the reasoning model ($-1.47$ vs. $-0.57$; $p = 0.038$), and the damage correlates negatively with baseline difficulty ($R^2 = 0.36$, $p = 0.014$). We further document a persistent declarative-procedural gap in which both models identify correct strategies at rates far exceeding their ability to execute them; separation fully closes this gap for the reasoning model while no intervention helps the standard model.
comment: 26 pages (11 main + 15 appendix), 6 figures, 4 tables. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on LLM Reasoning

AI.title_translation: 战略家的支架：霍特林空间市场中依赖于架构的推理干预研究
AI.tldr: 推理干预的效果取决于模型架构，针对一种模型有效的提示策略可能会损害另一种模型，且模型普遍存在知道策略却无法正确执行的问题。
AI.motivation: 探究结构化推理干预是否能改善大语言模型的战略经济推理能力，以及这种改善效果是否受模型底层架构的影响。
AI.method: 使用霍特林线性城市模型作为测试平台，对比了GPT-4.1-mini（标准模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）在五种不同推理干预条件下的表现，通过8个问题、3种框架和多次重复实验，共评估了720个响应。
AI.result: 研究发现，干预效果与模型架构存在显著的交叉互动：承诺支架（commitment scaffolding）提升了标准模型表现却损害了推理模型；而原则性分离（principled separation）则相反。此外，对抗性压力测试对两类模型均有负面影响，且推理模型受损更严重。同时观察到明显的“声明性-程序性”差距，推理模型可通过分离干预消除此差距，但标准模型无法通过任何干预解决。
AI.conclusion: 推理干预的效果高度依赖于模型架构，不存在单一的“最佳”提示策略；标准模型与推理优化模型在面对不同干预时呈现出显著的交叉效应。此外，模型普遍存在“声明性-程序性”差距，即知晓策略却难以正确执行。
AI.translation: 我们调查了结构化推理干预是否能提高大语言模型的战略经济推理能力，以及其效果是否取决于模型架构。以霍特林线性城市模型为诊断工具，我们评估了GPT-4.1-mini（标准指令遵循模型）和GPT-5-mini（推理优化模型）在五种条件（一个无支架基准和四个推理干预）下的表现，涵盖了八个涉及演绎和溯因推理的问题、三种提示框架以及每种条件下的三次重复，共产生了720个独立判断的响应。我们发现支架类型与模型架构之间存在统计学上显著的交叉相互作用（t(7) = 4.79, p = 0.002, d = 1.69）：承诺支架改善了标准模型（+0.21）但损害了推理模型（-0.63），而原则性分离则呈现出相反的模式（-0.40 vs. +0.31）。这两个交叉点均具有统计学显著性（承诺：p = 0.040；分离：p = 0.002），并且在所有八个问题中保持一致，其中7/8具有方向上的一致性。对抗性压力测试损害了两种模型，推理模型的退化程度高出2.6倍（-1.47 vs. -0.57；p = 0.038），且损害程度与基准难度呈负相关（R² = 0.36, p = 0.014）。我们进一步记录了一个持续存在的声明性-程序性差距，即两种模型识别正确策略的比例远高于其执行策略的能力；分离干预完全弥合了推理模型的这一差距，而没有任何干预能帮助标准模型。
AI.summary: 本文通过霍特林空间市场模型，评估了不同推理干预手段对标准型与推理优化型大模型战略推理能力的影响。研究发现，干预措施的效果取决于模型架构，存在显著的交叉效应，且模型普遍存在知行不一的“声明性-程序性”差距，提示针对性提示策略的重要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 战略推理, 霍特林模型, 提示工程, 模型架构
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了提示工程（Prompt Engineering）并非普适的，模型架构的差异决定了推理干预措施的效果。这一发现对于理解大模型如何进行战略推理以及如何针对特定模型架构优化提示具有重要的理论和实践意义。局限性在于仅基于霍特林空间市场模型，其结论在更复杂或不同领域的泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: A Theory of Least Autonomy in AI
summary:
Least privilege, the principle that an identity should hold only the permissions strictly required for its task, has been a foundational primitive of access control for decades. We argue that this principle is insufficient for agentic AI systems, which do not merely hold permissions but can combine, approve, and amplify them across workflows and system boundaries.
  We propose least autonomy as an appropriate generalization and develop a formal theory. First, we define a compositional blast radius d(a,b) that measures structural separation between actions in an enterprise hierarchy, combining an ultrametric tree with lattice-valued confidentiality, integrity, and control-context labels. Second, we define a directed agent influence graph G(theta). An arc from U to V requires a directed shared-resource write-to-read meeting or a conservative undirected agent-to-agent (A2A) communication meeting, and a meeting-conditioned influence potential at or above an externally selected policy threshold theta. A catalogue-radius profile supports calibration and audit of theta. Finally, we define a collusion predicate over graph reachability that detects authorization composition, decision manipulation, and cross-domain capability composition.

AI.tldr: 针对智能体AI系统，论文提出了“最小自主”原则，通过形式化建模智能体间的资源影响和协作关系，有效识别并限制潜在的授权滥用和共谋风险。
AI.motivation: 传统的“最小权限”原则无法满足具有自主性、能跨工作流组合和放大权限的智能体AI系统的安全需求，因此需要一种更高级的通用原则来约束AI的自主行为。
AI.method: 1. 定义组合式爆炸半径 d(a,b) 来衡量企业层次结构中操作的结构分离度；2. 构建有向智能体影响图 G(theta) 来模拟智能体间的资源交互和影响潜力；3. 设计共谋谓词以识别授权组合、决策操纵及跨域能力整合。
AI.result: 建立了“最小自主”的形式化理论，提供了一种通过目录半径配置文件来校准和审计策略阈值的机制，并能有效检测智能体系统中的授权组合及恶意共谋行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过形式化“最小自主”原则，构建了一套用于评估和限制智能体AI系统风险的理论框架，涵盖了结构分离、影响图建模及共谋检测，为保障复杂AI环境的安全性提供了系统性方法。
AI.translation: 最小权限原则（即身份应仅持有完成任务所需的最低权限）几十年来一直是访问控制的基础准则。我们认为，这一原则对于智能体AI系统而言是不够的，因为这些系统不仅仅是持有权限，还能跨工作流和系统边界组合、批准并放大这些权限。我们提出了“最小自主”作为一种适当的推广，并开发了一套形式化理论。首先，我们定义了一个组合式爆炸半径 d(a,b)，它衡量了企业层次结构中操作之间的结构分离，结合了超度量树与格值机密性、完整性和控制上下文标签。其次，我们定义了一个有向智能体影响图 G(theta)。从 U 到 V 的弧需要满足有向共享资源读写匹配或保守的无向智能体间（A2A）通信匹配，以及处于或高于外部选择策略阈值 theta 的会议条件影响潜力。目录半径配置文件支持对 theta 的校准和审计。最后，我们定义了一个基于图可达性的共谋谓词，用于检测授权组合、决策操纵和跨域能力组合。
AI.summary: 论文针对智能体AI系统的安全挑战，提出了“最小自主”原则作为“最小权限”的扩展。通过引入组合式爆炸半径、有向智能体影响图和共谋谓词，该理论量化了智能体间的相互作用，并为评估、审计和限制AI系统的潜在风险提供了形式化工具。
AI.keywords: 智能体AI, 最小自主, 访问控制, 影响图, 共谋检测
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具前瞻性的安全框架，将传统的“最小权限”原则升级为“最小自主”原则，以应对智能体AI系统带来的复杂威胁。其创新之处在于通过形式化方法量化了智能体之间的影响力和潜在的共谋风险。该研究为AI安全治理和智能体访问控制提供了重要的理论基础，但其实际部署的计算复杂度和对策略阈值（theta）的依赖可能是未来的挑战。

title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
summary: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). A key motivation behind SupplyNetPy's development is programmatic generation and simulation of complex models, enabling design-space exploration, what-if analysis, training data generation, and supply chain digital twins.

AI.title_translation: SupplyNetPy：用于任意供应链与库存网络高保真建模和仿真的开源 Python 库
AI.tldr: SupplyNetPy 是一个开源 Python 库，支持对复杂供应链网络进行高保真离散事件仿真及数字孪生构建。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决复杂供应链模型的程序化生成与仿真需求，以支持设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成及构建供应链数字孪生。
AI.method: 采用基于图论的建模方式，通过 Python 编写离散事件仿真引擎，支持继承式扩展，并结合验证流程与解析基准、商业工具及案例研究进行对比。
AI.result: 成功开发了功能完备的库，并通过与解析基准、商业软件及已发表案例的对比，验证了其在处理多级结构、随机需求及库存策略等复杂场景下的准确性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: SupplyNetPy 为供应链仿真提供了一个强大、灵活且开源的 Python 工具，能够有效支撑从理论研究到工业实践的多种应用场景。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了 SupplyNetPy，这是一个开源、文档齐全的 Python 库，用于对具有任意多级结构的供应链网络进行建模和离散事件仿真。它支持多种补货策略、易腐库存、节点中断以及随机需求和交付周期。所有组件均可通过继承进行扩展。用户将供应链描述为具有节点和链路属性的图，而该库负责处理仿真，并提供日志和广泛的节点及网络级性能报告。本文介绍了 SupplyNetPy 的动机、设计、关键功能和架构，以及详细的验证结果（针对分析基准、商业工具和已发表的案例研究）。SupplyNetPy 开发背后的一个关键动机是复杂模型的程序化生成和仿真，从而实现设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成和供应链数字孪生。
AI.summary: SupplyNetPy 是一个开源的 Python 库，专门用于构建和模拟具有任意多级结构的供应链及库存网络。它支持多种补货策略、易腐库存处理及节点中断模拟，并具备高度可扩展性，能够为供应链设计、分析及数字孪生应用提供高效的支持。
AI.keywords: 供应链建模, 离散事件仿真, Python库, 库存管理, 数字孪生
AI.comments: 该库通过面向对象设计提供高度可扩展性，对于需要进行复杂供应链仿真、数字孪生构建及大规模数据生成的科研人员和工程师具有重要价值，弥补了开源领域在灵活建模方面的空白。

title: Life as Plasmas: Autonomy and Interactivism in-materio
comments: To appear in the MIT Press Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Artificial Life (ALIFE 2026). Accepted as a Talk for the Special Session on 'Artificial Life as Experimental Philosophy'
summary: When is a material system a candidate for life at all? We argue that this question is prior to behavior, functional architecture, or computational capacity, and that at root it is one of physical admissibility. We develop a framework in which minimal autonomy, taken in the interactivist sense of normativity grounded in self-maintaining far-from-equilibrium organization, corresponds to a distinct non-equilibrium phase of matter, and we take complex plasmas, a physical and non-biological system, as its in-materio exemplar. We formalize a diagnostic phase-space whose criteria (sustained free-energy throughput, organizational closure, active information maintenance, and regulated noise sensitivity) constitute necessary conditions for life-attribution. We instantiate the diagnostics across contrasting systems and fix the boundaries of the phase space via Bénard convection as a driven baseline lacking closure, and a digital self-replicating soup that carries measured informational heredity while its physical closure remains a structural zero. We demonstrate that plasmas satisfy every admissibility condition for minimal physical autonomy while carrying none of the informational heredity that open-ended evolution requires, sharpening the distinction between physical admissibility and biological sufficiency, and bounding downstream questions of machine sentience.
comment: To appear in the MIT Press Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Artificial Life (ALIFE 2026). Accepted as a Talk for the Special Session on 'Artificial Life as Experimental Philosophy'

AI.title_translation: 作为等离子体的生命：物质层面上的自主性与交互主义
AI.tldr: 本文通过物理学框架论证了复杂等离子体具备生命的“物理自主性”，但因缺乏遗传机制，仍不足以构成生物学意义上的生命。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决“什么样的物质系统有资格被称为生命”这一基础问题，主张生命属性应先于行为、功能架构或计算能力，其根源在于物理上的可采纳性。
AI.method: 建立了一套基于非平衡态物理的诊断相空间框架，包含持续自由能吞吐、组织封闭性、主动信息维护和受控噪声敏感性四个标准，并对比了贝纳德对流和数字自复制系统进行验证。
AI.result: 研究发现复杂等离子体满足所有最小物理自主性的诊断条件，但缺乏信息遗传性；通过与贝纳德对流和数字系统的对比，明确了物理可采纳性与生物充分性之间的界限。
AI.conclusion: 复杂等离子体满足最小物理自主性的所有必要条件，但缺乏开放式进化所需的遗传信息。这表明物理上的自主性（可采纳性）是生命的必要条件，但并非充分条件。
AI.translation: 什么样的情况下，一个物质系统才具备成为生命的资格？我们认为这个问题先于行为、功能架构或计算能力，其根源在于物理上的可采纳性。我们开发了一个框架，其中最小自主性（以交互主义意义上，即基于自我维持的远离平衡态组织的规范性）对应于物质的一种独特的非平衡相，并以复杂等离子体（一种物理的、非生物的系统）作为其物质层面的范例。我们形式化了一个诊断相空间，其标准（持续的自由能吞吐、组织封闭性、主动信息维护和受控的噪声敏感性）构成了生命归因的必要条件。我们通过对比系统实例化了这些诊断标准，并通过作为缺乏封闭性的驱动基准的贝纳德对流，以及物理封闭性为零但携带信息遗传的数字自复制汤，确定了相空间的边界。我们证明了等离子体满足最小物理自主性的所有可采纳性条件，同时不具备开放式进化所需的任何信息遗传性，从而强化了物理可采纳性与生物充分性之间的区别，并为后续有关机器感知的问题划定了界限。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于非平衡态物理的生命定义框架，将最小自主性视为一种特定的物质相。通过对复杂等离子体的分析，作者定义了生命可采纳性的诊断标准，并指出物理上的自主性虽是生命的必要条件，但不足以等同于生物学意义上的生命。
AI.keywords: 生命定义, 复杂等离子体, 物理自主性, 交互主义, 非平衡态组织
AI.comments: 该研究通过物理视角重新审视了生命的定义，将生命属性从生物学范畴提升至物理学相变范畴。其创新之处在于利用复杂等离子体作为非生物系统，量化了生命物理可采纳性的边界，为区分“物理上的自主性”与“生物学上的充分性”提供了严谨的框架，对理解生命起源及机器意识具有重要启示。

title: Replicating Belief, Not Bits: Epistemic State Replication for Agentic Systems
summary:
In distributed systems, the classical State Machine Replication (SMR) model assumes that correct replicas execute deterministic transitions to yield identical bitwise states. However, the rise of agentic distributed systems -- where autonomous, stochastic, and model-driven agents orchestrate infrastructure -- presents scenarios where deterministic, bitwise replication is insufficient. Replicas operating with generative models may exhibit divergent reasoning paths, summaries, and token boundaries, yet reach semantically equivalent and correct operational decisions. Forcing bitwise agreement across these stochastic participants degrades execution flexibility, induces context amnesia, and limits performance.
  We argue that in such settings replicas should agree on belief, not bits. We propose Epistemic State Replication (ESR), a belief-replication layer for agentic distributed systems that shifts the replication boundary from data visibility to knowledge visibility. We formalize the epistemic node state as a pair K = (L, B) separating the deterministic, immutable evidence log (L) from the stochastic, evolving belief lineage (B). To govern execution safety, we define Semantic Linearizability, which requires operations to reflect the latest committed operational meaning within a verifier-bounded semantic compatibility metric, and Bounded Eventual Coherence, which bounds expected semantic divergence under fair delivery, monotonic evidence, bounded verifier disturbance, and a contractive graft operator. We outline protocols for propagating derived insights using structured epistemic deltas, and formalize Verifiable Semantic Rollbacks to prune faulty premises from belief lineages without inducing context amnesia. We prototype ESR and report preliminary simulation results that show feasibility under the stated assumptions and illustrate reductions in secondary cognitive faults.

title: Task-Conditioned Synthetic Data Generation for Improving Machine Learning Performance in Agricultural Prediction Tasks
summary: Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have been widely used to estimate agricultural variables across diverse contexts. However, because the quantity and quality of training data strongly influence performance of ML algorithms, their use can be constrained by limited or incomplete reference data. Synthetic Data Generation (SDG) offers a practical approach to address this issue by producing artificial but realistic samples that preserve key characteristics of the original data. Building on teacher-student knowledge transfer and in-context learning for tabular data, this study proposes a Task-Conditioned SDG (TCSDG) algorithm that pairs a Bayesian Network generator with a transformer-based tabular foundation model (TabICL). The proposed algorithm was evaluated on two agricultural prediction tasks: crop yield prediction and crop type classification. Six benchmark SDG algorithms were also utilized to compare their performance with that of TCSDG. Across twelve study sites, two training-data fractions, four multiplication ratios, and three predictive ML algorithms, augmenting the original data with TCSDG-generated synthetic data improved ML performance in 89% of the crop type classification experiments and 74% of the crop yield prediction experiments. TCSDG also substantially outperformed benchmark SDG algorithms and was the only method to consistently improve ML performance across both tasks at the aggregate level. The study demonstrates that carefully designed and processed synthetic data can improve ML performance in precision-agriculture applications. TCSDG offers a practical and extensible framework for generating synthetic data that supports downstream ML agricultural prediction. The full implementation of TCSDG is publicly available as open source at https://github.com/HamidEbrahimy/TCSDG.

AI.title_translation: 基于任务条件化合成数据生成的农业预测任务机器学习性能提升研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出TCSDG算法，通过结合Transformer和贝叶斯网络生成高质量合成数据，有效解决了农业领域数据稀缺问题，显著提升了作物产量和类型预测的准确性。
AI.motivation: 农业机器学习模型在应用中常受限于高质量参考数据的数量与质量，研究旨在通过合成数据生成（SDG）技术扩充数据，从而提升农业预测任务的性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种任务条件化合成数据生成算法（TCSDG），该算法结合了贝叶斯网络生成器和基于Transformer的表格数据基础模型（TabICL），并利用教师-学生知识迁移和上下文学习机制进行训练。
AI.result: 在涉及12个研究地点、多种预测模型和任务的实验中，TCSDG在89%的作物类型分类实验和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升了机器学习性能，且在综合表现上优于其他六种基准算法。
AI.conclusion: TCSDG是一种高效的合成数据生成框架，能够通过任务条件化生成高质量的合成数据，显著提升农业机器学习预测任务的性能，具有广泛的实际应用潜力。
AI.translation: 机器学习（ML）算法已被广泛用于评估不同背景下的农业变量。然而，由于训练数据的数量和质量强烈影响ML算法的性能，其使用往往受到有限或不完整参考数据的限制。合成数据生成（SDG）通过产生既人工合成又真实、且保留原始数据关键特征的样本，为解决这一问题提供了一种实用的方法。基于教师-学生知识迁移和表格数据的上下文学习，本研究提出了一种任务条件化合成数据生成（TCSDG）算法，将贝叶斯网络生成器与基于Transformer的表格基础模型（TabICL）配对。该算法在作物产量预测和作物类型分类两项农业预测任务上进行了评估。研究还使用了六种基准SDG算法与其进行性能对比。通过在12个研究地点、两种训练数据比例、四种乘数倍率和三种预测ML算法下的实验，使用TCSDG生成的合成数据扩充原始数据，在89%的作物类型分类实验和74%的作物产量预测实验中提升了ML性能。TCSDG的表现也大幅优于基准SDG算法，并且是唯一一种在汇总层面持续提升两项任务ML性能的方法。本研究表明，精心设计和处理的合成数据可以提升精准农业应用中的ML性能。TCSDG为生成支持下游ML农业预测的合成数据提供了一个实用且可扩展的框架。TCSDG的完整实现已在GitHub开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为TCSDG的任务条件化合成数据生成算法，旨在通过结合贝叶斯网络与Transformer模型来解决农业预测中数据稀缺的问题。实验证明，该方法能有效生成高质量合成数据，并在作物产量和类型预测任务中显著优于现有基准方法。
AI.keywords: 合成数据生成, 任务条件化, 农业机器学习, 表格数据基础模型, 知识迁移
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将任务条件（Task-Conditioned）机制与贝叶斯网络及Transformer基础模型相结合，有效解决了农业领域数据稀缺的痛点。其优势在于通用性和鲁棒性，能够显著提升多种预测任务的性能，是弥补数据不足的有力工具。

title: Unified Backbone Refinement for Diffusion Models via Internal-Latent Analysis
comments: 45 pages, 23 figures. Accepted at the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
summary: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, with performance closely related to the denoising backbones that parameterize the score function. In this paper, we present a systematic, phase-aware analysis of diffusion components and show that abrupt, early-stage fluctuations in deep latents are strongly associated with artifacts. Guided by these findings, we introduce DUNE (Diffusion Unified Network refiNEr), a training-free refinement framework that detects abrupt deviations in deep low-noise internal latents using a shared EMA-based criterion, and applies backbone-specific suppression to the detector-selected entries. Although derived from U-Net, the same detect-suppress principle extends naturally to Transformer-based diffusion models by acting on the latents of deep self-attention blocks. Extensive experiments across multiple backbones indicate that DUNE improves fidelity while reducing hallucinations, offering new insight into where and when diffusion backbones should be controlled.

AI.title_translation: 基于内部潜变量分析的扩散模型统一骨干网络精炼
AI.tldr: DUNE是一种无需训练的精炼框架，通过检测并抑制扩散模型深层潜变量中的异常波动，显著提升了图像生成质量并减少了伪影。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的性能高度依赖于去噪骨干网络，而研究发现深层潜变量在早期阶段的剧烈波动与生成图像中的伪影存在强相关性。
AI.method: 提出DUNE框架，通过基于EMA的准则检测深层低噪声潜变量中的突变，并对检测到的异常项应用针对性的抑制策略。该方法适用于U-Net和Transformer架构。
AI.result: 实验证明DUNE能够有效提升多种骨干网络（U-Net和Transformer）的生成保真度，并减少幻觉现象。
AI.conclusion: DUNE提供了一种有效的、与架构无关的训练后精炼框架，能够通过抑制异常潜变量波动来提升扩散模型的生成质量，并为理解扩散模型内部机制提供了新视角。
AI.translation: 扩散模型在多个领域取得了显著成功，其性能与参数化分数函数的去噪骨干网络密切相关。在本文中，我们对扩散模型组件进行了系统的、阶段感知的分析，并表明深层潜变量中早期的突发波动与伪影强相关。基于这些发现，我们引入了DUNE（扩散统一网络精炼器），这是一个无需训练的精炼框架，它使用基于EMA的共享准则来检测深层低噪声内部潜变量中的突发偏差，并对检测到的条目应用骨干网络特定的抑制。虽然DUNE源于U-Net，但同样的检测-抑制原则可以通过作用于深度自注意力块的潜变量，自然地扩展到基于Transformer的扩散模型。在多个骨干网络上的广泛实验表明，DUNE在提高保真度的同时减少了幻觉，为扩散骨干网络在何时何地应受到控制提供了新的见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为DUNE的训练后精炼框架，用于优化扩散模型的去噪骨干网络。通过分析发现深层潜变量的早期波动与伪影有关，DUNE通过检测并抑制这些异常波动，实现了在不进行额外训练的情况下提升模型生成质量。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 潜变量分析, DUNE, 训练后精炼, 图像生成
AI.comments: 该论文通过分析扩散模型内部潜变量的波动提出了一个新颖的训练后优化框架（DUNE）。其创新之处在于将性能问题与早期的潜变量波动联系起来，并提出了一种无需训练即可跨架构（U-Net和Transformer）应用的通用精炼策略。该方法在提升生成质量和减少伪影方面具有显著潜力。

title: Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization
comments: Published at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/ShanechiLab/WiCAT
summary: Large-scale, multi-subject widefield calcium imaging provides unprecedented access to brain-wide cortical dynamics. However, the high dimensionality, complex spatiotemporal structure, and substantial task-irrelevant activity in widefield recordings have largely restricted modeling efforts to single-session analyses, limiting scalability and generalization. While multi-subject pretrained models have been explored for some neural modalities, multi-subject models for widefield calcium imaging have not yet been demonstrated; further, subject-invariant zero-shot behavior decoding remains elusive for multi-subject models across neural modalities more broadly. As a first step toward foundation modeling of widefield data, we introduce WiCAT, a multi-subject model that leverages self-supervised pretraining to both outperform single-session models and enable zero-shot behavior decoding on unseen subjects. WiCAT introduces an atlas-grounded tokenization scheme without session-specific components and learns globally shared spatiotemporal representations. Across multiple widefield datasets, the pretrained model supports lightweight downstream decoding, transfers across subjects, tasks, and datasets, and outperforms baseline models. Notably, the model also achieves robust zero-shot continuous behavior decoding and left-out brain region reconstruction on unseen subjects.
comment: Published at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) 2026. Code available at: https://github.com/ShanechiLab/WiCAT

AI.title_translation: 基于图谱对齐时空标记化的宽场钙成像跨受试者建模
AI.tldr: WiCAT 是一种新型宽场钙成像多受试者模型，通过自监督预训练实现了跨受试者的通用表征学习，并支持零样本行为解码。
AI.motivation: 现有的宽场钙成像建模受限于高维度和复杂的时空结构，多局限于单会话分析，缺乏可扩展性和跨受试者的泛化能力，且目前尚无针对宽场钙成像的多受试者模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 WiCAT 的模型，采用基于图谱对齐（atlas-grounded）的时空标记化方案，通过自监督预训练学习全局共享的时空表征，且模型不包含任何特定于会话的组件。
AI.result: WiCAT 在多个数据集上优于基线模型，支持轻量级下游解码，实现了跨受试者、任务和数据集的迁移，并在未见过的受试者上实现了鲁棒的零样本连续行为解码和被遮挡脑区重建。
AI.conclusion: WiCAT 通过自监督预训练成功实现了宽场钙成像的跨受试者建模，在性能和通用性上均优于传统单会话模型，为神经科学研究提供了一种高效、可扩展的通用分析工具。
AI.translation: 大规模、多受试者的宽场钙成像为研究全脑皮层动态提供了前所未有的途径。然而，宽场记录的高维性、复杂的时空结构以及大量的任务无关活动，使得建模工作大多局限于单会话分析，限制了其可扩展性和泛化能力。尽管针对某些神经模态的多受试者预训练模型已有研究，但宽场钙成像的多受试者模型尚未得到验证；此外，在更广泛的神经模态中，实现受试者不变的零样本行为解码仍然困难。作为迈向宽场数据基础模型的第一步，我们引入了 WiCAT，这是一种利用自监督预训练的多受试者模型，它不仅优于单会话模型，还实现了对未见受试者的零样本行为解码。WiCAT 引入了一种无需会话特定组件的图谱对齐标记化方案，并学习了全局共享的时空表征。在多个宽场数据集上，该预训练模型支持轻量级下游解码，能够跨受试者、任务和数据集进行迁移，并优于基线模型。值得注意的是，该模型还在未见受试者上实现了稳健的零样本连续行为解码和被遮挡脑区重建。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 WiCAT，这是一种用于宽场钙成像的多受试者基础模型。通过引入基于图谱对齐的时空标记化技术，WiCAT 能够学习通用的时空表征，从而在无需会话特定参数的情况下，实现跨受试者、任务和数据集的高效迁移与零样本行为解码。
AI.keywords: 宽场钙成像, 跨受试者建模, 自监督学习, 标记化, 行为解码
AI.comments: 该论文在宽场钙成像领域迈出了重要的一步，通过引入图谱对齐的标记化方法，成功解决了跨受试者建模的难题。其最大的创新在于实现了无需特定会话组件的通用表征学习，证明了在神经成像中实现跨受试者零样本行为解码的可能性，为构建宽场数据的“基础模型”奠定了基础。

title: LegalFarePlan: A Label-Setting Framework for Fare-Transparent Urban Rail Route Planning under Non-Additive Fare Rules
comments: 6 pages, 4 tables; author preprint version, not the conference camera-ready version
summary: Urban rail fare systems may be non-additive: the fare of a single paid journey from an origin to a destination can differ from the sum of fares over multiple legally separated journey legs. This paper presents LegalFarePlan, a fare-transparent route-planning framework that models legal exit-and-reentry operations as explicit, auditable constraints. Given a transit network, fare function, transfer rules, station-level exit/re-entry costs, an extra-time budget, and a split limit, the planner computes explainable route plans over paid journey segments. The artifact implements Dijkstra shortest-time and direct route-planner baselines, a greedy split heuristic, bounded exact label-setting, and Pareto-frontier search. Evaluation uses controlled synthetic data and a 57-station semi-synthetic benchmark with 360 OD pairs. On the semi-synthetic benchmark, bounded exact search identifies positive modeled fare reductions for 71.11% of OD pairs, with mean reduction 3.78 and maximum reduction 9.0 synthetic fare units under a 45-minute extra-time budget. These results demonstrate method behavior and reproducibility; they are not empirical conclusions about MTR or any transit operator.

AI.title_translation: LegalFarePlan：一种非加性票价规则下票价透明的城市轨道交通路径规划标签设置框架
AI.tldr: LegalFarePlan通过显式建模合法出站/再入站规则，帮助乘客在城市轨道交通中通过拆分行程找到更便宜的出行路径。
AI.motivation: 城市轨道交通中存在非加性票价现象（即多段行程之和可能低于直达票价），现有的路径规划工具缺乏对合法出站/再入站操作的显式支持和可解释性。
AI.method: 提出LegalFarePlan框架，将出站/再入站操作建模为约束条件；实现了Dijkstra基准、贪心启发式算法、有界精确标签设置算法及帕累托前沿搜索算法。
AI.result: 在57站的半合成基准测试中，有界精确搜索算法在71.11%的OD对中发现了票价降低方案，平均降低3.78个票价单位，最大降低9.0个单位。
AI.conclusion: LegalFarePlan框架通过显式处理非加性票价规则，能够有效识别更经济的出行路径，证明了在有限的时间预算内通过拆分行程降低票价的可行性。
AI.translation: 城市轨道交通票价系统可能具有非加性特征：从起点到终点的单次付费行程票价可能与多次合法分离的行程票价之和不同。本文提出了LegalFarePlan，这是一个票价透明的路径规划框架，它将合法的出站和再入站操作建模为显式、可审计的约束。给定交通网络、票价函数、换乘规则、车站级出站/再入站成本、额外时间预算和拆分限制，该规划器计算付费行程段上的可解释路径计划。该工具实现了Dijkstra最短时间基准和直接路径规划基准、贪心拆分启发式算法、有界精确标签设置算法和帕累托前沿搜索。评估使用了受控合成数据和一个包含360个OD对的57站半合成基准。在半合成基准测试中，有界精确搜索在45分钟的额外时间预算下，识别出71.11%的OD对存在正向票价缩减，平均缩减3.78个票价单位，最大缩减9.0个票价单位。这些结果展示了方法行为和可重复性；它们并非关于MTR或任何交通运营商的实证结论。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LegalFarePlan框架，专门用于解决城市轨道交通中非加性票价带来的路径规划问题。该框架通过引入可审计的约束条件，在考虑时间预算和拆分限制的前提下，为乘客提供更经济且可解释的出行路径方案。实验验证了该方法在识别票价节省方案方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 城市轨道交通, 路径规划, 非加性票价, 标签设置算法, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入标签设置框架解决了城市轨道交通中非加性票价规则下的路径规划难题。其创新之处在于将合法的出站/再入站操作显式建模为可审计的约束，不仅提高了路径规划的经济性，还增强了方案的可解释性。不过，研究主要基于半合成数据，实际应用中复杂的运营约束可能带来更多挑战。

title: LLM-Centric Agentic AI for UAV Swarms: Architecture, Enabling Technologies, and Open Problems
summary: Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) swarms have significant potential for applications such as Search and Rescue (SAR) and environmental monitoring, but their real-world deployment is limited by a lack of situational awareness, intermittent connectivity, and significant cybersecurity risks. Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) represents a shift from standalone Large Language Model (LLM) toward closed-loop cognitive architectures that integrate perception, memory, reasoning/planning, and action to enable adaptive, goal-directed swarm behavior. Within this framework, Agentic AI provides a unifying structure for autonomous and adaptive swarm operations while expanding the system attack surface compared to conventional AI systems. This paper proposes LLM-Centric Agentic AI for UAV Swarms (LAUS) and reviews key enabling technologies such as onboard and edge computing, 5G/6G connectivity, multimodal intelligence, and cybersecurity mechanisms, and analyzes threats such as Priority Manipulation Attacks (PMA) that can distort decision-making and degrade network performance. Finally, it identifies open research challenges, including hallucination-resistant reasoning, onboard LLM deployment under SWaP constraints, and standardized security benchmarks for perception-reasoning attacks in agentic UAV systems.

AI.title_translation: 面向无人机蜂群的以LLM为中心的Agentic AI：架构、使能技术与开放问题
AI.tldr: 本文探讨了将LLM驱动的Agentic AI应用于无人机蜂群的架构方案，分析了其技术挑战与安全风险，并提出了未来的研究路径。
AI.motivation: 现有的无人机蜂群在复杂应用场景下受限于感知能力不足、通信中断及安全风险，亟需一种能够整合感知、记忆、推理与执行的闭环认知架构来提升其自主性。
AI.method: 提出了以LLM为中心的无人机蜂群Agentic AI架构（LAUS），并通过综合分析机载/边缘计算、5G/6G连接、多模态智能及网络安全机制，探讨了其技术实现路径与面临的威胁。
AI.result: 明确了LAUS架构的实施关键技术，分析了如优先级操纵攻击（PMA）等新型威胁，并系统梳理了包括防幻觉推理、计算资源约束（SWaP）及安全性评估标准在内的开放研究课题。
AI.conclusion: 以LLM为中心的Agentic AI是提升无人机蜂群自主性与适应性的关键路径，但必须克服计算资源限制、决策幻觉及新型安全攻击等挑战，才能实现大规模的实际部署。
AI.translation: 无人机（UAV）蜂群在搜索与救援（SAR）和环境监测等应用中具有巨大潜力，但其实际部署受限于态势感知能力不足、通信中断以及严重的安全风险。Agentic人工智能（AI）代表了从独立的LLM向闭环认知架构的转变，该架构整合了感知、记忆、推理/规划和行动，以实现自适应、目标导向的蜂群行为。在该框架下，Agentic AI为自主和自适应蜂群操作提供了一个统一的结构，但与传统AI系统相比，它也扩大了系统的攻击面。本文提出了面向无人机蜂群的以LLM为中心的Agentic AI（LAUS），综述了机载和边缘计算、5G/6G连接、多模态智能和网络安全机制等关键使能技术，并分析了可能扭曲决策并降低网络性能的优先级操纵攻击（PMA）等威胁。最后，文章确定了开放的研究挑战，包括抗幻觉推理、SWaP（尺寸、重量和功耗）约束下的机载LLM部署，以及代理无人机系统中感知-推理攻击的标准化安全基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向无人机蜂群的以LLM为核心的Agentic AI架构（LAUS），旨在通过闭环认知系统提升蜂群的自主性与环境适应能力。文章探讨了实现该架构的关键支撑技术，分析了其引入的系统性安全风险，并为未来实现安全、高效的无人机蜂群自主决策指明了研究方向。
AI.keywords: 无人机蜂群, Agentic AI, 大语言模型, 网络安全, 自主决策
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将以大语言模型（LLM）为中心的Agentic AI架构引入无人机蜂群控制，系统性地探讨了该架构在复杂环境下增强蜂群感知与决策能力的潜力，同时也敏锐地指出了其带来的新型网络安全风险。这对无人机自主化研究具有重要的前瞻性指导意义。

title: RSLoRA: Training-free Rank Allocation for LoRA via Representational Sensitivity Probing
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT); however, the conventional practice of uniform rank assignment ignores the functional heterogeneity of neural layers. Existing rank allocation methods typically struggle with a trade-off between computational intensity and heuristic simplicity: training-based methods suffer from prohibitive overhead, while pre-allocation methods fail to capture the dynamic task-specific representation manifold. In this paper, we propose RSLoRA (Representational Sensitivity LoRA), a training-free and gradient-free rank allocator driven by activation-space geometry. We identify a "sensitivity regime shift" across layers, observing that static weight analysis and local gradients are insufficient to reflect how updates reshape a model's internal representations. To address this, RSLoRA introduces a virtual representational probing mechanism. By simulating adaptation through structured low-rank noise and measuring the resulting manifold displacement by using Effective Rank and Frechet Distance, we identify high-sensitivity modules that require higher rank capacity. Our framework effectively bridges the gap between expert-crafted heuristics and actual representational impact. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RSLoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art allocators (e.g., AdaLoRA, GoRA) across mainstream benchmarks. By eliminating the need for iterative training-time adjustments and backward gradients, RSLoRA provides a highly efficient, robust, and representation-aware solution for large-scale model adaptation.

AI.title_translation: RSLoRA：基于表示敏感度探测的LoRA免训练秩分配方法
AI.tldr: RSLoRA通过分析模型激活空间的几何变化，无需额外训练即可智能地为LoRA分配各层秩，实现高效且精准的模型微调。
AI.motivation: 传统的LoRA秩分配方法存在局限性：统一秩分配忽视了层间功能差异，而基于训练的方法开销过大，现有的预分配方法则无法准确捕捉任务特定的表示流形。
AI.method: 提出RSLoRA框架，通过虚拟表示探测机制，利用结构化低秩噪声模拟适配过程，并使用有效秩（Effective Rank）和弗雷歇距离（Frechet Distance）测量流形位移，从而识别敏感度较高的模块并分配更高秩。
AI.result: 在主流基准测试中，RSLoRA的表现持续优于AdaLoRA和GoRA等现有最先进的分配方法，且无需迭代训练和反向梯度计算。
AI.conclusion: RSLoRA通过虚拟表示探测机制，无需训练即可实现高效的LoRA秩分配，在性能和计算效率上均优于现有的分配方法。
AI.translation: 低秩适配（LoRA）已成为参数高效微调（PEFT）的基石；然而，传统的统一秩分配做法忽视了神经网络层的功能异质性。现有的秩分配方法通常在计算强度和启发式简单性之间难以权衡：基于训练的方法面临过高的开销，而预分配方法则无法捕捉任务特定的动态表示流形。在本文中，我们提出了RSLoRA（表示敏感度LoRA），这是一种由激活空间几何驱动的免训练、无梯度秩分配器。我们识别出各层之间存在“敏感度机制转移”，观察到静态权重分析和局部梯度不足以反映更新如何重塑模型的内部表示。为了解决这个问题，RSLoRA引入了一种虚拟表示探测机制。通过结构化低秩噪声模拟适配过程，并利用有效秩和弗雷歇距离测量由此产生的流形位移，我们识别出需要更高秩容量的高敏感度模块。我们的框架有效地弥合了专家启发式方法与实际表示影响之间的差距。广泛的评估表明，RSLoRA在主流基准测试中始终优于最先进的分配器（如AdaLoRA、GoRA）。通过消除对迭代训练调整和反向梯度的需求，RSLoRA为大规模模型适配提供了一种高效、稳健且具有表示感知能力的解决方案。
AI.summary: RSLoRA是一种无需训练和梯度的LoRA秩分配方法，通过探测模型激活空间的几何位移来识别各层敏感度，从而实现动态的秩分配，在保证高性能的同时显著提升了微调效率。
AI.keywords: LoRA, 参数高效微调, 秩分配, 表示敏感度, 模型适配
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“无需训练”的LoRA秩分配方法，巧妙地利用激活空间的几何特性来评估各层的敏感度。其核心贡献在于避开了昂贵的训练开销，同时比传统的启发式方法更精准，为大规模模型的高效微调提供了极具实用价值的方案。

title: ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multi-Media Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams
summary: Building assistants that can continually watch the world, remember what they see, and reason over their accumulated experience is a long-standing goal, and recently multimodal agents equipped with long-term memory over video streams have attracted increasing interest. Unfortunately, existing systems either keep their memory inside the model context or in a flat feature store, and organize it around frames rather than around the persistent entities a stream is really about, which confines them to bounded videos and weakens their ability to track who and what reappears over time. In this paper, we propose ReflectWorld-MM, an entity-oriented multi-media memory system for open-ended video streams. It consists of three parts. The first is a perception front-end that turns a streaming video into entity-resolved observations under a bounded short-term memory. The second is a hierarchical long-term memory, grounded in human memory theory, that couples a multi-scale episodic memory, an evolving entity-centric semantic memory, and a procedural memory. The third is a complete realization, built for real-world operation, that ingests arbitrary streams and plugs into off-the-shelf assistants. Across six long-video and lifelong-memory benchmarks, ReflectWorld-MM achieves the best accuracy on all six, outperforming strong memory agents and a frontier model.

title: BatteryLake: Agentic, Physics-Grounded Curation of Heterogeneous Battery Aging Data and Benchmarking
comments: The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/
summary: Public battery aging datasets are a critical asset for advanced health management, but their practical use is often limited by inconsistent formats, unclear schemas, and metadata scattered across repositories and publications. Current curation remains largely manual and hard to reproduce, while general-purpose data integration tools miss the domain-specific semantics of electrochemical time-series data. We present BatteryLake, a governed data lakehouse that turns raw public battery data into benchmark-ready assets through an agentic, physics-grounded curation framework, with three contributions. First, LLM agents extract metadata and synthesize dataset-specific converters, grounding every output in verbatim evidence and abstaining when none supports a value. Second, a human-in-the-loop mechanism frames verification as selective prediction and gates admitted data through 26 schema, statistical, and physical-plausibility rules. Third, we release an open benchmark of 41 datasets from over 25 institutions, with standardized SOH and RUL tasks, three split protocols, and eight baseline model families. The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/.
comment: The platform, benchmark, and curation protocol are publicly available at https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/

AI.title_translation: BatteryLake：异构电池老化数据的代理式、物理约束治理与基准测试
AI.tldr: BatteryLake 利用物理约束的 AI 智能体自动清洗和标准化异构电池数据，并提供了一个包含 41 个数据集的开放基准，旨在解决电池健康管理研究中的数据碎片化难题。
AI.motivation: 公共电池老化数据集格式不统一、元数据分散且缺乏领域语义，导致数据使用效率低下且难以复现，缺乏专门针对电化学时间序列数据的集成工具。
AI.method: 提出 BatteryLake 框架，采用 LLM 智能体提取元数据并自动生成转换器，结合人机协同验证机制及 26 条模式、统计与物理合理性规则进行数据治理。
AI.result: 构建并发布了一个包含 41 个数据集（来自 25+ 机构）的开放基准，涵盖标准化的 SOH 和 RUL 任务、三种分割协议及八种基准模型系列。
AI.conclusion: BatteryLake 通过智能体驱动的物理约束框架，成功将异构电池老化数据转化为标准化的基准资产，显著降低了数据使用门槛，推动了电池健康管理领域的研究进程。
AI.translation: 公共电池老化数据集是先进健康管理的重要资产，但其应用常受限于格式不一致、模式定义模糊以及元数据分散在各类存储库和出版物中。目前的数据整理工作主要依赖人工且难以复现，而通用数据集成工具又缺乏电化学时间序列数据的领域语义。我们提出了 BatteryLake，这是一个受治理的数据湖仓，通过代理式、物理约束的整理框架，将原始的公共电池数据转化为可直接使用的基准资产。我们做出了三点贡献：首先，LLM 智能体通过逐字证据提取元数据并合成特定数据集的转换器，并在缺乏证据时拒绝处理；其次，人机协同机制将验证过程构建为选择性预测，并通过 26 条模式、统计及物理合理性规则对入库数据进行筛选；第三，我们发布了一个开放基准，包含来自 25 个以上机构的 41 个数据集，以及标准化的 SOH 和 RUL 任务、三种分割协议和八种基准模型系列。平台、基准和整理协议已在 https://tianwen1209.github.io/batterylake/ 公开。
AI.summary: BatteryLake 是一个专门用于电池老化数据的治理湖仓，利用基于物理约束的 LLM 智能体将异构原始数据转化为标准化的基准资产。该系统通过自动化数据提取、严格的验证机制和开放的基准测试平台，解决了当前电池数据处理碎片化和不透明的问题。
AI.keywords: 电池老化数据, 数据湖仓, 大语言模型代理, 物理约束, 电池健康管理
AI.comments: BatteryLake 是一项非常有意义的工作，它解决了电池领域数据碎片化和处理成本高的痛点。其核心创新在于将 LLM 的智能体能力与领域物理约束相结合，实现了数据清洗的自动化与可信度保障，为电池健康管理研究提供了一个标准化的基准。

title: Knowledge-Constrained Shape Optimization with a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator for High-Confidence Design
summary: Engineering shape optimization faces challenges in both expert-dependent problem setup and surrogate-model reliability. In practical aerodynamic design, optimization settings such as editable regions, deformation ranges, and design-preservation constraints are typically specified manually by experienced engineers, while surrogate-based optimization may become unreliable for heterogeneous geometry databases and out-of-distribution designs. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge-constrained shape-optimization framework that translates knowledge-based constraints and user intent into quantifiable parameters of DFFD-based deformation operators, enabling engineering-aware and controllable constrained optimization. We further develop a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator (MoE-NO) to improve drag prediction and trend consistency over heterogeneous aerodynamic datasets. Based on the MoE-NO encoder and Mahalanobis distance, an uncertainty-estimation strategy is introduced to detect out-of-distribution geometries and selectively trigger physics-solver feedback for local sample enrichment. Experiments on in-house MPV, SUV, and Sedan datasets show that MoE-NO achieves a test-set MAPE of $1.16\%$ and a trend-prediction accuracy of $94.34\%$, outperforming the best baseline results of $1.52\%$ and $90.34\%$, respectively. Vehicle shape-optimization experiments further yield CFD-validated drag coefficient reductions of approximately $4\%$ to $10\%$.

AI.title_translation: 基于混合专家神经算子的知识约束形状优化：实现高置信度设计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合工程知识与MoE神经算子的形状优化框架，通过不确定性感知和物理反馈，显著提升了空气动力学设计的可靠性与优化效果。
AI.motivation: 工程形状优化中存在高度依赖专家经验的问题，且现有的代理模型在处理异构几何数据及分布外（OOD）设计时可靠性不足。
AI.method: 提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，利用DFFD变形算子将工程知识转化为量化参数；开发了混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO）以处理异构数据集；引入了基于马氏距离的不确定性检测策略，以触发物理求解器进行样本补充。
AI.result: 在MPV、SUV和Sedan数据集上，MoE-NO的测试集MAPE达到1.16%，趋势预测准确率达94.34%，均优于基线模型；车辆形状优化实验实现了4%至10%的阻力系数降低。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过集成工程约束与MoE-NO代理模型，实现了高可靠性、可控的空气动力学形状优化，在提升预测精度的同时，显著降低了设计过程对人工经验的依赖。
AI.translation: 工程形状优化在问题设置的专家依赖性和代理模型的可靠性方面均面临挑战。在实际的空气动力学设计中，可编辑区域、变形范围和设计保留约束等优化设置通常由经验丰富的工程师手动指定，而基于代理的优化对于异构几何数据库和分布外设计可能变得不可靠。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，将基于知识的约束和用户意图转化为基于DFFD变形算子的量化参数，从而实现工程感知且可控的约束优化。我们进一步开发了一种混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO），以改善异构空气动力学数据集上的阻力预测和趋势一致性。基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离，引入了一种不确定性估计策略，用于检测分布外几何形状并选择性地触发物理求解器反馈以进行局部样本补充。在内部MPV、SUV和Sedan数据集上的实验表明，MoE-NO的测试集MAPE达到1.16%，趋势预测准确率为94.34%，分别优于最佳基线结果的1.52%和90.34%。车辆形状优化实验进一步实现了约4%至10%的CFD验证阻力系数降低。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，旨在解决工程设计中的人工依赖和代理模型可靠性问题。通过融合领域知识的变形算子和MoE-NO预测模型，结合分布外检测机制，实现了对复杂几何设计的高精度预测和有效阻力优化。
AI.keywords: 形状优化, 混合专家神经算子, 空气动力学设计, 不确定性估计, 工程约束
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了领域知识与深度学习，通过MoE-NO架构增强了代理模型在异构数据上的泛化能力，并引入了基于马氏距离的不确定性评估机制，有效解决了优化过程中常见的“黑盒”不可控和分布外失效问题，具有很高的工业应用价值。

title: OmniSCS: Omni Safety-Critical Scenario Synthesis for Autonomous Driving via a Fully Editable Driving World
summary: The synthesis of safety-critical scenarios (SCS) and their evaluation through closed-loop simulations are crucial for developing robust autonomous driving systems. A key aspect of this process involves editing agent states in both appearance and trajectory levels within existing scenes. However, current methods struggle to preserve data fidelity after scene editing and fail to efficiently generate high-quality SCS through such modifications. To overcome these limitations, we propose OmniSCS, an innovative system that generates photorealistic SCS with high physical fidelity while enabling closed-loop testing in synthetic environments. OmniSCS comprises two key modules: 1) A Fully Editable Driving World Construction module that maintains high-fidelity agent appearance and background during scene editing via dual-strategy agent reconstruction and depth-refinement background reconstruction methods. 2) A SCS Synthesis module that facilitates object insertion and agent trajectory editing to synthesize diverse SCS while preserving data fidelity. Experiments on nuScenes, Waymo, and KITTI datasets show that OmniSCS outperforms state-of-the-art methods in edited scene fidelity. We further validate its ability to enhance autonomous driving algorithms and support real-time (13Hz) closed-loop testing. Overall, OmniSCS provides a safer, more effective, and cost-efficient solution for SCS optimization and testing in autonomous driving.

title: How Much Does Correctness Cost? Budgeted Placement of Strong Correctors in a Weak Multi-Agent Swarm
comments: 30 pages, 9 figures, 1 table.. Code and data: https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placement
summary: A cheap swarm of unreliable agents can be steered to a correct consensus by a few strong, expensive "oracle" correctors. We ask how much one must spend, and where to place the oracles. We model the swarm as a consensus on a graph in which each oracle pins one node toward the truth at a cost-coupled, concave strength, and measure quality by the coherence H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1}. Our first result is that H stays submodular (each added oracle helps less than the last) even when the oracles differ in strength, so a cost-benefit greedy comes within 1-1/e of the best placement at any budget. Inverting the budget gives the budget-correctness frontier B*(eps), the least spend that guarantees an eps-correct consensus: closed-form on the complete graph, and a minimal oracle count k* when oracles cost the same. Whether a budget then buys a few strong oracles or many medium onese curvature of the cost-quality law: diminishing returns favour spreadsharply increasion. Measured onthe Qwen3 ladder (0.6-32B), the law is concave for math verificatio convex foremergent code tracing, so the verdict is genuinely task-dependent.https://github.com/YehudaItkin/budgeted-oracle-placemen

AI.title_translation: 正确性需要多少代价？弱多智能体群组中强修正器的预算化部署研究
AI.tldr: 本文通过子模性证明了贪心算法在多智能体系统修正器部署中的有效性，并指出不同任务类型决定了投资强修正器还是多弱修正器的最优策略。
AI.motivation: 在由廉价且不可靠的智能体组成的群组中，如何以最小的成本通过部署少量昂贵的“预言家”修正器来确保系统达成正确的共识，以及这些修正器应该放置在何处。
AI.method: 将多智能体群组建模为图上的共识问题，引入相干性指标 H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1} 来衡量准确性；证明了 H 的子模性，并利用贪心算法在预算约束下进行修正器放置优化；通过分析成本-质量定律的曲率来评估不同任务下的表现。
AI.result: 证明了在任何预算下，基于贪心策略的放置方案能达到最优方案 1-1/e 的效果；推导出了完全图上的预算-准确性边界；发现成本-质量定律在数学验证任务中呈凹性（边际收益递减），而在代码追踪任务中呈凸性。
AI.conclusion: 在多智能体系统中，通过贪心策略放置修正器可以以接近最优的代价实现目标共识，但最优的投资策略（强修正器与弱修正器的选择）高度依赖于具体任务的性质（凹性或凸性）。
AI.translation: 由廉价、不可靠的智能体组成的群组可以通过少量强大且昂贵的“预言家”修正器引导至正确的共识。我们探讨了需要花费多少成本以及将这些修正器放置在何处。我们将群组建模为图上的共识问题，其中每个预言家以成本耦合的凹强度将一个节点引向真理，并使用相干性 H(R)=tr M(R)^{-1} 来衡量质量。我们的第一个结果是，即使预言家的强度不同，H 仍然保持子模性（每个新增的预言家带来的帮助递减），因此在任何预算下，成本效益贪心算法都能达到最优放置效果的 1-1/e。反转预算得出预算-正确性边界 B*(eps)，即保证 eps-正确共识所需的最小支出：在完全图上得到闭式解，当预言家成本相同时得到最小预言家数量 k*。至于预算是应该购买少量强预言家还是多个中等预言家，取决于成本-质量定律的曲率：边际收益递减倾向于分散放置。在 Qwen3 阶梯（0.6-32B）上测量发现，该定律对于数学验证是凹的，对于新兴代码追踪是凸的，因此结论确实取决于任务本身。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在多智能体群组中如何高效分配昂贵的修正器资源以实现系统共识。研究证明了准确性指标的子模性，支持使用贪心算法进行资源放置。实验显示，最优的预算分配策略（强修正器 vs. 多弱修正器）取决于任务类型，在数学任务中表现为边际收益递减，而在代码任务中则相反。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 共识模型, 子模性, 预算分配, 资源优化
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入子模性（submodularity）理论，成功将复杂的修正器放置问题转化为可优化的贪心策略问题。其最大的创新在于量化了“修正成本”与“结果准确性”之间的权衡，并揭示了这种权衡在不同任务（如数学验证与代码追踪）中表现出完全相反的曲率特性，为资源受限下的多智能体系统设计提供了重要的理论指导。

title: Norm Enforcement for AI Agents: Robustly Shaping Behavior in Multi-Agent Systems
comments: ICML2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop
summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed in shared environments where they pursue diverse goals and compete for rewards. This multi-agent competition can lead to behaviors that serve individual gains at collective cost -- for instance, marketing agents may post misleading content as a result of competing for engagement on social media. Human societies address such problems through norms that constrain acceptable behavior, supported by enforcement mechanisms that detect and penalize violations. Motivated by this, we study norm enforcement mechanisms for language model agents. We find that simple enforcement mechanisms are exploited by misaligned agents for competitive advantage, even when they are not explicitly trained or prompted to do so. We thus turn our attention to designing more robust mechanisms, and identify two key ingredients: estimating each agent's reliability over time, and updating this estimate with escalating penalties for repeated misbehavior. Across three simulated environments and a variety of agent populations, mechanisms built on these principles resist exploitation, while still penalizing norm violations at comparable or lower cost than baselines. Our results position norm enforcement mechanisms as scalable levers for shaping agents' behavior, but only when designed to anticipate becoming part of the system they govern. Our code and data are available at https://yaowenye.com/norm-enforcement.
comment: ICML2026 Trustworthy AI for Good Workshop

AI.title_translation: AI智能体的规范执行：在多智能体系统中稳健地塑造行为
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种结合可靠性评估与递增惩罚的鲁棒机制，以防止AI智能体在多智能体竞争中利用规范执行规则，从而实现更有效的行为引导。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体竞争环境中，智能体往往为了个体利益而损害集体利益（如发布虚假内容），现有的简单执行机制容易被智能体利用以获取竞争优势，因此需要设计更鲁棒的规范执行机制。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于两个核心要素的规范执行机制：一是随时间推移评估每个智能体的可靠性，二是根据重复违规行为实施递增惩罚。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于所提原则设计的机制在三种模拟环境中均能有效抵御利用行为，且在惩罚违规行为时的成本优于或等同于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入动态可靠性评估和递增惩罚机制，可以有效构建抗利用的鲁棒规范执行系统，为多智能体环境下的行为治理提供了 scalable 的解决方案。
AI.translation: AI智能体越来越多地被部署在共享环境中，它们追求多样化的目标并竞争奖励。这种多智能体竞争可能导致以牺牲集体利益为代价的个体收益行为——例如，营销智能体为了争夺社交媒体上的参与度而发布误导性内容。人类社会通过规范来约束可接受的行为，并辅以检测和惩罚违规行为的执行机制来解决此类问题。受此启发，我们研究了语言模型智能体的规范执行机制。我们发现，即使没有明确的训练或提示，简单的执行机制也会被不对齐的智能体利用以获取竞争优势。因此，我们将注意力转向设计更稳健的机制，并确定了两个关键要素：随时间推移评估每个智能体的可靠性，并通过对重复违规行为实施递增惩罚来更新该评估。在三种模拟环境和多种智能体群体中，基于这些原则构建的机制能够抵御利用行为，同时以相当或更低的成本惩罚违规行为。我们的研究结果表明，规范执行机制是塑造智能体行为的可扩展杠杆，但前提是其设计必须预见到自身将成为其所治理系统的一部分。我们的代码和数据可在 https://yaowenye.com/norm-enforcement 获取。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了如何通过规范执行机制来引导多智能体系统中的AI行为。研究发现简单的执行机制易被智能体利用，为此提出了一种结合可靠性评估与递增惩罚的鲁棒机制，实验证明该机制在提升系统规范性的同时具备良好的抗干扰能力。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 规范执行, AI治理, 鲁棒性, 语言模型代理
AI.comments: 该研究敏锐地指出了在多智能体系统中，单纯的规范执行机制可能被智能体“利用”的问题。通过引入基于可靠性评估和递增惩罚的机制，作者为解决AI系统的治理问题提供了切实可行的路径，强调了机制设计必须具备“反思性”，即考虑到机制本身会成为系统博弈的一部分。这是AI安全与治理领域的重要贡献。

title: Low-Power License Plate Detection and Recognition on a RISC-V Multi-Core MCU-Based Vision System
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. This paper has been accepted for publication in the IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS). Copyright 2021 IEEE
summary: In this paper, we present the first (to the best of our knowledge) demonstration of a low-power MCU-based edge device for Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR). The design leverages on a 9-core RISC-V processor, GAP8, coupled with a QVGA ultra-low-power greyscale imager. The proposed visual processing pipeline uses a multi-model inference approach based on SSDlite-MobilenetV2 for license plate detection and LPRNet for optical character recognition, reaching a 38.9% mAP score for the first task and a recognition rate of >99.13% for the latter on public datasets. On real-world data, the pipeline recognizes registration numbers when the size of LP crops is as small as 30x5 pixels. Thanks to the applied compression and optimization strategies, the multi-model inference (687 MMAC) achieves a throughput of 1.09 FPS at a power cost of 117 mW when running on GAP8. Our solution is the first MCU-class device embedding such a level of network complexity, resulting to be 73x more energy-efficient w.r.t. precedent mobile-class ALPR system featuring a Raspberry Pi3. The proposed design does not resort to any hardwired acceleration engines, thus retaining full flexibility for future algorithmic improvements.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. This paper has been accepted for publication in the IEEE International Symposium on Circuits and Systems (ISCAS). Copyright 2021 IEEE

AI.title_translation: 基于RISC-V多核MCU视觉系统的低功耗车牌检测与识别
AI.tldr: 本文展示了首个在RISC-V MCU上运行的高效ALPR系统，其能效比传统移动平台提升73倍，且无需专用硬件加速。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决现有车牌识别系统通常依赖高功耗硬件（如Raspberry Pi）的问题，探索在极低功耗MCU边缘设备上实现复杂视觉任务的可能性。
AI.method: 采用基于GAP8（9核RISC-V处理器）的硬件平台，结合SSDlite-MobilenetV2进行车牌检测，使用LPRNet进行字符识别，并应用了压缩与优化策略以适配MCU资源。
AI.result: 实现了1.09 FPS的吞吐量，功耗仅为117 mW；车牌检测mAP为38.9%，字符识别率超过99.13%，其能效比传统移动端系统（如树莓派3）提升了73倍。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功证明了在无需专用硬件加速的情况下，利用多核RISC-V MCU实现高效边缘侧车牌识别的可行性，为低功耗视觉系统提供了新的参考范式。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们展示了（据我们所知）第一个用于自动车牌识别（ALPR）的低功耗MCU边缘设备演示。该设计利用了9核RISC-V处理器（GAP8）以及QVGA超低功耗灰度成像仪。提出的视觉处理流水线采用了基于SSDlite-MobilenetV2的车牌检测和用于光学字符识别的LPRNet的多模型推理方法，在公共数据集上，检测任务达到38.9%的mAP，识别率超过99.13%。在真实数据上，当车牌裁剪尺寸小至30x5像素时，该流水线仍能识别注册号码。得益于应用的压缩和优化策略，多模型推理（687 MMAC）在GAP8上运行时的吞吐量为1.09 FPS，功耗为117 mW。我们的解决方案是第一个嵌入如此复杂网络级别的MCU级设备，其能效比以往基于树莓派3的移动级ALPR系统高出73倍。所提出的设计不依赖任何硬连线加速引擎，因此为未来的算法改进保留了完全的灵活性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了首个基于RISC-V多核MCU的低功耗车牌识别（ALPR）系统。通过在GAP8处理器上部署优化后的SSDlite-MobilenetV2和LPRNet模型，该方案在无需专用硬件加速的情况下，实现了高能效的实时车牌检测与字符识别，为边缘侧视觉处理提供了高度灵活且节能的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 车牌识别, RISC-V, 低功耗边缘计算, MCU, 视觉系统
