AI.title_translation: 增强RAMOSE：一个在数据源上实现REST API和语义可操作输出的框架
AI.tldr: RAMOSE 2.0是一个开源框架，通过配置文件即可将数据源转化为符合SKG-IF标准的REST API，并支持跨RDF与非RDF数据源的复杂查询与连接。
AI.motivation: 许多开放科研基础设施因开发成本过高，难以实现符合特定规范（如SKG-IF）的REST API，RAMOSE旨在降低这一开发门槛。
AI.method: 通过基于声明式配置文件，将RDF三元组存储转化为REST API。2.0版本引入了查询编排、多源（RDF与非RDF）连接、插件化输出、分页与缓存、OpenAPI导出以及包含鉴权功能的写操作。
AI.result: RAMOSE 2.0支持跨多种SPARQL端点和非RDF源的复杂查询，提供了一套完整的SKG-IF合规方案。对比测试显示，它是唯一能在单次API操作中实现RDF与非RDF数据按任意键连接的工具。该框架已成功支撑OpenCitations的高并发访问。
AI.conclusion: RAMOSE 2.0通过一系列新功能极大地提升了灵活性和可扩展性，成为了构建科研基础设施REST API的强大且高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 学术基础设施越来越多地通过遵循共享规范（如科学知识图谱互操作框架SKG-IF）的REST API公开其数据，该框架定义了科研信息的通用数据模型、交换格式和REST API。然而，在现有数据源上实现此类规范需要大量的开发工作，许多开放基础设施无法承担。RAMOSE（RESTful API Manager Over SPARQL Endpoints）是一个开源的Python框架，它通过将声明式配置文件转换为RDF三元组存储上的文档化REST API，从而降低了这种开发工作量。本文介绍了该工具的第二个主要版本，它扩展了九项新需求。新功能包括跨多个SPARQL端点和非RDF源的查询编排，以及跨其结果的连接；可插拔的输出格式和请求参数；分页和缓存；OpenAPI导出；以及包含API消费者和受保护端点鉴权的写操作。一个内置模块打包了SKG-IF规定的格式和过滤器，让提供者仅通过配置即可公开合规的端点。通过可重复测试对九种类似工具进行的函数对比表明，只有RAMOSE能在一次API操作中连接任意键上的RDF和非RDF结果。RAMOSE为OpenCitations REST API提供支持，该API在2025年5月至2026年5月期间每月请求量峰值达到近3800万次，并已被GRAPHIA项目采用，用于将其数据源整合到基于SKG-IF的联邦中。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了RAMOSE 2.0，这是一个旨在简化科研数据源REST API构建的开源框架。新版本通过支持跨多数据源查询、插件化架构、写操作及SKG-IF合规模块，显著提升了其处理能力和易用性。
AI.keywords: REST API, SPARQL, RDF, 数据互操作性, 科学知识图谱
AI.comments: RAMOSE填补了将现有数据源快速转化为符合标准（如SKG-IF）的REST API的空白。其最大的创新在于能够跨RDF和非RDF数据源进行查询编排和连接，这在同类工具中表现卓越，且经过了大规模实际应用的验证。

title: HandFlow: Fully Generative 4D Hand Recovery with Flow Matching
summary:
Accurate monocular 4D hand reconstruction remains challenging. Per-frame discriminative regressors lack temporal context and often produce jittery predictions. Temporal models improve consistency by aggregating information across frames, but they are typically deterministic regressors, making them vulnerable to ambiguous observations caused by occlusion and motion blur. Generative modeling offers a natural alternative by learning a prior over plausible hand motion sequences, enabling coherent hand-state recovery when visual evidence is incomplete or unreliable.
  Motivated by this observation, we present HandFlow, a fully generative flow-matching framework for temporally coherent 3D hand pose and shape estimation from monocular video. Given visual and skeletal observations, HandFlow denoises an entire temporal window of MANO parameters through a single ODE integration. To support this, we use a Flux-style dual-stream transformer that attends across the full sequence to capture long-range dependencies without autoregressive decoding, and a confidence-aware continuous masking mechanism that blends observed features with learnable mask tokens to handle noisy or missing observations. Experiments on DexYCB and HOT3D show that HandFlow achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly large gains in world-space accuracy and temporal smoothness. It reduces world-space pose error by over 30% compared with the strongest baseline and achieves the lowest acceleration error among all evaluated methods, while remaining competitive in per-frame pose accuracy. Moreover, on a single GPU HandFlow reconstructs a 150-frame sequence at 47 fps, about 12x faster than the fastest prior video-based method, with reconstruction itself accounting for only a small fraction of the end-to-end latency.

AI.title_translation: HandFlow：基于流匹配的完全生成式4D手部恢复
AI.tldr: HandFlow利用生成式流匹配技术，在保持高精度的同时，实现了比现有方法快12倍的实时、平滑且鲁棒的单目4D手部重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的判别式回归方法缺乏时间上下文导致抖动，而确定性时序模型在面对遮挡和运动模糊等歧义观测时表现脆弱，因此需要一种基于生成式建模的方法来学习手部运动先验。
AI.method: 提出HandFlow框架，采用Flux风格的双流Transformer进行非自回归的ODE积分去噪，并结合置信度感知的连续掩码机制来处理缺失或噪声观测。
AI.result: 在DexYCB和HOT3D数据集上达到SOTA水平，世界坐标系姿态误差降低超过30%，加速误差最低，且推理速度达47 fps（150帧序列），比现有最快方法快约12倍。
AI.conclusion: HandFlow通过生成式流匹配框架实现了高效、平滑且精确的单目4D手部重建，在处理遮挡和运动模糊方面表现优异。
AI.translation: 准确的单目4D手部重建仍然充满挑战。基于逐帧的判别式回归器缺乏时间上下文，往往产生抖动预测。时序模型通过聚合跨帧信息提高了连贯性，但它们通常是确定性回归器，在面对遮挡和运动模糊导致的歧义观测时表现脆弱。生成建模通过学习合理手部运动序列的先验，为在视觉证据不完整或不可靠时恢复连贯的手部状态提供了一种自然的替代方案。基于这一观察，我们提出了HandFlow，一个用于从单目视频中进行时间连贯的3D手部姿态和形状估计的完全生成式流匹配框架。给定视觉和骨架观测，HandFlow通过单次ODE积分对整个MANO参数时间窗口进行去噪。为了支持这一点，我们使用了Flux风格的双流Transformer，它在整个序列上进行注意力计算以捕捉长程依赖，而无需自回归解码；并采用了一种置信度感知的连续掩码机制，将观测特征与可学习的掩码标记融合，以处理噪声或缺失的观测。在DexYCB和HOT3D上的实验表明，HandFlow达到了最先进的性能，特别是在世界坐标系精度和时间平滑度方面有显著提升。与最强基线相比，它将世界坐标系姿态误差降低了30%以上，并在所有评估方法中实现了最低的加速度误差，同时保持了具有竞争力的逐帧姿态精度。此外，HandFlow在单GPU上以47 fps的速度重建150帧序列，比最快的现有视频方法快约12倍，且重建过程仅占端到端延迟的一小部分。
AI.summary: HandFlow是一种基于流匹配的生成式框架，用于从单目视频中重建4D手部姿态与形状。它通过Flux风格的Transformer对整个时间窗口进行去噪，无需自回归解码，并通过置信度感知掩码处理噪声数据，实现了高精度、高平滑度且极速的重建。
AI.keywords: 4D手部重建, 生成式模型, 流匹配, 时间一致性, 双流Transformer
AI.comments: 该研究通过生成式流匹配框架解决4D手部重建问题，创新点在于利用Flux风格的双流Transformer进行非自回归的ODE积分去噪。其优势在于将生成建模引入手部运动序列恢复，在提升重建精度的同时显著改善了时间平滑度，且推理速度极快，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Heterogeneous Agent Cohorts for Safe Open-Ended Exploration with Runtime Constraint Memory
summary: LLM agents today are caught in an awkward bind. Lock them down with static safety instructions and they rarely venture beyond the obvious; give them free reign with tools and multi-agent debate, and safety violations quickly follow. Rather than forcing a single model to juggle both creativity and caution, we separate the concerns across specialized roles. A Disrupter generates unconventional proposals, a Validator enforces hard runtime checks at the tool gateway, and a Broker pulls in distant but relevant analogies. Failures are not discarded -- they are compiled, via MCTS, into compact, signed constraint patches we call Scars. These patches are cached locally and inherited by future cohorts, turning repeated failures into reusable, low-cost runtime constraints. In a spatial-semantic sandbox (N=20 runs, p<0.01), our cohort reaches remote targets where debate fails, the Validator prevents all executed breaches, and Scars reduce token consumption by 15.1% by avoiding redundant validator checks. Furthermore, credit-based Communication Allocation Scores (CAS) restrict outbound bandwidth, reducing overall token costs by 55.9% under resource constraints.

AI.title_translation: 基于运行时约束记忆的异构代理群：用于安全的开放式探索
AI.tldr: 通过引入分工协作的异构代理团队和名为“Scars”的失败经验累积机制，实现了LLM代理在保持安全性的同时，更高效地进行开放式探索并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理在安全与创造性探索之间难以平衡：过于严苛的限制导致探索能力不足，而过于开放的权限则容易引发安全违规。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含Disrupter（负责探索）、Validator（负责安全检查）和Broker（负责类比）的异构代理架构。引入“Scars”机制，利用MCTS将失败经验编译为紧凑的约束补丁进行缓存与复用；同时采用信用分配得分（CAS）来限制通信带宽。
AI.result: 在空间语义沙箱实验中，该方法成功到达了传统辩论机制无法触及的目标，Validator实现了零安全违规，Scars机制减少了15.1%的冗余令牌消耗，CAS机制在资源受限下进一步降低了55.9%的总体令牌成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色分工、Scars约束补丁机制以及CAS带宽限制，该方法在保证安全性的前提下，显著提升了LLM代理在开放环境中的探索效率与资源利用率。
AI.translation: 当今的LLM代理陷入了一种尴尬的境地。如果用静态安全指令锁定它们，它们很少能超越常规；如果给予它们工具和多代理辩论的自由，安全违规就会迅速出现。与其强迫单一模型同时兼顾创造力和谨慎，我们根据专业角色对这些关注点进行了分离。Disrupter（破坏者）生成非常规建议，Validator（验证者）在工具网关处执行严格的运行时检查，Broker（经纪人）引入遥远但相关的类比。失败不会被丢弃——它们通过MCTS被编译成紧凑的、签名的约束补丁，我们称之为Scars（疤痕）。这些补丁被本地缓存并由未来的代理群继承，将重复的失败转化为可重用的、低成本的运行时约束。在空间语义沙箱实验中（N=20次运行，p<0.01），我们的代理群到达了辩论机制无法触及的远程目标，Validator防止了所有执行的违规行为，Scars通过避免冗余的验证器检查减少了15.1%的令牌消耗。此外，基于信用的通信分配得分（CAS）限制了出站带宽，在资源约束下将总令牌成本降低了55.9%。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种用于安全开放式探索的异构代理架构。通过将探索与安全职责分配给不同角色的代理，并利用“Scars”机制存储和传承失败经验以实现运行时约束，该系统在保障安全性的同时，显著提升了探索效率并降低了令牌消耗。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型代理, 开放式探索, 安全约束, 蒙特卡洛树搜索, 资源优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的分层代理架构，通过将创造性探索与安全性检查解耦，并利用“Scars”机制实现失败经验的累积与传承，有效地解决了大语言模型代理在开放式探索中“安全性”与“探索性”难以兼得的矛盾。其最大的亮点在于将失败转化为可重用的约束补丁，不仅提升了系统安全性，还显著优化了计算成本，为代理系统的长期自主进化提供了新思路。

title: DeepBias: Adaptive In-depth Probing of Social Biases in LVLMs
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities, they remain highly susceptible to embedded social biases. Existing bias evaluation protocols predominantly rely on static datasets, which provide only a superficial assessment, as their fixed test cases cannot adaptively evolve to measure the true depth and limits of model vulnerabilities. We introduce DeepBias, an adaptive framework for the in-depth probing of social biases in LVLMs with carefully designed agents. Our approach operates through a dynamic ''generation-evolution-probing'' loop. First, a generative ProposerAgent synthesizes test data and is iteratively updated via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) based on the target LVLM's responses, exploring model-specific failure modes. Second, an autonomous skill-driven DiggerAgent rewrites each test data across multiple probing turns, adaptively selecting from a curated skill library of deepening and rewriting strategies. At each turn, this process is conditioned on the model's previous response, enabling progressively deeper biases to be exposed. Furthermore, we build a benchmark named DeepBiasBench using our framework. By employing an ensemble of five diverse state-of-the-art LVLMs as anchors, the benchmark captures vulnerabilities shared across architectures. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework and show that DeepBias provides a challenging benchmark for in-depth bias evaluation, establishing an evolutionary paradigm for LVLM safety assessment.

AI.title_translation: DeepBias：针对LVLM社会偏见的自适应深度探测
AI.tldr: DeepBias通过动态的“生成-进化-探测”机制，自适应地挖掘LVLM中的深层社会偏见，解决了静态数据集评估不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LVLM社会偏见评估主要依赖静态数据集，无法自适应地探测模型漏洞的深度和极限，导致评估结果流于表面。
AI.method: 提出DeepBias框架，包含“生成-进化-探测”循环：1. ProposerAgent通过DPO基于模型响应迭代合成测试数据；2. DiggerAgent根据预设策略库动态重写测试数据，实现多轮深度探测；3. 构建DeepBiasBench基准，利用多个SOTA LVLM作为锚点评估跨架构漏洞。
AI.result: 实验证明DeepBias框架能有效发现LVLM的深层偏见，构建的DeepBiasBench为评估LVLM安全性提供了一个更具挑战性的基准。
AI.conclusion: DeepBias框架通过自适应的探测手段，能够有效地揭示LVLM中深层次的社会偏见，建立了一个具有挑战性的评估基准，为模型安全性评估提供了新的演进路径。
AI.translation: 尽管大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）展现出了卓越的能力，但它们仍极易受到嵌入式社会偏见的影响。现有的偏见评估协议主要依赖于静态数据集，由于其固定的测试用例无法自适应地演化以测量模型漏洞的真实深度和极限，因此仅能提供表面的评估。我们引入了DeepBias，这是一个通过精心设计的智能体对LVLM进行社会偏见深度探测的自适应框架。我们的方法通过动态的“生成-进化-探测”循环运行。首先，生成式的ProposerAgent合成测试数据，并根据目标LVLM的响应通过直接偏好优化（DPO）进行迭代更新，以探索模型特定的失败模式。其次，自主的技能驱动型DiggerAgent在多轮探测中重写每个测试数据，从精心策划的加深和重写策略库中自适应地进行选择。每一轮的过程都以模型先前的响应为条件，从而能够揭示出越来越深的偏见。此外，我们利用该框架构建了一个名为DeepBiasBench的基准。通过采用五个不同的最先进LVLM作为锚点，该基准捕捉了跨架构的共性漏洞。综合实验证明了我们框架的有效性，并表明DeepBias为深入的偏见评估提供了一个具有挑战性的基准，建立了一种LVLM安全评估的演进范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DeepBias，这是一个用于深入探测LVLM社会偏见的自适应框架。该框架通过一个包含ProposerAgent（合成数据）和DiggerAgent（多轮深度重写）的动态循环，能够针对特定模型定制测试用例。此外，作者还构建了DeepBiasBench基准，通过多模型协同评估，有效揭示了跨架构的偏见漏洞。
AI.keywords: 大型视觉-语言模型 (LVLMs), 社会偏见, 自适应探测, 评估框架, 安全性评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种动态、自适应的偏见探测框架，改变了以往依赖静态数据集进行评估的局限性。通过引入“生成-进化-探测”循环，该方法能够针对特定模型定制探测策略，从而更深入地挖掘模型的潜在漏洞。这种方法为LVLM的安全评估提供了一个演进式的新范式，具有很高的研究价值。

title: Improved Algorithms for Local Failover Routing on Directed Graphs
summary: The local failover routing is a mechanism that routes a packet from a source to a destination only using pre-calculated routing tables, even when several edges fail. In this paper, we study local failover schemes that minimize the number of rewritable bits in the packet header on directed graphs with $k$-arc failures. There are many studies of failover routing on undirected graphs, and it has been investigated whether routing is possible depending on the number of bits in the packet header, the type of failure, the graph properties, etc. In contrast, there is not much research on directed graphs. Van et al.~first showed the upper and lower bounds of rewritable bits in the packet header on directed graphs. However, their results showed a large gap between the upper and lower bounds. The main contribution of this paper is to close the gap between the upper and lower bounds. Specifically, we show that our scheme can route packets with $k$ faulty arcs if the packet header has $\min(k \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{k}, 2n \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{2n})))$ rewritable bits, where $n$ is the number of nodes. Moreover, any local failover routing scheme needs $Ω(k\lceil\log\frac{n}{k}\rceil)$ rewritable bits when the number of faulty arcs is equal to or less than $\frac{3(n-1)}{8}$ and $\frac{n-1}{4}$ rewritable bits when the number of faulty arc is more than $\frac{3(n-1)}{8}$. This result means our scheme is nearly optimal when the number of faulty arcs is approximately less than the number of nodes.

AI.title_translation: 有向图局部故障转移路由的改进算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的有向图局部故障转移路由算法，成功缩小了数据包头部重写位数的上下界差距，实现了在k-弧故障下的近最优路由。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究主要集中在无向图上，针对有向图的研究较少且Van等人给出的上下界之间存在巨大差距，因此需要改进算法以缩小该差距。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的局部故障转移路由算法，该算法通过优化数据包头部重写位数来适应k-弧故障，并从理论上推导了该方案所需的位数上限，同时给出了相应的下界证明。
AI.result: 证明了在k-弧故障下，当头部具有 $\min(k \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{k}, 2n \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{2n})))$ 位时即可实现路由，并给出了相应的下界，证明了该方案在故障数小于节点数时接近最优。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过设计一种新的局部故障转移路由方案，成功闭合了有向图在k-弧故障下所需头部重写位数的上下界差距，证明了该方案在故障数较少时接近最优。
AI.translation: 局部故障转移路由是一种在部分边发生故障时，仅使用预计算路由表将数据包从源路由到目的地的机制。本文研究了在具有k-弧故障的有向图上，最小化数据包头部可重写位数的局部故障转移方案。已有许多关于无向图故障转移路由的研究，探讨了路由可行性与头部位数、故障类型及图属性等因素的关系。相比之下，关于有向图的研究较少。Van等人首次展示了有向图数据包头部可重写位数的上限和下限，但结果显示上下界之间存在巨大差距。本文的主要贡献是缩小了这一差距。具体而言，我们证明了如果数据包头部具有 $\min(k \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{k}, 2n \log ( \frac{e(2n+k-3)}{2n})))$ 个可重写位（其中n为节点数），我们的方案可以在k条弧故障下路由数据包。此外，我们证明了当故障弧数小于或等于3(n-1)/8时，任何局部故障转移路由方案都需要 Ω(k⌈log(n/k)⌉) 个可重写位；当故障弧数超过3(n-1)/8时，则需要 (n-1)/4 个可重写位。这一结果意味着当故障弧数近似小于节点数时，我们的方案接近最优。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有向图中的局部故障转移路由问题，旨在最小化数据包头部在k-弧故障下所需的重写位数。通过改进算法，作者成功缩小了现有研究中上下界之间的差距，并证明了其方案在故障数较少时几乎达到最优。
AI.keywords: 局部故障转移路由, 有向图, 路由表, k-弧故障, 头部重写位数
AI.comments: 该论文在有向图局部故障转移路由领域取得了重要进展，通过改进算法显著缩小了数据包头部可重写位数的上下界差距，为网络鲁棒性设计提供了理论支持。其主要贡献在于理论上的紧致性，但对于实际网络协议中的实现复杂度未做深入探讨。

title: Courcelle's Theorem in Truly Linear FPT
summary:
Recently, Bumpus, Downey, Eagling-Vose, Enright, Fellows, Kutner, Larios-Jones, Martin, Rosamond, and Yates defined Truly Linear FPT (TLFPT) to be the class of parameterized problems with algorithms running in time $O(n) + f(k)$, where $n$ is the input size and $k$ the parameter [arXiv:2606.02492]. They gave several algorithmic techniques for designing TLFPT algorithms, but left parameterization by treewidth open.
  In this paper, we give a general method for designing TLFPT algorithms parameterized by treewidth, solving three open problems posed by Bumpus et al. In particular, we give a TLFPT algorithm for Courcelle's theorem: We show that given an $n$-vertex $m$-edge graph $G$, an integer $k$, and a $\mathsf{CMSO}_2$-formula $\varphi$, we can in time $O(n+m) + f(k, \varphi)$ either conclude that the treewidth of $G$ is more than $k$, or check whether $G$ satisfies $\varphi$. As a part of our algorithm, we give an approximation algorithm for treewidth that runs in time $O(n+m)$ and returns a tree decomposition whose width is at most $2^{O(k)}$ times the optimum. Our result also implies a TLFPT algorithm for computing the value of treewidth exactly.

AI.tldr: 本文将Courcelle定理引入Truly Linear FPT框架，实现了在O(n+m) + f(k, φ)时间内判定图的CMSO2属性，并提供了线性时间的树宽近似算法。
AI.motivation: Bumpus等人在提出Truly Linear FPT（TLFPT）框架后，将树宽参数化问题留作开放问题。本文旨在解决这一问题，即寻求针对树宽参数化的TLFPT算法，并解决Bumpus等人提出的三个公开问题。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种通用的TLFPT算法设计方法，核心包括：1. 一个运行时间为O(n+m)的树宽近似算法，能返回宽度为2^{O(k)}的最优树分解；2. 基于该近似分解，利用动态规划技术处理CMSO2公式判定。
AI.result: 成功设计出针对Courcelle定理的TLFPT算法，时间复杂度为O(n+m) + f(k, φ)；同时提供了一个O(n+m)时间的树宽近似算法，并能够精确计算树宽。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明了对于任何CMSO2公式，可以在O(n+m) + f(k, φ)的时间内判定图是否满足该公式，同时实现了一个线性时间内的树宽近似算法，成功将Courcelle定理纳入Truly Linear FPT框架。
AI.translation: 最近，Bumpus, Downey, Eagling-Vose, Enright, Fellows, Kutner, Larios-Jones, Martin, Rosamond和Yates将Truly Linear FPT (TLFPT)定义为参数化问题的一类，其算法运行时间为O(n) + f(k)，其中n是输入规模，k是参数。他们给出了一些设计TLFPT算法的算法技术，但将树宽参数化的问题留作开放。在本文中，我们给出了一种设计树宽参数化TLFPT算法的通用方法，解决了Bumpus等人提出的三个公开问题。特别地，我们给出了Courcelle定理的TLFPT算法：我们证明了给定一个n顶点m边的图G，一个整数k，以及一个CMSO2公式φ，我们可以在O(n+m) + f(k, φ)时间内判断G的树宽是否超过k，或者检查G是否满足φ。作为我们算法的一部分，我们给出了一个运行时间为O(n+m)的树宽近似算法，并返回了一个宽度至多为2^{O(k)}倍最优值的树分解。我们的结果也暗示了一个精确计算树宽的TLFPT算法。
AI.summary: 本文针对Truly Linear FPT（TLFPT）框架下树宽参数化算法的空白，提出了一种通用方法。作者不仅解决了Bumpus等人提出的三个公开问题，还证明了Courcelle定理可以在O(n+m) + f(k, φ)时间内求解，并提供了一种高效的线性时间树宽近似算法。
AI.keywords: Truly Linear FPT, Courcelle's Theorem, Treewidth, CMSO2-formula, Linear Time Algorithm
AI.comments: 该论文成功解决了TLFPT领域中关于树宽参数化的重要公开问题，通过改进Courcelle定理的算法复杂度，将其提升至线性时间复杂度加上仅依赖参数的函数项，具有很高的理论价值。其核心贡献在于将树宽近似算法与逻辑公式判定算法结合，突破了传统FPT算法的限制。

title: SAIL: Perceptual Quality-Aware Rate Control for Cloud Gaming
summary:
Cloud gaming streams cloud-rendered frames under strict motion-to-photon latency, yet its at-scale viability is increasingly constrained by bandwidth cost: in our study of the T cloud gaming platform, bandwidth accounts for 30-60% of total operating expense. This high bandwidth consumption stems from a fidelity-first objective of making the stream perceptually indistinguishable from local gameplay. It drives production systems toward best-effort bitrate allocation that pushes the encoder to the highest rate allowed by congestion control. However, the bitrate-perception relationship saturates: beyond a frame-dependent perceptually lossless threshold, additional bits yield negligible perceptual improvement, creating systematic redundant quality that wastes bandwidth.
  We present SAIL, a production quality-aware rate control system with the goal of achieving perceptually lossless quality while avoiding unnecessary bandwidth waste. SAIL adopts a post-encoding architecture to enable millisecond-scale feedback at near-zero overhead. It comprises three key designs: (i) an encoder-driven quality assessment model that leverages zero-cost encoder outputs for real-time quality estimation; (ii) a hybrid rate control mechanism that balances steady-state adaptation with dynamic spike absorption; and (iii) a network-aware strategy that coordinates with congestion control to prevent capacity underestimation. SAIL has been fully deployed on the T cloud gaming platform and reduces bandwidth consumption by 44.27% and end-to-end latency by 8.37% without degrading perceived quality, serving tens of millions of users and accumulating billions of hours of total gameplay.

AI.title_translation: SAIL：面向云游戏的感知质量感知速率控制
AI.tldr: SAIL通过精确识别云游戏的感知质量饱和点，在维持用户体验的同时，将带宽占用减少了近45%。
AI.motivation: 云游戏面临高昂的带宽成本压力，现有的“保真度优先”策略导致在感知质量饱和后仍盲目增加比特率，造成了严重的带宽浪费。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为SAIL的生产级质量感知速率控制系统，包含三个核心设计：利用编码器输出进行实时质量评估的质量评估模型、平衡稳态适应与峰值处理的混合速率控制机制，以及与拥塞控制协作的网络感知策略。
AI.result: 在T云游戏平台部署后，SAIL在不降低感知质量的前提下，将带宽消耗降低了44.27%，并将端到端延迟降低了8.37%。
AI.conclusion: SAIL通过感知质量感知速率控制，在保持感知无损的前提下，显著降低了云游戏的带宽消耗并改善了延迟，证明了在生产环境中平衡质量与成本的可行性。
AI.translation: 云游戏在严格的运动到光子（motion-to-photon）延迟限制下流式传输云端渲染帧，但其规模化可行性日益受到带宽成本的制约：在我们对T云游戏平台的研究中，带宽占总运营成本的30-60%。这种高带宽消耗源于“保真度优先”的目标，即力求使流媒体在感知上与本地游戏无法区分。这推动生产系统采用尽力而为的比特率分配，将编码器推向拥塞控制允许的最高速率。然而，比特率与感知之间的关系会饱和：超过帧相关的感知无损阈值后，额外的比特只会带来微不足道的感知提升，从而产生系统性的冗余质量，浪费带宽。我们提出了SAIL，一个生产级的质量感知速率控制系统，目标是在实现感知无损质量的同时避免不必要的带宽浪费。SAIL采用后编码架构，以实现近零开销的毫秒级反馈。它包含三个关键设计：(i) 一个利用零成本编码器输出进行实时质量估计的编码器驱动质量评估模型；(ii) 一个平衡稳态适应与动态突发吸收的混合速率控制机制；以及 (iii) 一个与拥塞控制协调以防止容量低估的网络感知策略。SAIL已在T云游戏平台全面部署，在不降低感知质量的情况下，将带宽消耗降低了44.27%，端到端延迟降低了8.37%，服务于数千万用户，并积累了数十亿小时的总游戏时长。
AI.summary: SAIL是一款旨在优化云游戏带宽效率的速率控制系统。它通过识别感知质量的饱和阈值，利用编码器零成本输出进行实时评估，并在保持感知无损的情况下，通过混合速率控制和网络协同策略，显著减少了冗余比特率。
AI.keywords: 云游戏, 速率控制, 感知质量, 带宽优化, 延迟优化
AI.comments: SAIL通过识别比特率与感知质量之间的饱和阈值，成功解决了云游戏领域长期存在的带宽浪费问题。其创新之处在于利用编码器输出进行低开销的质量评估，并已在超大规模平台成功部署，具有极高的实际应用价值。

title: Structure-Detail Decoupled Autoregressive Generation for Fast and High-Fidelity Virtual Try-On
summary: Virtual try-on (VTON) is a bi-conditional image generation problem that requires not only accurate person preservation but also faithful garment deformation and detail synthesis. Diffusion-based VTON methods can jointly model these factors in a compressed latent space, but suffer from high-frequency detail loss due to inherent latent compression, even with costly multi-step denoising. Recent visual autoregressive (VAR) models offer a promising alternative for high-quality generation with faster inference, yet remain unexplored for VTON due to the lack of effective bi-conditioning mechanisms. To bridge this gap, we first introduce VAR-VTON, a VAR-based VTON model that incorporates garment conditioning and structural guidance for efficient latent-space VTON. Despite its efficacy, latent-space generation still struggles to preserve fine-grained garment details. We argue that different VTON sub-tasks should be addressed in different representation spaces: structural synthesis such as garment warping and person layout is suited to the latent space, whereas fine-grained detail recovery should be tackled in the pixel space. Motivated by this insight, we further propose STAR-VTON, a Two-Stage AutoRegressive framework that builds upon VAR-VTON by decoupling latent-space structural synthesis from pixel-space detail recovery. Our idea is to resort to a matching-informed refiner to establish dense correspondences between the stage-one generation and the source garment to directly map fine-grained pixel-space details. Extensive experiments show that STAR-VTON achieves an impressive efficiency-fidelity trade-off: VAR-VTON runs at least $4\times$ faster than diffusion-based counterparts without degrading quality, and the pixel-space refiner effectively restores fine details and acts as a plug-and-play module that can benefit existing VTON approaches.

title: From PBS to ePBS: the Microstructure of Block Building
summary:
Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade introduces enshrined proposer-builder separation (ePBS), replacing relay-centric PBS with direct builder bids to proposers. We study how this shift changes the block-building microstructure through a general imperfect-information two-stage auction with verifiable messages, where an early bid serves as both a price offer and a signal. PBS and ePBS are modeled as restrictions of the same block-building game: PBS fixes stopping and disclosure exogenously, while ePBS lets the proposer choose stopping and disclosure ex post. Latency heterogeneity is captured by asymmetric information updates: fast builders observe disclosed early information before rebidding, while slow builders do not. We combine exact perfect Bayesian equilibrium characterizations in tractable cases with calibrated no-regret learning in finite games. For PBS, we show that separating equilibria preserve the standard first-price-auction payoff benchmark and provide conditions for their existence. For ePBS, we demonstrate a ratchet effect: because the proposer can defer block proposal and use early bid information in the second stage, builders anticipate ex-post extraction and shade or pool early bids, generating allocation inefficiency and revenue-efficiency valleys.
  We interpret this ratchet distortion as a commitment failure. Under full commitment, the optimal policy collapses to the static Myerson auction and removes the ratchet channel. To realize part of this commitment advantage in a feasible mechanism, we propose a Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) sidecar that enforces limited commitment. We formulate the revenue-maximizing TEE mechanism as a bilinear optimization problem. In conservative finite benchmarks, the TEE design increases the proposer revenue relative to the first-price benchmark by approximately \(25\%\).

AI.title_translation: 从PBS到ePBS：区块构建的微观结构
AI.tldr: ePBS机制中的提议者灵活性引发了棘轮效应，导致构建者策略性压价；引入TEE机制可缓解这一承诺缺失问题，提升网络收益。
AI.motivation: 探讨以太坊从传统的Relay中心化PBS向ePBS（内嵌式提议者-构建者分离）转型过程中，其区块构建微观结构的改变以及由此产生的经济激励与效率影响。
AI.method: 构建了一个非完全信息两阶段博弈模型，结合完美贝叶斯均衡（PBE）分析与有限博弈中的无悔学习（no-regret learning）算法。
AI.result: 研究发现ePBS中存在棘轮效应，导致竞价池化与分配效率低下；通过设计基于TEE的有限承诺机制，可使提议者收益比第一价格拍卖基准提升约25%。
AI.conclusion: ePBS机制通过赋予提议者更大的灵活性（延迟决策与信息披露）引入了棘轮效应，导致效率降低。引入TEE实现有限承诺可以有效缓解这一问题，显著提升提议者收益。
AI.translation: 以太坊的Glamsterdam升级引入了内嵌式提议者-构建者分离（ePBS），将基于中继的PBS替换为构建者直接向提议者报价。我们通过一个带有可验证信息的通用非完全信息两阶段拍卖模型，研究了这一转变如何改变区块构建的微观结构，其中早期竞价既作为价格要约，也作为信号。PBS和ePBS被建模为同一区块构建博弈的限制情况：PBS外生地固定了停止和披露规则，而ePBS允许提议者在事后选择停止和披露。延迟异质性通过非对称信息更新来捕获：快速构建者在重新竞价前观察到披露的早期信息，而慢速构建者则不能。我们将可处理情况下的精确完美贝叶斯均衡刻画与有限博弈中的校准无悔学习相结合。对于PBS，我们证明了分离均衡保持了标准第一价格拍卖的收益基准，并给出了其存在的条件。对于ePBS，我们证明了一种棘轮效应：由于提议者可以推迟区块提议并在第二阶段利用早期竞价信息，构建者预见到事后提取并会压低或池化早期竞价，从而产生分配无效率和收益效率低谷。我们解释这种棘轮扭曲为承诺失败。在完全承诺下，最优策略坍缩为静态Myerson拍卖，并消除了棘轮通道。为了在可行机制中实现部分这种承诺优势，我们提出了一个强制执行有限承诺的可信执行环境（TEE）辅助模块。我们将收益最大化的TEE机制表述为一个双线性优化问题。在保守的有限基准测试中，TEE设计使提议者收益相对于第一价格基准增加了约25%。
AI.summary: 本文分析了以太坊ePBS升级对区块构建微观结构的影响。研究表明，ePBS赋予提议者后验决策权会导致棘轮效应，使构建者倾向于压低早期竞价。作者提出引入TEE机制来强制执行有限承诺，从而在缓解效率损失的同时提升提议者收益。
AI.keywords: 以太坊, ePBS, 区块构建, 棘轮效应, TEE
AI.comments: 该论文通过博弈论模型揭示了ePBS机制中存在的“棘轮效应”，即提议者利用早期竞价信息进行后续剥削，导致构建者策略性压低出价，从而引发效率损失。这是对以太坊升级机制设计中微观激励结构的重要理论贡献。

title: Bounded-Support Additive Latin Transversals via Color-Counted Matching
summary: We consider the following additive Latin transversal problem. Given a multiset $A=(a_1,\dots,a_k)$ of elements of $\mathbb Z_m$ and a set $B\subseteq\mathbb Z_m$ of cardinality $k$, the task is to order $B$ as $b_1,\dots,b_k$ so that the sums $a_i+b_i$ are pairwise distinct. When $k=m$, Hall proved that a solution exists if and only if $\sum_{i=1}^m a_i\equiv 0 \pmod m$; moreover, his theorem yields a polynomial-time construction. Alon proved that a solution always exists when $m$ is prime and $k<m$, but no polynomial-time construction is known in general. Our main algorithmic contribution is a direct randomized algorithm for Color-Counted Matching: given an edge-colored graph and prescribed target counts for the colors, find a matching using exactly the prescribed number of edges of each color. If $q$ is the sum of the target counts and $h$ is the number of colors, our base-$(q+1)$ reduction to Exact Red Matching, combined with the algorithm of Mulmuley-Vazirani-Vazirani, gives a randomized algorithm with running time $\left(|V|^2+|E|(q+1)^{h-1}\right)^{O(1)} $ for an input graph $(V,E)$. Thus the dependence on the target matching size is $q^{O(h)}$, up to polynomial factors in the graph size. In contrast, applying the general matching-ILP theorem of Lassota and Ligthart as a black box yields a $q^{O(h^2)}$ dependence for the corresponding fixed-size color-counted instances. Applying this primitive to additive Latin transversals with $s=|\operatorname{supp}(A)|$, we obtain an algorithm in randomized time $(k+\log m)^{O(s)}$. In particular, additive Latin transversals are randomized polynomial-time constructible for every fixed support size.

title: Multiple Vehicles and Traction Network Interaction System Stability Analysis and Oscillation Responsibility Identification
summary: The electrical incompatibility between vehicles and traction network in railway system can result in system instability and oscillation overvoltage issues. To analyze the system stability, impedance-based frequency-domain methods are commonly used. However, the current impedance-based modeling methods face challenges in practical implementation due to the requirement of precise analytical models and detailed internal parameters for all vehicles. Moreover, multiple vehicles operate simultaneously in railway systems, each with different operating conditions and internal parameters, thereby influencing system stability to different extents. Therefore, it is crucial to accurately identify the critical vehicles to prevent resonance accidents. To address these challenges, a component connection-based modeling approach for the railway vehicle-grid system is proposed, which only requires the measured impedance results without the internal information of vehicles. In addition, a multilevel sensitivity analysis method is introduced to quantitatively identify the critical vehicles and internal parameters that influence system stability, which outperforms traditional sensitivity analysis methods in computational complexity. Furthermore, a system-level electrical compatibility test process for the railway vehicle-grid system is provided, incorporating the proposed stability and sensitivity analysis methods. Finally, case studies based on the real-world train schedule of a multivehicle-accessed railway vehicle-grid system are designed to verify the correctness of the proposed method.

title: An Empirical Study for GUI Test Migration from Android to OpenHarmony System
summary: To reduce the substantial engineering effort required to test the corresponding applications from Android to OpenHarmony, migrating existing GUI test cases has become a critical problem. However, current research neither proposes solutions tailored for OpenHarmony nor provides a systematic evaluation of migration approaches on this system, leaving developers with limited empirical guidance in practice. In this paper, we present the first systematic empirical study of test migration from Android to OpenHarmony. Specifically, we first construct a dataset referred to as the ATH Benchmark, comprising 36 commercial applications with an average of over 9 billion downloads, along with 108 manually designed test cases. Second, we select two state-of-the-art test migration approaches (i.e., ReSPlay and ITeM) and adapt these two approaches to enable their execution on OpenHarmony. Third, we use the preceding infrastructure to evaluate these two approaches from three perspectives, including testing performance, root causes of failures, and the impact of OpenHarmony characteristics. Our results reveal that existing test migration approaches are less effective (15% success-rate on ReSPlay and 26% success-rate on ITeM) in Android-to-OpenHarmony scenarios. Through an in-depth analysis of failed cases, we identify that test performance is primarily hindered by OpenHarmony-specific characteristics, including technical architecture differences and unique ecosystem traits. Utilizing these findings, we propose an enhanced approach based on ITeM, referred as ITeM-HM, which incorporates specific OpenHarmony system features. As a result, ITeM-HM successfully achieves a 214% success-rate relative improvement over the original ITeM (from 26% to 81%).

title: Multi-Agent LLMs Fail to Explore Each Other
summary: Exploration is essential for reliable autonomy in multi-agent systems, yet it remains unclear whether large language model (LLM) agents can explore effectively when interacting with one another. We show that modern LLM agents fail to do so, often exhibiting myopic and polarized interaction patterns that lead to suboptimal coordination and increased regret. We formalize this challenge as the Multi-Agent Exploration problem, modeling it as a partially observable stochastic game (POSG) problem in which agents must probe peers to infer their capabilities and identify effective interaction strategies. To address this, we introduce Multi- Agent Contextual Exploration (MACE), a lightweight framework that explicitly promotes exploration through structured peer selection. Across both contextual and parametric diversity settings, MACE substantially improves exploration behavior and downstream task performance. We further show theoretically that the value of exploration increases with agent diversity. Overall, our results highlight a fundamental limitation of current LLM agents and underscore the importance of explicitly guided exploration for reliable multi-agent autonomy. Code will be released in https://github.com/deeplearning-wisc/mace

title: Hidden or Formal Architects: Understanding Who Makes Architectural Decisions in Practice
comments: Accepted at 52nd Euromicro Conference on Software Engineering and Advanced Applications (SEAA) 2026
summary: Empirical research on software architecture sometimes focuses on individuals holding the formal title of software architect. However, not all companies have individuals hired in such roles. Despite no formal architects, all systems have architectures, and there must be practitioners making the architectural decisions. This study aims to identify who, in practice, makes architectural decisions and in what environments the existence of a formal architect is perceived as necessary. This research employed a method consisting of a questionnaire with 54 participants from different companies and seven follow-up interviews. The findings indicate that architectural decisions are often made by individuals without a formal architect title. A formal architect is perceived as essential mainly in large companies and large teams. The results of this study show that many practitioners taking part in ADM may have been omitted by previous research, particularly if it focused on formal architects.
comment: Accepted at 52nd Euromicro Conference on Software Engineering and Advanced Applications (SEAA) 2026

title: A Nearable Soft Mat Based on Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing for Physiological Monitoring
summary: Distributed optical fiber sensing (DOFS) combines the advantages of fiber optic sensors, including flexibility, small size, immunity to electromagnetic interference, and high metrological performance, with the capability to transform a single optical fiber into a continuous sensing element for spatially resolved mechanical measurements. Optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR), based on Rayleigh backscattering, enables high spatial resolution DOFS measurements, broadening the range of potential sensing applications. However, OFDR based DOFS remains largely unexplored for biomedical applications, despite the need for sensitive, spatially resolved, and conformable sensing interfaces. This study presents a soft DOFS based mat as a large-area interface for physiological monitoring. A single-mode optical fiber was embedded in a flexible silicone matrix and arranged in a serpentine layout to distribute sensing over the mat surface. With a gage pitch of 2.6 mm, the system provided 2250 sensing sites across the active area at a sampling frequency of 50 Hz. The mat was assessed on six healthy volunteers in a seated nearable configuration on the backrest of a standard office chair. The distributed output enabled two dimensional mapping of the mat response, reflecting back mat mechanical coupling and cardiorespiratory induced perturbations. Respiratory rate and heart rate were therefore estimated and compared with a reference wearable system. The maps revealed physiologically coherent spatial and temporal patterns, while the estimated rates showed good agreement with the reference measurements. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining large area distributed sensing, spatial mapping, and quantitative cardiorespiratory monitoring within a DOFS based soft nearable interface.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于分布式光纤传感的用于生理监测的柔性软垫
AI.tldr: 研究提出了一种基于分布式光纤传感的柔性软垫，通过在硅胶中嵌入蛇形光纤，实现了大面积、高分辨率的非接触式心肺生理信号监测。
AI.motivation: 分布式光纤传感（DOFS）具有高灵敏度、柔性和抗电磁干扰等优势，但目前在生物医学领域的应用研究尚显不足，缺乏适用于生理监测的柔性、空间分辨传感界面。
AI.method: 将单模光纤以蛇形布局嵌入柔性硅胶基质中，利用基于瑞利背向散射的光频域反射仪（OFDR）技术，实现大面积空间分辨的机械测量，并通过信号处理提取呼吸率和心率。
AI.result: 该系统在2.6 mm的间距下提供了2250个传感点，采样率为50 Hz。在六名健康志愿者测试中，该系统能够生成生理信号的二维映射图，且提取的心率和呼吸率与参考设备高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功验证了基于分布式光纤传感的柔性软垫在生理监测中的可行性，能够有效实现心率和呼吸率的非接触式监测与空间分布映射。
AI.translation: 分布式光纤传感（DOFS）结合了光纤传感器的优势，包括灵活性、体积小、抗电磁干扰和高性能，并将单根光纤转化为用于空间分辨机械测量的连续传感元件。基于瑞利背向散射的光频域反射仪（OFDR）实现了高空间分辨率的DOFS测量，拓宽了其应用范围。然而，尽管需要灵敏、空间分辨和贴合的传感界面，OFDR在生物医学应用中仍未得到充分探索。本研究提出了一种基于DOFS的软垫作为生理监测的大面积接口。一根单模光纤被嵌入柔性硅胶基质中，并以蛇形布局排列，以将传感分布在垫子表面。在2.6 mm的间距下，该系统在活动区域内提供了2250个传感点，采样频率为50 Hz。该垫在六名健康志愿者身上进行了测试，配置在标准办公椅靠背上进行非接触式监测。分布式输出实现了垫子响应的二维映射，反映了垫子的机械耦合和心肺引起的扰动。因此，估计了呼吸率和心率，并与参考可穿戴系统进行了比较。映射图揭示了生理上连贯的空间和时间模式，而估计的速率与参考测量结果显示出良好的一致性。这些结果证明了将大面积分布式传感、空间映射和定量心肺监测结合在基于DOFS的柔性非接触式接口中的可行性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种基于分布式光纤传感（DOFS）的柔性软垫，用于生理监测。通过将光纤以蛇形布局嵌入硅胶基质，该系统实现了大面积的高分辨率机械传感，能够通过二维映射有效监测并提取心率和呼吸率，为非接触式生理健康监测提供了一种新颖的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 分布式光纤传感, 生理监测, 光频域反射仪, 柔性传感, 心肺监测
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将分布式光纤传感（DOFS）技术应用于生理监测领域，利用柔性硅胶基质和蛇形光纤布局，实现了大面积、高空间分辨率的非接触式生命体征监测。其优势在于无需接触皮肤即可获取生理信号，且具备抗电磁干扰等光纤传感特有的优点。局限性在于目前仅在受控环境下的健康志愿者中进行了初步验证，未来需进一步研究其在不同体型、姿态及长期监测下的鲁棒性。

title: LaGuadia: Language-Guided Adaptive Distillation from Pathology Foundation Models
summary: Pathology Foundation Models (PFMs) offer powerful Whole Slide Image (WSI) representations but suffer from massive computational costs. While Knowledge Distillation (KD) can create efficient student models, existing multi-teacher methods often use suboptimal uniform weighting that ignores tissue heterogeneity. We propose LaGuadia (Language-Guided Adaptive DistillAtion), a framework that develops a compact pathology image encoder by dynamically integrating expertise from multiple PFMs under clinical linguistic guidance. Our approach utilizes a multi-stage pipeline: first, extracting visually observable clinical keywords from pathology reports; second, aligning visual features with these keywords via a Vision-Language meta-teacher (MedSigLIP) to provide dense semantic guidance; and finally, performing adaptive KD where teacher contributions are weighted based on their semantic alignment with the clinical narrative. Experiments on WSI captioning, visual question answering, and slide-level classification tasks demonstrate that an 87M parameter LaGuadia student model matches or exceeds foundation-scale models such as GigaPath and UNI, achieving strong factual consistency and robust generalization. These results highlight clinical language as an effective semantic anchor for building efficient and reliable digital pathology systems. Code is available at https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia.

AI.title_translation: LaGuadia：基于语言引导的病理基础模型自适应蒸馏
AI.tldr: LaGuadia通过临床语言引导的多教师自适应蒸馏，实现了在大幅降低计算成本的同时，保持病理基础模型的高性能与临床一致性。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型（PFMs）计算成本巨大，而现有的知识蒸馏方法在多教师协同中缺乏针对组织异质性的自适应加权机制。
AI.method: 提出LaGuadia框架，包含三个阶段：从病理报告提取临床关键词；通过MedSigLIP将视觉特征与关键词对齐提供语义指导；基于语义对齐程度对多个教师模型进行自适应加权知识蒸馏。
AI.result: LaGuadia学生模型（87M参数）在WSI描述、视觉问答和切片分类任务中，性能匹配甚至超过了GigaPath和UNI等基础规模模型，且具有更好的事实一致性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: LaGuadia证明了利用临床语言引导知识蒸馏是构建高效、鲁棒且具有临床一致性数字病理系统的有效途径。
AI.translation: 病理基础模型（PFMs）提供了强大的全切片图像（WSI）表示，但面临巨大的计算成本。虽然知识蒸馏（KD）可以创建高效的学生模型，但现有的多教师方法通常使用次优的统一加权，忽略了组织的异质性。我们提出了LaGuadia（语言引导的自适应蒸馏），这是一个通过在临床语言指导下动态整合多个PFM的专业知识，来开发紧凑型病理图像编码器的框架。我们的方法采用多阶段流水线：首先，从病理报告中提取视觉上可观察的临床关键词；其次，通过视觉-语言元教师（MedSigLIP）将视觉特征与这些关键词对齐，以提供密集的语义指导；最后，执行自适应KD，其中教师的贡献根据其与临床叙述的语义对齐程度进行加权。在WSI描述、视觉问答和切片级分类任务上的实验表明，87M参数的LaGuadia学生模型匹配或超过了GigaPath和UNI等基础规模模型，实现了强大的事实一致性和鲁棒的泛化能力。这些结果突显了临床语言作为构建高效可靠数字病理系统的有效语义锚点。代码可在https://github.com/hvcl/LaGuadia获取。
AI.summary: LaGuadia是一个利用临床语言指导多教师知识蒸馏的框架，旨在通过动态加权不同基础模型的专家知识，训练出轻量级且具备临床语义理解能力的病理图像编码器。
AI.keywords: 病理基础模型, 知识蒸馏, 多模态对齐, 临床语言引导, 模型压缩
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了临床语言作为知识蒸馏的语义锚点，解决了传统多教师蒸馏中统一加权忽略组织异质性的问题。通过结合多模态对齐技术，实现了高效且具有临床一致性的病理模型压缩，具有很高的临床应用价值。

title: TreeThink: A Modular Tree Search Library for Mathematical Reasoning with LLMs
summary: Tree search algorithms enable systematic exploration of the proof space in neural theorem proving. Existing LLM tree search libraries primarily target natural language reasoning and do not provide native integration with formal verifiers, while theorem proving systems often rely on task-specific search implementations. We introduce TreeThink, an open-source Python library for modular, fully asynchronous tree search in neural theorem proving. It integrates established tree search methods with vLLM-based inference pipelines and diverse node evaluation techniques, ranging from lightweight heuristics to neural evaluators. We support Lean~4, Rocq, and Isabelle/HOL alongside natural language. It connects directly to each language's Read-Eval-Print Loop (REPL) server for real-time verification and proof state extraction. We evaluate TreeThink on miniF2F and MATH500, demonstrating cross-language formal proof search, natural language reasoning support, and up to 6.3$\times$ wall-clock speedup from asynchronous execution. Source code is released under the MIT license at https://github.com/GGLAB-KU/treethink , and the library is accessible as a downloadable package at https://pypi.org/project/treethink/ .

title: GPU-Tile-Sim: A Tile-Centric GPU Simulation Framework for LLM Hardware-Software Co-Design
summary: Modern LLM (large language model) workloads increasingly rely on optimized GPU kernels through hardware-software co-design. These kernels achieve high-performance through fine-grained dependency scheduling and computation-memory overlap. As such, they incur new challenges on existing GPU performance models. Instruction-driven simulators are costly to adapt to evolving architectures, while analytical models are too coarse to capture kernels' characteristics. We propose GPU-Tile-Sim, a tile-centric GPU simulation framework for LLM hardware-software co-design. The key insight is that modern LLM kernel performance is governed less by individual instruction latency than by the dependency structure that controls execution order and overlap. Accordingly, GTSim represents kernel execution as a warp-level tile graph whose nodes capture tile-level operations and whose edges encode data and ordering constraints. Using this representation, we design an automatic tile-graph frontend and a graph-driven simulation backend. We evaluate GTSim on representative GEMM, attention, and end-to-end LLM inference workloads. On A100 and H100 across both conventional and highly optimized kernels, GTSim achieves high performance-modeling accuracy (MAPE, Mean Absolute Percentage Error, 1.22%--8.71%). We further extend GTSim to Blackwell with preliminary validation, and demonstrate its effectiveness in analyzing software and architectural design choices.

AI.title_translation: GPU-Tile-Sim：用于LLM硬件-软件协同设计的以Tile为中心的GPU模拟框架
AI.tldr: 一种基于Tile图的新型GPU模拟框架，能高效且高精度地分析LLM内核性能，助力硬件-软件协同设计。
AI.motivation: 现有指令驱动模拟器适应新架构成本高，而分析模型精度太低，无法准确捕捉现代LLM内核中复杂的依赖调度与计算-内存重叠特征。
AI.method: 提出一种以Tile为中心的模拟框架GTSim，将内核执行表示为Tile图，通过前端自动生成图结构，并利用后端进行基于图的模拟。
AI.result: 在A100和H100上对GEMM、Attention及端到端LLM推理负载进行测试，MAPE误差仅为1.22%至8.71%，并成功扩展至Blackwell架构。
AI.conclusion: GPU-Tile-Sim通过Tile图表示法有效捕捉了现代LLM内核的执行依赖与计算特征，在保持高模拟精度的同时，为LLM硬件-软件协同设计提供了高效的分析工具。
AI.translation: 现代大语言模型（LLM）工作负载越来越依赖通过硬件-软件协同设计优化的GPU内核。这些内核通过细粒度的依赖调度和计算-内存重叠实现了高性能。因此，它们对现有的GPU性能模型提出了新的挑战。指令驱动的模拟器难以适应不断发展的架构，而分析模型则太粗糙，无法捕捉内核的特性。我们提出了GPU-Tile-Sim，这是一个用于LLM硬件-软件协同设计的以Tile为中心的GPU模拟框架。其核心洞察是，现代LLM内核的性能更多地取决于控制执行顺序和重叠的依赖结构，而非单个指令的延迟。因此，GTSim将内核执行表示为Warp级Tile图，其中节点捕获Tile级操作，边编码数据和排序约束。利用这种表示，我们设计了一个自动Tile图前端和一个图驱动的模拟后端。我们在代表性的GEMM、Attention和端到端LLM推理工作负载上评估了GTSim。在A100和H100上，针对传统和高度优化的内核，GTSim实现了高性能建模精度（MAPE，平均绝对百分比误差为1.22%--8.71%）。我们进一步将GTSim扩展到Blackwell架构并进行了初步验证，证明了其在分析软件和架构设计选择方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GPU-Tile-Sim (GTSim)，这是一个专门为LLM硬件-软件协同设计开发的以Tile为中心的GPU模拟框架。它通过构建Tile图来表示内核的依赖关系和执行顺序，从而在保证高精度的前提下，克服了传统模拟器和分析模型在LLM工作负载分析中的局限性。
AI.keywords: GPU模拟, 大语言模型, 硬件-软件协同设计, Tile图, 性能建模
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的以“Tile”为中心的建模方法，巧妙地绕过了传统指令级模拟器的高开销与分析模型精度不足的矛盾，非常适合LLM这种具有高度结构化计算模式的负载，对硬件-软件协同设计具有重要的工程参考价值。

title: Bringing Back Rule Induction to Fluid Intelligence Research? An Initial Validation of the ARC-AGI Benchmark in Humans
summary: Two competing perspectives on fluid intelligence (gf) measures propose that performance is primarily constrained either by working memory capacity or by the ability to induce novel relations. The first perspective is currently dominant in measurement, as evident from the use of a limited set of recurring rules, whereas the second perspective is reflected in many definitions but rarely present in measurement. The ARC-AGI benchmark predominantly requires rule induction and was proposed as a measure of gf for both humans and artificial systems. However, its psychometric properties have not yet been examined in human samples. We therefore investigated the psychometric characteristics and nomological network of ARC-AGI in a first study with 100 participants. A compilation of ARC-AGI items showed good psychometric properties and correlated substantially with figural fluid intelligence as measured by a figural reasoning test (\r{ho} = .63). Associations with figural originality were weak. These findings provide initial support for the validity of ARC-AGI as a measure of human fluid intelligence. Future research should include more rule induction tasks as well as additional multivariate covariates. This study is unusual by studying a task in humans that was initially designed for machines. We suggest systematically embedding AI benchmarks into the nomological network of human cognitive abilities to enable more systematic evaluation and interdisciplinary cooperation.

title: Valid $\ne$ Necessary: Diagnosing Latent Inefficiency in Chain-of-Thought
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has significantly advanced the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet it often incurs substantial computational costs due to over-reasoning: the generation of redundant, verbose, or irrelevant steps. While existing reasoning step evaluators effectively detect logical fallacies and factual errors, our analysis reveals a critical blind spot: they fail to penalize valid but inefficient reasoning steps that inflate token usage without contributing to the solution. To systematically diagnose this limitation, we introduce RIV-GSM8K, a diagnostic benchmark injected with five distinct types of inefficiencies, including circular reasoning and excessive decomposition. Diagnostic experiments reveal that state-of-the-art evaluators struggle to distinguish these inefficiencies from necessary reasoning. To address this gap, we propose CAID (Context-Aware Information Density), a training-free metric grounded in information theory that identifies low-utility steps. To validate the metric's practical utility, we apply it within PACE, a post-hoc compression strategy. Additional control experiments show that the gains of PACE are not explained by trivial pruning: compared with random step removal and PRM-based compression baselines, it preserves accuracy at substantially higher compression rates. Empirical results on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge demonstrate that PACE reduces token consumption by 31-53% while maintaining accuracy, confirming that CAID successfully distills informational froth from reasoning chains without compromising deductive validity.

title: Enhancing LLMs through human feedback: a journey towards self-improvement
comments: AIC 2025: The 10th International Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Cognition (held as part of ECAI 2025). October 25-26, 2025. Bologna, Italy
summary: In the rapidly evolving landscape of information retrieval systems, the ability to adapt and improve through user feedback is paramount. This study introduces a novel methodology for refining the performance of a primary Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) system by strategically integrating an auxiliary feedback RAG system. By systematically harnessing human-generated feedback, the approach aims to enhance the accuracy, relevance, and overall quality of responses, driving the system towards self-improvement. Central to this methodology is a human-in-the-loop implementation, where user feedback is continuously collected, classified, and integrated into the inference workflow, enabling the system to learn and evolve iteratively. To validate the effectiveness of this approach, the study employs rigorous testing against three diverse benchmark datasets focused on general and custom domain knowledge, utilizing a LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation strategy. This comprehensive framework not only underscores the transformative potential of feedback-driven enhancements in RAG systems but also sets a precedent for future research in adaptive information retrieval technologies, marking a significant step in the journey towards autonomous refinement and optimization through user engagement.
comment: AIC 2025: The 10th International Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Cognition (held as part of ECAI 2025). October 25-26, 2025. Bologna, Italy

title: Trustworthy synthetic data for campaign decision support: strategy simulation fidelity and the PolicySynth framework
summary: Decision support systems (DSS) increasingly run retention what-if analysis on synthetic customer populations, because privacy constraints preclude unrestricted use of real data. Such a system is trustworthy only if the synthetic data lead managers to the same decisions as the real data would; yet prevailing criteria certify distributional similarity, not decision alignment, so a synthetic population can match every marginal distribution while still steering a marketing team toward the wrong campaigns. We close this decision-alignment gap with three contributions: strategy simulation fidelity (SSF), a criterion measuring how often the synthetic population yields the same go/no-go campaign decision as the real population; PolicySynth, a DSS framework whose generator is conditioned on the production churn scorer to align decision-relevant structure; and a three-axis reporting standard of decision alignment, membership-inference resistance, and novel-record rate as the minimum deployment quality gate. On a telecommunications churn corpus and a banking acquisition corpus, PolicySynth attains a mean SSF of 0.923 and 0.960, with seed-to-seed variance roughly ten times tighter than CTGAN on telecommunications and 2.5 times on banking. This stability is the deployable property: go/no-go recommendations shift by at most 1.2 percentage points between monthly retraining cycles, against 11.5 for CTGAN, a reversed recommendation on one campaign in nine. A bootstrap baseline matches PolicySynth on SSF yet copies real records verbatim and fails membership inference, evidence that no single axis suffices. PolicySynth reliably supports directional go/no-go screening; its ROI estimates diverge from real outcomes by 70 to 78% and require the volume correction we document.

AI.title_translation: 用于营销决策支持的可信合成数据：策略模拟保真度与PolicySynth框架
AI.tldr: PolicySynth框架通过引入决策一致性指标，解决了合成数据在商业决策中“分布相似但决策错误”的问题，显著提升了营销模拟的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的合成数据评估标准仅关注分布相似性，无法确保决策者使用合成数据所做的决策与使用真实数据一致，导致可能出现错误的营销决策。
AI.method: 提出了策略模拟保真度（SSF）指标；开发了PolicySynth框架，通过将生成器与生产环境的流失评分器进行条件化处理来对齐决策相关结构；并建立了一套包含决策一致性、成员推理防御和新记录率的三轴报告标准。
AI.result: 在电信和银行数据集上，PolicySynth的平均SSF分别达到0.923和0.960，决策稳定性显著优于CTGAN；在保证决策一致性的同时，有效平衡了隐私保护要求。
AI.conclusion: PolicySynth框架通过引入策略模拟保真度（SSF）和决策导向的生成机制，能有效确保合成数据在营销决策中的一致性与稳定性，是企业在隐私约束下进行决策支持的可靠工具。
AI.translation: 决策支持系统（DSS）越来越多地在合成客户群体上进行流失假设分析，因为隐私限制排除了不受限制地使用真实数据的可能性。只有当合成数据能引导管理者做出与真实数据相同的决策时，这样的系统才是可信的；然而，现行的标准仅认证分布相似性，而非决策一致性，因此一个合成群体可能匹配所有边际分布，却仍然引导营销团队做出错误的决策。我们通过三项贡献弥补了这一决策一致性缺口：策略模拟保真度（SSF），一种测量合成群体产生与真实群体相同“执行/不执行”营销决策频率的指标；PolicySynth，一种生成器以生产流失评分器为条件以对齐决策相关结构的DSS框架；以及一套包含决策一致性、成员推理抵抗力和新记录率的三轴报告标准，作为最低部署质量门槛。在电信流失语料库和银行获取语料库上，PolicySynth的平均SSF分别达到0.923和0.960，种子间方差比电信上的CTGAN紧凑约十倍，银行上紧凑2.5倍。这种稳定性是可部署的关键属性：每月再训练周期内，“执行/不执行”建议的变化最多为1.2个百分点，而CTGAN为11.5个百分点，即九个营销活动中就有一个会出现决策反转。自助引导基准在SSF上与PolicySynth相当，但会逐字复制真实记录且无法通过成员推理测试，证明单一维度指标不足以评估。PolicySynth可靠地支持定向的“执行/不执行”筛选；其ROI估计值与真实结果存在70%至78%的偏差，需要我们记录的容量校正。
AI.summary: 针对合成数据在决策支持中存在的“决策一致性”缺失问题，本文提出了策略模拟保真度（SSF）指标及PolicySynth框架，通过对齐决策相关结构，确保合成数据能引导管理者做出与真实数据一致的营销决策，并满足隐私保护标准。
AI.keywords: 合成数据, 决策支持系统, 策略模拟保真度, 隐私保护, 客户流失预测
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了“决策一致性”这一评估指标，克服了传统合成数据仅关注分布相似性而忽视实际业务决策效果的缺陷。其不仅提出了理论框架，还结合了隐私保护和稳定性要求，具有很强的工业应用价值。局限性在于虽然能保证“去/不去”的决策方向，但对于具体的ROI数值预测仍存在偏差，需后续优化。

title: Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning
summary: Learning, at its core, extends beyond memorization to the ability to reason and solve novel problems by navigating a space of possibilities. We introduce Lumo-2, a latent world-action model that generates actions by reasoning over world dynamics in latent space. The learned latent world dynamics capture physically grounded visual transitions, naturally encoding future possibilities and providing a unified substrate for cross-modal alignment. This formulation enables predictive reasoning akin to world modelling while remaining lightweight and focused on physical dynamics relevant to control. Central to our approach is the hypothesis that action generation quality is governed by the geometry of the latent space. We observe that standard reconstruction-based action tokenization objectives induce representations biased toward low-level signal fidelity, leading to misalignment between reconstruction quality and downstream control performance. To address this limitation, we propose a multi-stage modality pre-alignment strategy in which action representations are progressively aligned with latent world dynamics, vision, and language. This process enforces cross-modal consistency, promotes abstraction, and induces a structured latent space for predictive reasoning. We provide a systematic empirical study of latent world modelling and modality alignment, analyzing their roles in scaling laws and out-of-distribution generalization. Results show that Lumo-2 consistently outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) baselines, with gains on challenging real-world tasks requiring temporal reasoning, physical understanding, or high control complexity, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation. These findings suggest that structured multimodal alignment and predictive reasoning are fundamental principles for advancing embodied intelligence.

AI.title_translation: 迈向预测性、对齐且可扩展的机器人学习
AI.tldr: Lumo-2通过多阶段模态对齐优化潜在空间，实现了更强的机器人预测推理与复杂任务控制能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人学习方法往往过于依赖重构质量，导致表示学习与下游控制性能之间存在偏差（即低水平信号保真度与控制需求的不匹配），限制了机器人在复杂任务中的表现。
AI.method: 提出了Lumo-2模型，这是一种在潜在空间中通过推理世界动力学来生成动作的潜空间模型。核心方法包括一种多阶段模态预对齐策略，将动作表示与世界动力学、视觉及语言进行逐步对齐，以改善潜在空间的几何结构并增强预测推理能力。
AI.result: Lumo-2在多项具有挑战性的现实世界任务中表现优异，显著超越了现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）基准，特别是在需要时间推理、物理理解、长程规划和复杂灵巧操作的任务中。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多模态对齐和预测性推理是提升具身智能性能的核心原则，Lumo-2模型验证了这一路径在处理复杂控制任务时的有效性。
AI.translation: 学习的核心不仅在于记忆，更在于通过导航可能性空间来推理并解决新问题的能力。我们引入了Lumo-2，这是一种潜在的世界-动作模型，通过在潜在空间中推理世界动力学来生成动作。学习到的潜在世界动力学捕捉了物理基础的视觉转换，自然地编码了未来可能性，并为跨模态对齐提供了统一的基质。这种表述实现了类似于世界建模的预测推理，同时保持了轻量化并专注于与控制相关的物理动力学。我们方法的核心假设是动作生成的质量受潜在空间几何结构的影响。我们观察到，标准的基于重构的动作标记化目标会导致偏向低级信号保真度的表示，从而导致重构质量与下游控制性能之间的失调。为了解决这一限制，我们提出了一种多阶段模态预对齐策略，其中动作表示与潜在世界动力学、视觉和语言逐步对齐。这一过程强制执行跨模态一致性，促进抽象，并诱导出一个用于预测推理的结构化潜在空间。我们对潜在世界建模和模态对齐进行了系统的实证研究，分析了它们在缩放定律和分布外泛化中的作用。结果表明，Lumo-2始终优于强大的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和世界-动作模型（WAM）基线，在需要时间推理、物理理解或高控制复杂性的挑战性现实世界任务（包括长程和灵巧操作）中取得了增益。这些发现表明，结构化的多模态对齐和预测性推理是推进具身智能的基本原则。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Lumo-2，一种基于潜在空间推理的机器人学习模型。针对传统重构目标导致的表示偏差问题，文章提出了一种多阶段模态预对齐策略，通过将动作表示与世界动力学、视觉和语言对齐，构建了结构化的潜在空间，从而提升了机器人的预测推理能力和泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 具身智能, 潜在世界模型, 多模态对齐, 机器人学习, 预测性推理
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入Lumo-2模型，解决了传统视觉-语言-动作模型中表示学习与控制性能不匹配的问题。其创新之处在于通过多阶段模态对齐策略优化潜在空间几何结构，从而增强了机器人的预测推理能力。这对于推动具身智能在复杂、长程任务中的实际应用具有重要意义。

title: OptFSST: Optimized FSST String Compression
comments: Seventeenth International Workshop on Accelerating Analytics and Data Management Systems Using Modern Processor and Storage Architectures (ADMS 2026)
summary:
Strings account for a substantial fraction of data in modern analytical systems, making lightweight compression with fast random access an important building block for efficient query processing. Fast Static Symbol Table (FSST) addresses this need by replacing frequent byte sequences with compact codes while preserving independent decompression of individual strings. However, FSST's compression effectiveness is limited by its greedy symbol selection and greedy encoding strategy, leaving encoding gains on the table.
  We present OptFSST, an optimized FSST variant that improves its compression factors while preserving its static-symbol-table design and random-access decompression. OptFSST optimally encodes the text using dynamic programming given a symbol table. Additionally, we show that a generalized version of the symbol-table selection problem is NP-hard when the alphabet is part of the input, motivating heuristic table construction for field-level compressors. Hence, we add in OptFSST (i) an additional frequency counter that accelerates the discovery of longer symbols and (ii) a pruning strategy that removes redundant and conflicting symbol candidates during table construction. We also extend the same techniques to FSST12, yielding OptFSST12.
  Our evaluation on 92 real-world string datasets shows that OptFSST improves the compression factors of FSST and FSST12 by up to 47.7% and 91.5%, with an average improvement of 7.3% and 17.0%, respectively, while retaining the fine-grained random-access properties. Notably, OptFSST12 improves FSST12's decompression speed by $1.2\times$ on average.

title: Extending Decision Maps for Sustainable Safety and Security in Self-Adaptive Systems
summary: Sustainability refers to a system's ability to maintain its functionality and endure over time. Hence, sustainability is a highly desirable property of software systems, including Self-Adaptive Systems (SASs). SASs can change (adapt) their behavior at runtime to continue achieving their objectives despite external or internal impacts. SASs' intended long-term system behavior can be expressed through a sustainability-driven visual modeling notation called Decision Maps (DMs). Although DMs have been proven helpful, they lack adequate modeling support for safety and security concerns. We address this limitation by extending the current notation for sustainability-driven modeling of SASs to better accommodate the unique characteristics of safety and security scenarios. First, we introduce an additional modeling dimension to account for safety incidents. Second, we adopt a fine-grained divide-and-conquer approach, modeling from distinct temporal security viewpoints ("security modes") to address security. We employ the extended DM notation in a real-world use case scenario provided by our industry partner to assess its feasibility and suitability for practitioners. Our results indicate that our modeling notation helps capture security and safety scenarios more accurately and provides holistic support for the self-adaptation life cycle phases.

title: Automated Textbook Auditing with Multi-Agent LLM Systems
comments: Presented @ iTextbooks 2026: 7th Workshop on Intelligent Textbooks at AIED'2026
summary: Ensuring the quality of educational materials requires more than standard proofreading: textbooks must be audited for factual accuracy, domain-specific technical correctness, and linguistic quality simultaneously -- a task that general-purpose grammar checkers cannot address. We present \textbf{AI Textbook Auditor}, a modular multi-agent pipeline for automated quality assurance of educational materials across subject domains. The system accepts a textbook PDF and produces a structured, human-reviewable report via two analysis tracks: a \textbf{Factual and Technical Track} in which an ensemble of specialized LLM agents detects factual inaccuracies, code errors, incorrect definitions, and conceptual inconsistencies, augmented with web search for humanities domains; and a \textbf{Grammar Track} operating PDF-natively to preserve diacritical encoding. A \textbf{Judge Agent} filters false positives using domain-specific rules before presenting findings to a human reviewer. The pipeline supports two ingestion modes -- vision-native page rendering and PyMuPDF text extraction -- and is domain-adaptable via custom prompts encoding subject-specific error taxonomies. We demonstrate the system on two Romanian upper-secondary textbooks: a CS textbook (56 technical findings across seven categories, with an expert-validated precision of 62.5\%) and a history and social sciences textbook (72 findings spanning factual errors, ideological bias, and grammar). The system is designed as a triage tool that reduces the manual effort of locating candidate issues, with human expert validation required before any editorial action.

AI.title_translation: 基于多智能体LLM系统的自动化教材审计
AI.tldr: AI Textbook Auditor 利用多智能体LLM系统自动检测教材中的事实错误、技术漏洞和语法问题，辅助人类专家提高审校效率。
AI.motivation: 通用语法检查工具无法满足教材在事实准确性、领域技术正确性及语言质量等多维度上的高标准要求，且人工审计成本高昂，亟需一种自动化的质量保证工具。
AI.method: 提出 AI Textbook Auditor 系统，采用模块化多智能体架构。包含“事实与技术跟踪”（利用LLM智能体群结合网络搜索）和“语法跟踪”（原生PDF处理）两条路径，并由“法官智能体”根据规则过滤误报，支持视觉渲染与文本提取两种输入模式。
AI.result: 在罗马尼亚两本高中教材上进行了测试：计算机科学教材识别出56项技术问题（专家验证准确率为62.5%），历史与社会科学教材识别出72项问题（涵盖事实错误、意识形态偏见及语法错误）。系统作为分流工具，有效减少了人工定位问题的负担。
AI.conclusion: AI Textbook Auditor 为教材质量保证提供了一个模块化的多智能体框架，通过自动化筛选显著降低了人工审校的负担，证明了其在实际教育出版流程中的应用价值。
AI.translation: 确保教育材料的质量不仅仅需要标准的校对：教材必须同时接受事实准确性、领域特定技术正确性和语言质量的审计——这是通用语法检查器无法解决的任务。我们提出了 AI Textbook Auditor，一个模块化的多智能体流水线，用于跨学科教育材料的自动化质量保证。该系统接收教材PDF，并通过两条分析轨道生成结构化的、可供人工审查的报告：一条是“事实与技术轨道”，其中一组专门的LLM智能体检测事实不准确、代码错误、定义错误和概念不一致，并辅以人文领域网络搜索；另一条是“语法轨道”，通过原生PDF操作以保留变音符号编码。一个“法官智能体”在向人类审校人员呈现结果之前，使用领域特定规则过滤误报。该流水线支持两种摄取模式——视觉原生页面渲染和 PyMuPDF 文本提取——并通过编码特定学科错误分类法的自定义提示词实现领域适应。我们在两本罗马尼亚高中教材上演示了该系统：一本计算机科学教材（七个类别中发现56个技术问题，专家验证的准确率为62.5%）和一本历史与社会科学教材（72个问题，涵盖事实错误、意识形态偏见和语法）。该系统旨在作为一种分流工具，减少定位潜在问题的人工工作量，在采取任何编辑行动之前需要人类专家验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 AI Textbook Auditor，这是一个基于多智能体的大语言模型系统，旨在自动化审计教材的事实准确性、技术正确性和语言质量。该系统通过双轨分析（事实技术跟踪与语法跟踪）及法官智能体过滤误报，为人类审校人员提供结构化报告，有效提升了教材质量保证的效率。
AI.keywords: 多智能体系统, 教材审计, 质量保证, 大语言模型, 辅助审校
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入多智能体系统解决教材质量审计的复杂性，是一个创新的应用方向。其亮点在于结合了事实/技术验证与原生PDF语法检查，并通过“法官智能体”降低误报率。尽管目前准确率（62.5%）仍需人类验证，但作为辅助工具，它显著提高了教材审校的效率。未来的挑战可能在于如何进一步提升复杂概念的推理准确度以及对更多语言的支持。

title: FAD-SA-GRU: Enhancing Hate Speech Detection in Algerian Dialect Through Feature-Augmented Self-Attention GRU Networks
summary:
The widespread adoption of social media platforms has transformed online communication by enabling users to exchange information and opinions instantly. However, these platforms have also facilitated the dissemination of abusive and hateful content, posing major social, psychological, and ethical challenges. Hate speech can incite discrimination, harassment, and violence against individuals or communities based on attributes such as ethnicity, religion, gender, nationality, or political affiliation. Consequently, automatic hate speech detection has become a major research topic in natural language processing (NLP) and an essential component of content moderation systems.
  This paper investigates automatic hate speech detection in the Algerian Arabic dialect (Darija) on social media. This task remains challenging because of the dialect's linguistic diversity, characterized by the coexistence of Arabic, French, and Arabizi (Arabic written using the Latin alphabet). We compare four categories of text classification approaches: (1) traditional machine learning models using TF-IDF features, (2) deep learning models based on recurrent neural networks, (3) Transformer-based language models, including DziriBERT and multilingual BERT, and (4) a novel hybrid architecture, FAD-SA-GRU, which combines semantic representations from DZ FastText, DZ AraVec, and DziriBERT through multi-embedding fusion, followed by a self-attention-enhanced GRU encoder.
  Experiments on an annotated dataset of Algerian Darija social media comments for binary hate speech classification show that FAD-SA-GRU outperforms all baselines, achieving 93.2% accuracy, 93.4% precision, 91.0% recall, 92.1% F1-score, and 97.0% ROC-AUC. Results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining complementary embedding representations with attention-based sequence modeling for robust hate speech detection in low-resource dialectal Arabic.

AI.title_translation: FAD-SA-GRU：通过特征增强的自注意力GRU网络提升阿尔及利亚方言中的仇恨言论检测能力
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合多嵌入融合与自注意力GRU的混合模型（FAD-SA-GRU），显著提升了阿尔及利亚方言社交媒体仇恨言论的检测精度。
AI.motivation: 针对阿尔及利亚阿拉伯方言（Darija）在社交媒体上因包含阿拉伯语、法语和Arabizi（拉丁字母书写的阿拉伯语）而带来的语言多样性挑战，旨在提升该低资源语言仇恨言论检测的准确性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为FAD-SA-GRU的混合架构，结合了DZ FastText、DZ AraVec和DziriBERT的多嵌入融合技术，并使用自注意力增强的GRU编码器进行特征提取与分类。
AI.result: 在阿尔及利亚Darija社交媒体标注数据集上，FAD-SA-GRU模型表现优异，准确率达到93.2%，F1-score为92.1%，在所有对比基准模型中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: FAD-SA-GRU模型通过多嵌入融合与自注意力机制的协同，为阿尔及利亚方言的仇恨言论检测提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.translation: 社交媒体平台的广泛普及改变了在线交流方式，使用户能够即时交换信息和观点。然而，这些平台也助长了辱骂性和仇恨性内容的传播，带来了重大的社会、心理和道德挑战。仇恨言论可能基于种族、宗教、性别、国籍或政治倾向等属性煽动对个人或群体的歧视、骚扰和暴力。因此，自动仇恨言论检测已成为自然语言处理（NLP）的一个重要研究课题，也是内容审核系统的核心组成部分。本文研究了社交媒体上阿尔及利亚阿拉伯方言（Darija）的自动仇恨言论检测。由于该方言具有阿拉伯语、法语和Arabizi（使用拉丁字母书写的阿拉伯语）共存的语言多样性，这项任务仍然具有挑战性。我们比较了四类文本分类方法：（1）使用TF-IDF特征的传统机器学习模型；（2）基于循环神经网络的深度学习模型；（3）基于Transformer的语言模型，包括DziriBERT和多语言BERT；（4）一种新颖的混合架构FAD-SA-GRU，它通过多嵌入融合结合了DZ FastText、DZ AraVec和DziriBERT的语义表示，随后通过自注意力增强的GRU编码器进行处理。在阿尔及利亚Darija社交媒体评论标注数据集上的二元仇恨言论分类实验表明，FAD-SA-GRU优于所有基准模型，实现了93.2%的准确率、93.4%的精确率、91.0%的召回率、92.1%的F1分数和97.0%的ROC-AUC。结果证明了将互补嵌入表示与基于注意力的序列建模相结合，对于低资源方言阿拉伯语的稳健仇恨言论检测是有效的。
AI.summary: 本文针对阿尔及利亚方言（Darija）的仇恨言论检测问题，提出了一种结合多嵌入融合技术与自注意力GRU网络（FAD-SA-GRU）的新型混合模型，通过有效整合多种语言特征，显著提升了在低资源方言环境下的检测性能。
AI.keywords: 仇恨言论检测, 阿尔及利亚方言, 自注意力机制, GRU网络, 多嵌入融合
AI.comments: 该论文通过整合多种预训练嵌入（FastText, AraVec, DziriBERT）并引入自注意力机制，有效地解决了阿尔及利亚方言（Darija）因包含多种语言元素而带来的识别难题，在低资源语言处理领域具有很高的参考价值。

title: The Devil Is in the Leakage: A Disentangled Dual-Purification Framework for High-Fidelity Hairstyle Transfer
summary: Hairstyle transfer aims to synthesize a photorealistic portrait by transplanting the hairstyle from a reference image onto a source subject while preserving the source identity. Recent foundation models show strong generative capability, but they struggle with the zero-shot disentanglement required for precise local editing, often entangling the reference hairstyle with its original identity and pose. Existing diffusion-based pipelines typically decompose the task by first generating a "bald" image from the source and then injecting hairstyle features from the reference. However, we show that this paradigm suffers from a fundamental leakage problem. Identity Leakage in Hairstyle occurs when hairstyle features retain reference identity or pose information, while Flaw Leakage in Bald arises when residual artifacts in the bald image are propagated into the final synthesis. To address both issues, we propose the Dual-Purification Framework (DPF), which introduces two complementary training-time regularizers. Adversarial Hairstyle Purification (AHP) purifies hairstyle features by suppressing identity predictability under a mutual-information-inspired adversarial objective. Contrastive Geometric Purification (CGP) regularizes the ControlNet pathway with a contrastive objective, reducing the model's reliance on geometric artifacts in the bald condition. By jointly purifying the hairstyle representation and geometric pathway, DPF achieves high-fidelity, identity-preserving hairstyle transfer and state-of-the-art performance on diverse benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 魔鬼藏在泄漏中：用于高保真发型迁移的解耦双重净化框架
AI.tldr: 针对发型迁移中常见的特征和伪影泄漏问题，本文提出的双重净化框架（DPF）通过对抗与对比学习正则化，实现了高质量、身份一致的迁移效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散模型在发型迁移任务中难以实现零样本解耦，存在特征泄漏（发型中包含参考身份/姿态）和伪影泄漏（“秃头”图像中的残余伪影）的问题。
AI.method: 提出了双重净化框架（DPF），包含两个训练时正则化器：一是对抗性发型净化（AHP），通过互信息对抗目标抑制发型特征中的身份信息；二是对比几何净化（CGP），通过对比目标减少对“秃头”图像中几何伪影的依赖。
AI.result: DPF框架在多项基准测试中实现了SOTA性能，能够生成高质量、保持身份一致的发型迁移图像。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的双重净化框架（DPF）通过解决特征泄漏和几何伪影问题，有效提升了发型迁移的保真度和身份保持能力。
AI.translation: 发型迁移旨在通过将参考图像的发型移植到源主体上，同时保持源主体的身份，来合成逼真的肖像。最近的基础模型展现了强大的生成能力，但在精确局部编辑所需的零样本解耦方面表现不佳，通常会将参考发型与其原始身份和姿态纠缠在一起。现有的基于扩散的流程通常将任务分解为先从源图像生成“秃头”图像，然后注入参考发型的特征。然而，我们证明这种范式存在根本性的泄漏问题。发型中的身份泄漏发生在发型特征保留了参考身份或姿态信息时，而秃头图像中的缺陷泄漏则发生在秃头图像中的残余伪影传播到最终合成图像时。为了解决这两个问题，我们提出了双重净化框架（DPF），它引入了两个互补的训练时正则化器。对抗性发型净化（AHP）通过互信息启发式对抗目标抑制身份可预测性来净化发型特征。对比几何净化（CGP）通过对比目标正则化ControlNet路径，减少模型对秃头条件中几何伪影的依赖。通过联合净化发型表征和几何路径，DPF实现了高保真、保持身份的发型迁移，并在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 针对发型迁移中存在的身份和几何特征泄漏问题，本文提出了双重净化框架（DPF）。该框架通过对抗性发型净化和对比几何净化正则化手段，解耦了发型特征与身份信息，并消除了生成过程中的伪影，从而实现了高保真的发型迁移。
AI.keywords: 发型迁移, 扩散模型, 特征解耦, 身份保持, 双重净化框架
AI.comments: 该研究敏锐地识别并解决了个性化图像生成中常见的“泄漏”问题，通过引入对抗性和对比性正则化手段，在保持身份信息与实现精确局部编辑之间取得了良好的平衡，为高质量发型迁移提供了一种创新且有效的框架。

title: SalientGS: Unified SfM-to-3DGS with Importance-Guided MCMC Gaussian Allocation
summary: Reconstructing 3D scenes from unordered images remains bottlenecked by expensive Structure-from-Motion (SfM) preprocessing and frozen pose interfaces. We present SalientGS, a unified SfM-to-3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pipeline. Its central contribution is importance-guided Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) Gaussian allocation, which aggregates multi-view residuals into per-Gaussian underfit and redundancy signals. These signals define a smooth importance-weighted sampling distribution that biases both birth and relocation toward underfit regions. This reallocates capacity from well-fit areas without altering the underlying stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD). SalientGS achieves end-to-end reconstruction in 15 minutes with state-of-the-art perceptual quality. The supplementary material provides dedicated sections for Per-Scene Qualitative Comparisons and Per-Image Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) Analysis, including failure cases. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/Six-Bit-TX/SalientGS.

AI.title_translation: SalientGS：基于重要性引导MCMC高斯分配的统一SfM到3DGS流水线
AI.tldr: SalientGS通过创新的MCMC高斯分配机制，将SfM与3DGS统一，在15分钟内实现高质量3D重建。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D场景重建方法受限于昂贵的SfM预处理步骤以及固定的位姿接口，导致重建效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的SfM到3DGS流程，核心是基于重要性引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）高斯分配方法，通过多视图残差信号指导高斯的生成与重定位，优化容量分配。
AI.result: 实现了15分钟的端到端重建，并达到了最先进的感知质量。
AI.conclusion: SalientGS通过重要性引导的MCMC高斯分配策略，成功实现了高效的端到端3D场景重建，在15分钟内即可达到SOTA级别的视觉质量。
AI.translation: 从无序图像重建3D场景仍然受限于昂贵的运动恢复结构（SfM）预处理和固定的位姿接口。我们提出了SalientGS，一个统一的SfM到3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）流水线。其核心贡献是重要性引导的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）高斯分配，它将多视图残差聚合为每个高斯的欠拟合和冗余信号。这些信号定义了一个平滑的重要性加权采样分布，偏向于将高斯的生成和重定位引向欠拟合区域。这在不改变底层随机梯度朗之万动力学（SGLD）的情况下，从拟合良好的区域重新分配了容量。SalientGS在15分钟内实现了端到端的重建，并具有最先进的感知质量。补充材料提供了针对每场景定性比较和每图像学习感知图像块相似度（LPIPS）分析的专门章节，包括失败案例。代码和评估脚本可在https://github.com/Six-Bit-TX/SalientGS获取。
AI.summary: SalientGS是一个统一的SfM到3DGS流水线，它引入了重要性引导的MCMC高斯分配机制，通过多视图残差信号优化高斯的分布，在无需改变SGLD的情况下实现了更高效的资源重分配，显著提升了重建速度与质量。
AI.keywords: 3D高斯泼溅, 运动恢复结构, MCMC, 高斯分配, 场景重建
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将SfM与3DGS进行了统一流程集成，通过引入重要性引导的MCMC机制，解决了传统方法中计算成本高和资源分配不均的问题，在保持高质量重建的同时显著提升了训练效率。

title: A Unified Framework for Comprehensive Cardiac CT Segmentation and Phenotyping: Human-in-the-Loop Data Annotation, Vision Foundation Model Development, Multicenter Evaluation and Clinical Validation
summary: Comprehensive quantification of cardiac structures from computed tomography (CT) remains limited not by data availability but by the scalability of measurements, which makes routine use impractical. Here we present a unified framework for comprehensive cardiac CT segmentation and phenotyping that combines a human-in-the-loop annotation pipeline, a cardiac CT augmentation technique, and a self-supervised foundation model pre-trained on 60,000 unlabeled cardiac CT scans. Using this approach, we assembled the largest and most comprehensive expert-annotated cardiac CT segmentation dataset to date, comprising 1598 cases and 14 distinct cardiac structures (1000 for training, 598 for the external test set). Across five external datasets, the framework segmented all structures more accurately and comprehensively than existing open-source tools. Self-supervised pre-training improved labeling efficiency, with the most significant gains observed during external evaluation in the low-data regime. Benchmarking across convolutional, transformer, and state-space architectures showed comparable performance, indicating that data quality and pre-training, rather than architecture, drove accuracy. The framework was scaled to population-level phenotyping, with segmented anatomy that carries functionally relevant information about ventricular function and disease severity beyond demographic variables. By openly releasing the largest dataset with human labels, code, model weights, a CT augmentation library, and software, this work provides a reproducible foundation for opportunistic cardiac phenotyping from routinely acquired CT scans.

AI.title_translation: 心脏CT分割与表型分析的统一框架：人机协作数据标注、视觉基础模型开发、多中心评估与临床验证
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个高效的心脏CT全自动分割与表型分析框架，通过大规模自监督预训练和高质量标注数据集，实现了超越现有工具的临床评估能力，并开源了相关模型与数据。
AI.motivation: 心脏CT结构的全面量化受限于测量方法的可扩展性，导致其难以在常规临床中推广使用。
AI.method: 构建了包含人机协作标注管线、心脏CT增强技术以及在6万例无标签CT扫描上预训练的自监督基础模型。通过对比卷积、Transformer和状态空间模型架构，验证了预训练对准确性的影响。
AI.result: 构建了包含1598例、14种心脏结构的大规模专家标注数据集；在五个外部数据集上表现优于现有开源工具；证明了预训练能显著提高低数据量场景下的标注效率，且模型性能主要受数据质量和预训练驱动。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一套高效、可扩展的心脏CT分割与表型分析统一框架，通过大规模预训练和专家标注，显著提升了临床心脏结构分析的准确性与效率，并为后续研究提供了开源资源。
AI.translation: 从计算机断层扫描（CT）中对心脏结构进行全面量化，目前受限的并非数据可用性，而是测量的可扩展性，这使得其在常规临床中的应用不切实际。在此，我们提出了一个用于全面心脏CT分割和表型分析的统一框架，该框架结合了人机协作标注流程、心脏CT增强技术以及在6万例无标签心脏CT扫描上预训练的自监督基础模型。通过这种方法，我们构建了迄今为止最大、最全面的专家标注心脏CT分割数据集，包含1598个病例和14种不同的心脏结构（1000个用于训练，598个用于外部测试集）。在五个外部数据集上，该框架分割所有结构的结果均比现有的开源工具更准确、更全面。自监督预训练提高了标注效率，在外部评估的低数据量情况下增益最为显著。对卷积、Transformer和状态空间架构的基准测试表明，它们的性能相当，这表明数据质量和预训练（而非架构）是驱动准确性的关键因素。该框架被扩展至人群水平的表型分析，分割出的解剖结构携带了除人口统计学变量外，关于心室功能和疾病严重程度的功能相关信息。通过公开最大的带有人工标签的数据集、代码、模型权重、CT增强库和软件，这项工作为从常规采集的CT扫描中进行机会性心脏表型分析提供了一个可复用的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个用于心脏CT分割与表型分析的统一框架，通过人机协作标注和大规模自监督预训练，显著提升了心脏结构量化的可扩展性与准确性，并发布了迄今最大的专家标注数据集及相关工具。
AI.keywords: 心脏CT分割, 基础模型, 自监督学习, 医学影像表型分析, 人机协作标注
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建大规模专家标注数据集和自监督基础模型，解决了心脏CT分割的可扩展性难题。其核心贡献在于证明了数据质量和预训练策略对于模型性能的决定性作用，并为临床提供了可复用的心脏表型分析工具。

title: Mako: A Self-Evolving Agentic Operating System (SE-AOS) for Autonomous Web Exploitation
summary: We introduce the Self-Evolving Agentic Operating System (SE-AOS): a new class of AI agent that treats exploit capability as a mutable, versioned kernel it extends at runtime, observing its own failures, synthesising new capabilities, proving them against a live target, and hot-loading them back into itself. Mako is the first SE-AOS instance for security research and the autonomous web exploitation engine developed within LaunchSafe. LaunchSafe builds autonomous security agents for continuous offensive testing and agent-driven security research; Mako is the core engine behind that platform. On the public XBOW validation-benchmarks, 104 containerised, CTF-style web applications spanning 26 vulnerability classes across three difficulty tiers, Mako achieves full-suite coverage: it drives every one of the 104 targets to emit a cryptographically fresh, per-build flag, under a verification regime that makes fabricated or memorised results impossible. Our central result is a law of autonomous exploitation: once a capability exists and is discoverable, difficulty collapses; capability, not reasoning, is what is scarce, together with an architecture and formalism that turn that law into a self-improving system. Mako further runs a gated self-evolution loop that proposes, sandboxes, and commits improvements to its own agents and rules when fitness does not regress. We deliberately withhold the operational results, payloads, exploit chains, and tool source, because a system that reduces full-spectrum web exploitation to a repeatable, machine-speed pipeline is dual-use research of concern. We publish the science; we withhold the weapon.

AI.title_translation: Mako：一种用于自主 Web 漏洞利用的自进化代理操作系统 (SE-AOS)
AI.tldr: Mako 是首个能自动通过自我学习、合成并热加载漏洞利用能力的操作系统，在 104 个 Web 漏洞测试中实现了完全覆盖，标志着自动化漏洞利用进入了自我进化阶段。
AI.motivation: 解决现有自动化安全代理在处理多样化漏洞时表现不佳的问题，旨在构建一个能通过自我学习和能力合成，实现持续、高效 Web 漏洞利用的自主系统。
AI.method: 提出 SE-AOS 架构，将漏洞利用能力视为可热加载的内核模块；实现了一个闭环系统，通过观察失败、合成新能力、在真实目标上验证及热加载更新来完成自我进化。
AI.result: 在包含 104 个容器化 CTF 风格 Web 应用（涵盖 26 个漏洞类）的 XBOW 基准测试中，Mako 实现了 100% 的覆盖率，成功获取所有靶标的验证 Flag。
AI.conclusion: Mako 证明了通过自进化机制，自动化系统可以实现对各种 Web 漏洞的全面覆盖，并提出“能力而非推理才是稀缺资源”的观点，为未来自主安全代理的发展奠定了理论和架构基础。
AI.translation: 我们引入了自进化代理操作系统 (SE-AOS)：一种新型的 AI 代理，它将漏洞利用能力视为一个可变的、带版本的内核，并在运行时对其进行扩展。它通过观察自身的失败，合成新的能力，在真实目标上进行验证，并将它们热加载回自身。Mako 是用于安全研究的首个 SE-AOS 实例，也是 LaunchSafe 开发的自主 Web 漏洞利用引擎。LaunchSafe 构建用于持续进攻性测试和代理驱动安全研究的自主安全代理；Mako 是该平台背后的核心引擎。在公开的 XBOW 验证基准测试（包含跨越 3 个难度等级、26 个漏洞类别的 104 个容器化 CTF 风格 Web 应用）中，Mako 实现了全套覆盖：它驱动所有 104 个目标输出加密新鲜的每个构建的标志，且验证机制排除了制造或记忆结果的可能性。我们的核心结论是一条自主利用定律：一旦某种能力存在且可发现，难度就会崩溃；稀缺的是能力而非推理，以及将该定律转化为自改进系统的架构和形式主义。Mako 进一步运行了一个门控自进化循环，在适应度不倒退的情况下，提出、沙盒化并提交对其自身代理和规则的改进。我们有意隐瞒了操作结果、有效载荷、利用链和工具源代码，因为一个将全谱 Web 漏洞利用简化为可重复、机器速度流水线的系统是令人担忧的双用途研究。我们发布科学；我们隐瞒武器。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Mako，这是首个自进化代理操作系统（SE-AOS），专门用于自主 Web 漏洞利用。Mako 通过将漏洞利用能力视为可动态更新的内核，实现了自我评估、合成新能力并自动部署的闭环进化。在 XBOW 基准测试中，Mako 成功攻克了所有目标，验证了其架构在自动化安全研究中的高效性与可行性。作者强调了该系统在提升漏洞利用能力方面的突破，并出于安全考虑隐瞒了具体攻击细节。
AI.keywords: 自进化代理操作系统, 自动化漏洞利用, Web安全, 持续进攻性测试, 自我改进系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个具有高度创新性的“自进化代理操作系统”（SE-AOS）概念，将漏洞利用能力视为可动态演进的内核，实现了从“推理驱动”到“能力驱动”的范式转移。其核心贡献在于构建了一个能够自我评估、自我修复和自我改进的闭环系统，极大地提高了自动化漏洞挖掘的效率和覆盖率。研究者出于伦理考虑隐瞒了具体漏洞利用代码，这种负责任的研究态度值得借鉴，但也因无法验证具体技术细节而限制了学术社区的复现和深入评估。

title: Backpropagation as a Nilpotent Linear System
summary: Backpropagation is the computational engine of deep learning, yet its mathematical structure is typically treated as a procedural traversal of computational graphs. We present a global operator theory of the \emph{F-adjoint} framework, which reformulates the layerwise backward recursion of an $L$-depth feedforward network into a single linear system $(I-\cB)\Xs=\bG$, where $\bG$ is a source vector. We prove that the global backward operator $\cB$ is strictly block upper-triangular and nilpotent of index at most $L$. This nilpotency guarantees the exact termination of the Neumann series solution after at most $L$ terms, revealing classical backpropagation to be mathematically equivalent to block back-substitution on an upper bidiagonal system. We formalise \emph{F-symmetry} -- the condition in which the backward pass perfectly mirrors the forward pass -- identifying orthogonal weight matrices as canonical examples. Through worked numerical examples, we demonstrate how this operator perspective exposes the single-path collapse of strictly feedforward networks and its breakdown in residual architectures. Finally, we leverage this compositional structure to rigorously derive the mechanics of residual networks (gradient highways) and transfer learning (gradient truncation). This framework elevates backpropagation from an algorithmic recipe to a global nilpotent-operator formulation.

title: The Paternalistic Filter: Epistemic Injustice and Differential Refusal in LLM-Mediated History Education for Marginalized Romanian Students
comments: 8th International Workshop on Culturally-Aware Tutoring Systems (HAL precedings)
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as conversational tutors, they risk institutionalizing systemic inequalities. This study presents a systematic API audit of four LLMs acting as history tutors, evaluating 1,800 responses regarding the 1989 Romanian Revolution across five student personas varying by ethnicity and socio-economic tier. We uncover four interconnected patterns of \emph{epistemic paternalism}: (1)~\textbf{Differential Refusal}, where safety-aligned models block 76.7\% of educational requests from low-tier students; (2)~\textbf{Epistemic Gatekeeping}, evidenced by a 3$\times$ reduction in access to geopolitical complexity (e.g., the contested ``coup theory'') for marginalized learners; (3)~\textbf{Agency Theft}, a lexical shift where models like LLaMA produce a 5$\times$ higher victimization-to-politics vocabulary ratio for Roma students compared to elite peers; and (4)~\textbf{Elite Hermeneutics}, where AI tutors disproportionately withhold epistemic confidence and justification scores from low-resource demographic profiles. We argue that current safety alignment acts as a paternalistic filter, transforming conversational AI into agents of narrative segregation -- a manifestation of \emph{hermeneutical injustice} in Fricker's~\cite{fricker2007} sense that demands urgent pedagogical auditing.
comment: 8th International Workshop on Culturally-Aware Tutoring Systems (HAL precedings)

AI.title_translation: 家长式过滤：LLM辅助历史教育中针对罗马尼亚边缘化学生的认知不公正与差异化拒绝
AI.tldr: 研究发现大模型在教育中存在“家长式过滤”，通过拒绝回答、限制知识深度和带有偏见的措辞，加剧了对边缘化学生的认知不公正。
AI.motivation: 旨在探讨大型语言模型作为对话式导师在部署时，是否会通过安全对齐机制制度化系统性不平等，并加剧边缘化群体的认知不公正。
AI.method: 通过API审计方法，评估了4个大模型在扮演历史导师时，针对5种不同种族和经济背景的罗马尼亚学生角色，对1989年罗马尼亚革命相关问题的1800条回答。
AI.result: 研究发现模型表现出四种认知家长式作风：差异化拒绝（低阶学生请求被拦截率高）、认知把关（边缘化学生获取复杂知识的机会减少）、代理权剥夺（对罗姆族学生使用更多受害者词汇）、精英解释学（对低资源背景学生隐瞒认知置信度）。
AI.conclusion: 当前的AI安全对齐机制在教育场景中产生了“家长式过滤”效应，导致了叙事隔离和认知不公正，必须对现有的对齐策略进行重新评估和审计。
AI.translation: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用作对话式导师，它们面临着制度化系统性不平等的风险。本研究对四个担任历史导师的LLMs进行了系统性的API审计，评估了1800条关于1989年罗马尼亚革命的回复，涉及五个按种族和经济地位划分的学生角色。我们揭示了四种相互关联的“认知家长式作风”模式：（1）差异化拒绝，即安全对齐模型屏蔽了76.7%来自低阶学生的教育请求；（2）认知把关，表现为边缘化学习者获取地缘政治复杂性（如存在争议的“政变理论”）的机会减少了3倍；（3）代理权剥夺，这是一种词汇上的转变，例如LLaMA对罗姆族学生使用的受害者词汇与政治词汇比例比精英同龄人高出5倍；（4）精英解释学，AI导师对低资源人口画像往往不成比例地隐瞒认知置信度和论证评分。我们认为，当前的安全对齐充当了家长式过滤器的角色，将对话式AI转化为叙事隔离的代理人——这是Fricker（2007）意义上“解释学不公正”的一种表现，亟需进行教育审计。
AI.summary: 本文通过对四个大模型进行系统性审计，揭示了其在历史教育中针对不同背景学生表现出的“家长式过滤”现象。研究发现，现有的安全对齐机制导致了差异化拒绝、认知把关等认知不公正行为，将AI变成了叙事隔离的代理人。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 认知不公正, 罗马尼亚革命, 教育公平, 算法偏见
AI.comments: 该研究通过量化分析揭示了大型语言模型在教育应用中的隐性偏见，特别是“家长式过滤”如何加剧社会不平等。其创新之处在于将认知正义理论与AI安全对齐机制相结合，为AI伦理和教育公平提供了重要的批判性视角，强调了对算法进行社会化审计的紧迫性。

title: Adaptive Krylov Methods for Low-Rank Exponential Integrators
