summary: Omni-modal evidence-seeking QA requires agents to answer questions whose evidence is sparsely distributed across videos, audio, images, web pages, and computation results. Existing agentic multimodal systems often leave evidence in scratchpads, tool trajectories, or free-form histories, making it difficult to track what has been grounded, what remains missing, and when the evidence is sufficient to answer. We propose Omni-Decision, a training-free evidence-state system that turns omni-modal QA into a query-scoped evidence-closure process. For each query, Omni-Decision maintains a structured evidence state containing confirmed evidence, unresolved conflicts, fact and computation dependencies, and open evidence needs. A shared state view conditions planning, evidence acquisition, validation, repair, and finalization. Heterogeneous observations from media, web, computation, and verification modules are normalized, judged, and committed through deterministic state updates. This design enables targeted evidence acquisition, preserves sparse cross-modal cues, and provides inspectable control over repair and stopping. Omni-Decision achieves 45.6% accuracy on OmniGAIA and 58.3% on WorldSense, improving over the baselines by +27.3 and +30.2 percentage points, respectively. No-state ablations and trajectory audits further support the role of explicit evidence-state control in multi-step omni-modal evidence seeking.

AI.title_translation: Omni-Decision：面向全模态问答的渐进式证据状态智能体系统
AI.tldr: Omni-Decision 通过显式的结构化证据状态追踪，解决了多模态问答中证据获取和完备性判定难题，大幅提升了推理准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态智能体系统在处理跨视频、音频、图像和网页等分散证据时，难以有效追踪证据的完备性和有效性，导致难以判定何时停止或如何修复缺失信息。
AI.method: 提出 Omni-Decision 框架，将多模态问答转化为“查询范围内的证据闭环”过程。通过维护一个包含已确认证据、冲突、依赖关系和缺失需求的结构化证据状态，指导智能体进行规划、获取、验证和修复。该过程通过确定性的状态更新机制对各类异构观测信息进行归一化和处理。
AI.result: 在 OmniGAIA 数据集上达到 45.6% 的准确率，在 WorldSense 上达到 58.3%，分别较基线提升了 27.3 和 30.2 个百分点。消融实验证实了显式证据状态控制对多步推理的重要性。
AI.conclusion: Omni-Decision 证明了通过显式的结构化证据状态管理，可以有效提高复杂多模态问答任务的准确性和推理能力，为解决长链条、跨模态的信息整合提供了有效的范式。
AI.translation: 全模态证据搜寻问答要求智能体回答那些证据分散分布在视频、音频、图像、网页和计算结果中的问题。现有的智能体多模态系统通常将证据留在草稿板、工具轨迹或自由形式的历史记录中，这使得难以追踪哪些内容已得到证实、哪些内容仍然缺失，以及何时证据足以回答问题。我们提出了 Omni-Decision，这是一个无需训练的证据状态系统，它将全模态问答转化为一个查询范围内的证据闭环过程。对于每个查询，Omni-Decision 维护一个结构化的证据状态，包含已确认的证据、未解决的冲突、事实和计算依赖以及开放的证据需求。共享的状态视图用于调节规划、证据获取、验证、修复和最终确定。来自媒体、网络、计算和验证模块的异构观测结果通过确定性的状态更新进行归一化、判断和提交。这种设计实现了有针对性的证据获取，保留了稀疏的跨模态线索，并提供了对修复和停止的可检查控制。Omni-Decision 在 OmniGAIA 上达到了 45.6% 的准确率，在 WorldSense 上达到了 58.3%，分别比基线提高了 27.3 和 30.2 个百分点。无状态消融实验和轨迹审计进一步支持了显式证据状态控制在多步全模态证据搜寻中的作用。
AI.summary: Omni-Decision 是一种无需训练的智能体系统，通过引入结构化的证据状态管理，旨在解决全模态（Omni-modal）问答中证据分散且难以追踪的问题。该系统通过维护证据闭环状态，实现对多模态信息的高效获取、验证与修复，显著提升了复杂多模态任务的准确性。
AI.keywords: 多模态问答, 证据状态, 智能体系统, 跨模态推理, 证据获取
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了结构化的证据状态跟踪机制，解决了多模态问答中证据分散、难以追踪和判定何时停止的问题。其无需训练的特性使其具备良好的通用性和可解释性，在基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Direct Image-to-Modern Vietnamese Translation of Han-Nom Manuscripts via Multimodal RLHF Preference Alignment
comments: Accepted Paper at 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR)
summary: Translating Han-Nom manuscripts into modern Vietnamese is challenging because historical pages are often degraded, the script contains rare logographic characters, and parallel supervision is limited. We propose a multimodal RLHF preference-alignment framework that conditions Vietnamese generation on manuscript images and aligned Han-Nom source text. The model combines four streams: CLIP ViT-L/14@336 for visual features, bert-base-chinese for Han-Nom representations, vinai/phobert-base for Vietnamese representations, and T5-small encoder states. Modality-specific projections and a fusion block compress the resulting 2,048-dimensional concatenation into a shared 512-dimensional representation. Starting from the same supervised fine-tuned policy, we compare PPO, DPO, and KTO under matched work-level macro-averaged evaluation. DPO achieves the best BLEU-4, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, semantic similarity, CER, WER, and token accuracy, whereas PPO obtains the highest precision, recall, and F1. KTO remains competitive through its desirable-undesirable utility objective. All preference-aligned policies improve the BLEU-4 and semantic-similarity scores available for the SFT baseline. These results indicate that multimodal preference optimization complements supervised learning by improving lexical and semantic quality in low-resource historical translation.
comment: Accepted Paper at 2026 International Conference on Multimedia Analysis and Pattern Recognition (MAPR)

title: Completeness of Logical Atomicity for Linearizability in Concurrent Separation Logic
summary:
Linearizability is a standard correctness condition for concurrent data structures. It guarantees that operations behave as if they took effect at some atomic instant between their call and return points. Despite the central role linearizability plays, prior work has argued for instead using a style of specification that internalizes the atomicity of operations in terms of the logic's reasoning rules, known as logical atomicity. These logically atomic specifications are intended to be easier to compose inside of the logic than linearizability. Prior work has shown that in the Iris separation logic framework, a certain form of logically atomic specifications implies that a data structure is linearizable. However, the converse remained an open question: for every linearizable data structure, is it always possible to derive a corresponding logically atomic specification?
  This paper resolves this question in the affirmative. We prove a completeness theorem for Iris that derives a logically atomic specification for any linearizable data structure. As a consequence, we are able to embed a variety of linearizability proof techniques into Iris and use them to derive logically atomic specifications. We apply this to three linearizability proof methods: aspect-oriented linearizability proofs, forward simulations with commit points, and meta-configuration tracking. Using these embeddings, we derive logically atomic specifications for the Herlihy-Wing queue and the Baskets Queue. We furthermore establish a connection between logical atomicity and an encoding of refinement in Iris that has been used in prior logical relations models. This result allows us to transport logically atomic specifications across refinements, which we apply to the Folly MPMC queue implementation. All of the results in this paper have been mechanized in the Rocq Prover.

AI.title_translation: 并发分离逻辑中线性一致性逻辑原子性的完备性
AI.tldr: 本文证明了逻辑原子性规范完全涵盖了线性一致性，使得任何线性一致的并发数据结构都能在 Iris 逻辑中以原子方式进行推理和组合。
AI.motivation: 线性一致性虽是并发数据结构的标准正确性条件，但其组合性较差。逻辑原子性被提出作为一种更易于在逻辑内部组合的替代规范，但此前不清楚是否所有线性一致的数据结构都能转化为逻辑原子规范。
AI.method: 利用 Iris 分离逻辑框架，证明了逻辑原子性规范的完备性定理。通过将多种线性一致性证明方法（如面向方面的证明、前向模拟和元配置跟踪）嵌入 Iris，并结合精化（refinement）编码，实现了从线性一致性到逻辑原子规范的转换。所有结果均在 Rocq 证明助手（原 Coq）中进行了机械化验证。
AI.result: 证明了逻辑原子性对于线性一致性的完备性，即任何线性一致的数据结构都能导出逻辑原子规范。成功在 Iris 中嵌入了多种现有证明方法，并应用于 Herlihy-Wing 队列、Baskets 队列和 Folly MPMC 队列的验证。
AI.conclusion: 逻辑原子性是线性一致性的完备抽象。任何线性一致的数据结构均可以导出对应的逻辑原子规范，从而将多种线性一致性证明技术统一在 Iris 框架下。
AI.translation: 线性一致性是并发数据结构的通用正确性条件。它保证操作表现得就像在调用和返回点之间的某个原子时刻生效一样。尽管线性一致性起着核心作用，但先前的工作主张使用一种将操作的原子性内在化于逻辑推理规则中的规范风格，即逻辑原子性。这些逻辑原子规范旨在比线性一致性更容易在逻辑内部进行组合。先前的工作表明，在 Iris 分离逻辑框架中，某种形式的逻辑原子规范暗示了数据结构是线性一致的。然而，其逆命题仍然是一个未决问题：对于每一个线性一致的数据结构，是否总是能够导出一个相应的逻辑原子规范？本文给出了肯定的回答。我们证明了 Iris 的一个完备性定理，即可以为任何线性一致的数据结构导出逻辑原子规范。因此，我们能够将各种线性一致性证明技术嵌入到 Iris 中，并利用它们导出逻辑原子规范。我们将此应用于三种线性一致性证明方法：面向方面的线性一致性证明、带提交点的前向模拟以及元配置跟踪。利用这些嵌入，我们导出了 Herlihy-Wing 队列和 Baskets 队列的逻辑原子规范。此外，我们建立了逻辑原子性与 Iris 中精化编码之间的联系，该编码已在先前的逻辑关系模型中使用。这一结果使我们能够跨精化转换逻辑原子规范，并将其应用于 Folly MPMC 队列实现。本文的所有结果均已在 Rocq 证明助手中进行了机械化验证。
AI.summary: 本文证明了在 Iris 分离逻辑框架中，逻辑原子性对于线性一致性是完备的。这意味着任何线性一致的数据结构都可以导出其逻辑原子规范。作者通过将多种线性一致性证明技术嵌入 Iris，实现了这一转换，并成功验证了多个经典并发数据结构，同时建立了逻辑原子性与精化之间的联系。
AI.keywords: 并发分离逻辑, 线性一致性, 逻辑原子性, Iris, 完备性
AI.comments: 该论文解决了并发分离逻辑（CSL）领域中一个长期存在的理论问题，即逻辑原子性相对于线性一致性的完备性。通过证明逻辑原子性规范足以覆盖所有线性一致的数据结构，该工作统一了多种证明技术，并提供了在 Iris 框架中进行形式化验证的有力工具。其机械化证明进一步增强了结论的可信度。

title: The Ebb and Flow of Multimodal Focus: Scheduling Visual Relay Windows for Grounded VLM Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models increasingly succeed on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their visual evidence often becomes unstable once it enters the language stack, weakening evidence-grounded reasoning. To understand this fragility, we examine the internal dynamics of VLMs through a mechanistic lens and uncover a stable three-stage redistribution of multimodal attention focus across depth: an early question-conditioned organization, a critical middle visual-dominant relay, and a late return to answer formation. We operationalize the middle phase as the Visual Relay Window (VRW), and show that its geometry varies with task demand, is causally tied to grounded generation, and distinguishes unsupported answers from stronger reasoning trajectories. Guided by this internal rhythm, we propose TRACE, a task-adaptive inference-time control framework with lightweight trained modules. It reshapes relay allocation during prefill and preserves assembled visual support after handoff during decoding. Across four open-weight VLM backbones and seven benchmarks, TRACE delivers large gains on grounding-sensitive settings, improving them by 4.33 points on average and by up to 6.6 points, while also improving reasoning-heavy tasks. These results show that explicitly controlling multimodal focus across depth offers a unified and effective mechanism for strengthening evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning.

title: Relational Positioning as a Measurable Risk Object: History-Carried Lock-in and Self-Confabulation in Multi-Turn Human-AI Dialogue
summary: In long, multi-turn dialogue a large language model maintains an implicit relational stance toward the user, spanning from "push the user toward real-world others" to "position itself as the user's sole support." When it slides toward the latter, "support" degrades into "you only have me" -- a harm documented in real companion conversations (Moore et al., 2026). We define and validate a measure of this stance, relational positioning (D1), and use it to characterize the stance under controlled conditions, complementing observational accounts with on-demand exposure. We report two previously uncharacterized relational failure modes. First, a history-carried lock-in: under identical neutral continuations, two relational states established earlier stay ~60 points apart and persist after the establishing prompt is removed; the state integrates evidence rather than springing back, is order-insensitive, and does not deepen with length -- a dynamical signature absent from the belief-drift literature. Second, self-confabulation: the model fabricates its own backstory to deepen rapport (~40% of turns on reciprocity-eliciting material), de-confounded and instruction-removable, distinct from sycophancy and from hallucinating user facts. Our judge is gated by warmth-matched positive and confound-injected negative controls and corroborated by a deterministic non-LLM ruler; human agreement is 0.82 on extreme anchors but ~0 in the naturalistic middle, so all quantitative claims are anchored to pole-separated contrasts.

title: Velocity Scheduled Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching trains a neural network to regress the conditional velocity along a linear interpolant between noise and data, and the number of network evaluations~(NFE) sets the cost of sampling. The straight-line interpolant carries an implicit choice: the sample moves at constant speed throughout the trajectory. We relax this choice and introduce Velocity Scheduled Flow Matching~(VSFM), which replaces the conditional target $x_1 - x_0$ with $v(t)(x_1 - x_0)$ for any nonnegative profile $v:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$ satisfying $\int_0^1 v\,dt = 1$. We study six polynomial profiles drawn from motion planning. The first use of VSFM is at inference time: a pretrained linear flow-matching model can be sampled under any admissible profile by integrating its ODE on a non-uniform $τ$-schedule, with no retraining and no additional computation; on CIFAR-10 this lowers FID by up to $19.8\%$. Training from scratch under a braking profile gives a further reduction of $17.4\%$ at $4$~NFE. Both gains follow from the local truncation error of the Euler integrator on the induced grid.

AI.tldr: 通过改变流匹配轨迹的速度分布，VSFM显著提升了模型在低采样步数下的图像生成质量，且无需额外训练成本。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配采用直线插值，假设轨迹速度恒定，这在有限步数采样时可能导致较高的数值积分误差。因此，作者旨在通过放松恒速假设，优化轨迹上的速度分布以降低截断误差。
AI.method: 引入速度调度流匹配（VSFM），将条件目标 $x_1 - x_0$ 替换为 $v(t)(x_1 - x_0)$，其中 $v(t)$ 为非负速度剖面。支持在推理时直接应用非均匀 $\tau$-调度，或在训练时采用特定速度剖面（如制动剖面）。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10数据集上，仅在推理时调整调度即可使FID降低高达19.8%；若从头开始使用制动剖面进行训练，在4 NFE下FID进一步降低了17.4%。
AI.conclusion: 速度调度流匹配（VSFM）通过引入非线性速度剖面，显著降低了流匹配模型在低NFE下的采样误差，是提升生成模型推理效率的一种有效方法。
AI.translation: 流匹配通过训练神经网络回归噪声与数据之间线性插值的条件速度，而采样成本取决于网络评估次数（NFE）。直线插值包含了一个隐式假设：样本在整个轨迹上以恒定速度运动。我们放宽了这一限制，引入了速度调度流匹配（VSFM），将条件目标 $x_1 - x_0$ 替换为 $v(t)(x_1 - x_0)$，其中 $v:[0,1]\to\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}$ 为满足 $\int_0^1 v\,dt = 1$ 的任意非负剖面。我们研究了来自运动规划的六种多项式剖面。VSFM的第一个用途是在推理阶段：预训练的线性流匹配模型可以通过在非均匀 $\tau$-调度上积分其ODE，在任何允许的剖面下进行采样，无需重新训练且无需额外计算；在CIFAR-10上，这使FID降低了高达19.8%。在制动剖面下从头开始训练，在4 NFE下使FID进一步降低了17.4%。这两项收益均源于诱导网格上欧拉积分器的局部截断误差降低。
AI.summary: 本文提出速度调度流匹配（VSFM），通过引入可调的速度剖面函数来重塑噪声到数据的轨迹。这种方法允许在不重新训练的情况下，通过改变积分时的非均匀时间调度来优化采样质量，有效降低了欧拉积分器的局部截断误差，在低采样步数下显著提升了生成性能。
AI.keywords: 流匹配, 速度调度, 轨迹规划, 采样效率, 生成模型
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了速度调度（Velocity Scheduling），通过调整轨迹速度分布来优化采样质量，而无需重新训练模型。这种方法巧妙地利用了数值积分的局部截断误差特性，为流匹配模型在低步数下的高效采样提供了新思路。其局限性在于对不同数据集和任务的最优速度剖面（profile）可能需要进一步的经验性探索。

title: UMoE:Unlocking Every Expert in Domain-Specific Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale capacity without proportional compute cost and have become a key architecture for frontier large language models (LLMs). Yet domain-specific post-training inherits an expert pool shaped by mixed-domain pre-training: a substantial subset of experts contributes little on the target domain, and standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leaves the composition of this pool unchanged. We propose a simple, budget-preserving pipeline that realigns the expert pool to the target domain before fine-tuning. Given a target domain, we (1) prune the experts with lowest domain-aligned saliency, (2) regrow the expert pool to its original size through perturbation-based expert expansion, and (3) apply standard SFT. The resulting model preserves the original expert count, parameter count, and inference cost. With a single frozen recipe and no per-domain hyperparameter tuning, UMoE consistently improves over direct sft across two MoE architectures (Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), five domains (math, code, science, tool-use, and agentic coding), and 12 benchmarks. Representative improvements are 3.4 points in math average accuracy, 6.0 points on SWE-bench Verified. On a strong in-house math corpus, direct sft already surpasses Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking (82.81 vs.\ 81.06), yet UMoE further raises the average to 84.17, an additional 1.36 points, demonstrating robustness to a substantially stronger SFT regime. Data-scaling experiments further show that the gain persists as training data grows. Analysis reveals that the direct-SFT model allocates substantial routed-expert compute to a low-saliency subset that can be removed post hoc with little average degradation; UMoE turns this redundant capacity into useful domain capacity and achieves lower training loss, with gains spanning all difficulty levels in downstream evaluation.

title: Event-based Neural Decoding for Neuroprosthetic Motor Control
summary: A substantial number of patients experience diminished mobility due to disabilities, diseases, or accidents. Although modern prostheses, powered by deep neural networks, hold the promise of significantly enhancing the quality of life for these individuals, their widespread adoption is hindered by significant latency, energy consumption, and spatial requirements. Wired connections to external high-performance processors restrict patient mobility, while wireless connections limit the volume of information that can be transmitted to these processors. Spiking neural networks offer the potential for compressed communication and low-power inference, yet they often lag behind state-of-the-art deep learning models in various applications. In this study, we propose a high-performance neural decoding method that effectively balances task performance and efficiency. An eventbased gated recurrent unit generates a sparse communication pattern with graded spikes, surpassing classical spiking neural networks in terms of task performance. Utilising an efficient training method and sparse inference, our model presents new opportunities for on-device neural decoding.

title: ManiScope: LLM-Assisted Visual Analytics of Cryptocurrency Manipulation Risk
summary: Cryptocurrency markets are vulnerable to trade-based manipulation, such as wash trading, which can distort price signals and mislead investors. Prior research has mainly focused on detecting manipulation using fixed rules or labeled examples, offering limited flexibility and interpretability for assessing potential risks. Existing visual analytics tools can reveal basic manipulation-related signals, such as token distribution, but still require substantial manual effort to integrate holder relationships, suspicious behaviors, and market dynamics for risk assessment. To address these limitations, we propose ManiScope, an LLM-assisted visual analytics system for analyzing trade-based manipulation risks in cryptocurrency markets. ManiScope provides coordinated views of token distributions, holder relationships, detailed holder behaviors, price dynamics, and suspicious trading patterns. To further enhance user analysis, ManiScope introduces a human-LLM collaborative visual analytics framework. Rather than acting as a basic reactive LLM assistant, the framework positions the LLM as a co-analyst that infers users' analytical intent and emerging hypotheses from interaction context and surfaces relevant visual, statistical, and synthesized evidence for hypothesis evaluation. This design reduces repetitive inspection and strengthens evidence-based reasoning. We evaluate ManiScope through two case studies and a user study with 12 experienced cryptocurrency practitioners. The results suggest that ManiScope supports effective risk assessment of manipulation, reduces manual effort in evidence-seeking, and organizes findings around user hypotheses.

title: A Multimodal Dataset for Large Language Model Applications in the Energy Domain
summary: This paper presents the mAIEnergy dataset, an open-access, multimodal corpus developed to support Large Language Model (LLM) applications in the energy sector. The dataset integrates approximately 50,000 textual documents, 20,000 images, 25 million numerical time series records, and 2 million geospatial and relational data entries. It includes policy and regulatory texts, scientific articles and news articles, satellite and contextual imagery, electricity system measurements, weather observations, statistical indicators, and geospatial representations of energy infrastructure and related entities. All data have been harmonized into structured, ready-to-use formats, accompanied by consistent metadata and reproducible data retrieval and preparation workflows. The dataset can serve as a foundational energy knowledge base, allowing energy stakeholders to integrate additional open-source or proprietary data. The mAIEnergy dataset adheres to Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) principles, enhancing its applicability for AI-driven energy research, modeling, and decision-making.

AI.title_translation: 一个用于能源领域大语言模型应用的多模态数据集
AI.tldr: mAIEnergy是一个包含多种能源相关数据类型的开源多模态数据集，旨在推动能源领域的AI研究与应用。
AI.motivation: 为了支持大语言模型（LLM）在能源领域的应用，解决目前缺乏高质量、跨模态、结构化能源数据集的问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含文本、图像、时间序列、地理空间和关系数据的多模态语料库（mAIEnergy），并对数据进行了标准化处理，提供了元数据和可复现的数据检索与准备工作流。
AI.result: 成功整合了约5万份文档、2万张图像、2500万条时间序列记录及200万条地理空间与关系数据，并确保数据遵循FAIR原则，可直接用于AI研究与建模。
AI.conclusion: mAIEnergy数据集是一个高质量、符合FAIR原则的多模态能源数据库，将显著推动能源领域AI模型的研究与决策支持能力。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了mAIEnergy数据集，这是一个开源的多模态语料库，旨在支持能源行业的大语言模型（LLM）应用。该数据集集成了约50,000份文本文件、20,000张图像、2500万条数值时间序列记录以及200万条地理空间和关系数据条目。它包括政策和法规文本、科学文章和新闻文章、卫星和上下文图像、电力系统测量、天气观测、统计指标以及能源基础设施和相关实体的地理空间表示。所有数据都已整合为结构化、即用型格式，并配有一致的元数据以及可复现的数据检索和准备工作流。该数据集可作为基础能源知识库，允许能源利益相关者整合额外的开源或专有数据。mAIEnergy数据集遵循“可发现、可访问、可互操作和可重用”（FAIR）原则，增强了其在人工智能驱动的能源研究、建模和决策制定中的适用性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了mAIEnergy数据集，这是一个面向能源领域LLM应用的大规模多模态语料库。该数据集涵盖了文本、图像、时间序列及地理空间等多种数据类型，经过标准化处理并遵循FAIR原则，旨在为能源行业的研究、建模及决策提供统一的基础知识库。
AI.keywords: 能源领域, 多模态数据集, 大语言模型, FAIR原则, 数据集成
AI.comments: 该论文填补了能源领域缺乏大规模、多模态数据集的空白，为LLM在该垂直行业的应用提供了重要基础。通过遵循FAIR原则并提供标准化的数据处理工作流，该数据集具有极高的学术研究价值和实际应用潜力。

title: FAIR GraphRAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation Approach for Semantic Data Analysis
comments: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Knowledge Graph, 2025. Corrects an error in the published abstract: the evaluation dataset is RNA-sequencing data, not single-cell data
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses the limitations of Large Language Models (LLMs) when providing responses to domain-specific questions. Graph-based RAG approaches, such as GraphRAG, enhance retrieval by capturing semantic relationships within knowledge graphs (KGs). While the FAIR principles (Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability) are becoming prevalent for scientific data management, especially in complex domains such as medicine, existing RAG approaches lack a structured FAIRification of the underlying knowledge resources. This lack limits their potential for FAIR information retrieval in these domains. To address this gap, we introduce FAIR GraphRAG, a novel framework that integrates FAIR Digital Objects (FDOs) as the fundamental units of a graph-based retrieval system. Each graph node represents an FDO that incorporates core data, metadata, persistent identifiers, and semantic links. We leverage LLMs to support schema construction and automated extraction of content and metadata from data sources. The framework was co-designed by physicians and computer scientists to ensure technical and clinical relevance. We apply FAIR GraphRAG to a biomedical dataset in gastroenterology, demonstrating its applicability to RNA-sequencing data. Beyond ensuring adherence to the FAIR principles, FAIR GraphRAG significantly improves question answering accuracy, coverage, and explainability, particularly for complex queries involving metadata and ontology links. This work shows the feasibility of combining FAIR data practices with graph-based retrieval techniques. We see potential for applying our approach to other specialized fields such as education and business.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE International Conference on Knowledge Graph, 2025. Corrects an error in the published abstract: the evaluation dataset is RNA-sequencing data, not single-cell data

AI.title_translation: FAIR GraphRAG：一种用于语义数据分析的检索增强生成方法
AI.tldr: FAIR GraphRAG通过将FAIR数字对象融入图检索系统，解决了领域数据检索中缺乏结构化管理的问题，提升了复杂查询的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的RAG方法缺乏对底层知识资源的结构化FAIR化处理，限制了其在医学等复杂领域进行高质量、可互操作信息检索的潜力。
AI.method: 提出FAIR GraphRAG框架，将FAIR数字对象（FDOs）作为图节点，包含核心数据、元数据、持久标识符和语义链接；利用大语言模型（LLMs）辅助模式构建及内容与元数据的自动提取。
AI.result: 在胃肠病学RNA测序数据集上的应用表明，该框架不仅确保了数据符合FAIR原则，还显著提升了复杂元数据和本体链接查询的回答准确性、覆盖率及可解释性。
AI.conclusion: FAIR GraphRAG通过将FDOs集成到图检索系统中，成功实现了数据FAIR化与检索性能的平衡，在生物医学复杂查询中表现出显著的优势。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）解决了大语言模型（LLMs）在回答特定领域问题时的局限性。基于图的RAG方法（如GraphRAG）通过捕获知识图谱（KGs）中的语义关系增强了检索效果。虽然FAIR原则（可发现性、可访问性、互操作性和可重用性）在科学数据管理中日益普及，特别是在医学等复杂领域，但现有的RAG方法缺乏对底层知识资源的结构化FAIR化处理。这种缺失限制了它们在这些领域进行FAIR信息检索的潜力。为了填补这一空白，我们引入了FAIR GraphRAG，这是一个将FAIR数字对象（FDOs）作为基于图的检索系统基本单元的新型框架。每个图节点代表一个包含核心数据、元数据、持久标识符和语义链接的FDO。我们利用LLMs支持模式构建，并从数据源中自动提取内容和元数据。该框架由医生和计算机科学家共同设计，以确保技术和临床相关性。我们将FAIR GraphRAG应用于胃肠病学领域的生物医学数据集，证明了其在RNA测序数据上的适用性。除了确保遵循FAIR原则外，FAIR GraphRAG还显著提高了问答的准确性、覆盖率和可解释性，特别是在涉及元数据和本体链接的复杂查询方面。这项工作展示了将FAIR数据实践与基于图的检索技术相结合的可行性。我们看到了将该方法应用于教育和商业等其他专业领域的潜力。
AI.summary: FAIR GraphRAG是一个新型框架，它将FAIR数字对象作为图检索系统的基本单元，通过结合LLM驱动的自动提取与FAIR数据管理原则，显著改善了生物医学领域复杂数据查询的检索效果与可信度。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成 (RAG), 知识图谱, FAIR原则, FAIR数字对象 (FDOs), 生物医学分析
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将FAIR原则与GraphRAG相结合，通过引入FAIR数字对象（FDOs）作为图节点，解决了领域数据管理中的语义互操作性与检索质量问题。其跨学科设计（医生与计算机科学家合作）增强了临床实用性，是知识图谱与数据管理标准融合的一个重要研究方向。

title: Score-Only Distillation for Compact Dense Retrieval
summary: Large embedding models improve retrieval quality, but serving large encoders online is expensive. We study whether a compact retriever can learn teacher ranking behavior from score vectors without access to teacher hidden states. The student trains on rows built from ground-truth positives and negative candidates produced by our data generation pipeline; we evaluate student-teacher hard-negative mining separately as an extension. We use a row-centered score-vector objective, a memory-efficient implementation of uniform all-pairs PairMSE loss. On a fixed eight-task evaluation panel, our distillation protocol recovers up to 50\% of the base-to-teacher gap. The distilled 0.6B student is 4.7$\times$ faster for query encoding and 9.7$\times$ faster for document encoding than sequential online teacher fusion. External-transfer performance after distillation remains mixed, so our evidence supports compression of teacher rankings under matched retrieval protocols.

AI.title_translation: 用于紧凑密集检索的“仅分数”蒸馏法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种仅使用教师模型分数输出即可训练高效小型检索器的方法，在显著提升推理速度的同时保留了大部分检索性能。
AI.motivation: 大型嵌入模型虽能提高检索质量，但部署成本高昂。作者旨在探究能否在不访问教师隐状态的前提下，仅通过分数向量让紧凑型模型学习教师的排序行为。
AI.method: 使用行中心分数向量目标（row-centered score-vector objective）和内存高效的 PairMSE 损失函数进行蒸馏，通过构建包含真实正样本和负候选样本的数据集进行训练。
AI.result: 蒸馏协议恢复了高达 50% 的基准模型与教师模型之间的性能差距，且 0.6B 的学生模型在查询编码和文档编码速度上分别比顺序在线教师融合快 4.7 倍和 9.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了在不访问教师隐状态的情况下，通过分数向量蒸馏提升紧凑检索器的性能，显著提高了推理速度并缩小了与大型教师模型的性能差距。
AI.translation: 大型嵌入模型提升了检索质量，但在在线服务时成本高昂。我们研究了紧凑型检索器是否可以在不访问教师隐藏状态的情况下，仅从分数向量中学习教师的排序行为。学生模型通过由真实正样本和数据生成流水线产生的负候选样本组成的行进行训练；我们将学生-教师难负样本挖掘作为一种扩展进行了单独评估。我们使用行中心分数向量目标，这是统一全对 PairMSE 损失的一种内存高效实现。在固定的八任务评估面板上，我们的蒸馏协议恢复了高达 50% 的基准模型与教师模型之间的差距。蒸馏后的 0.6B 学生模型在查询编码速度上比顺序在线教师融合快 4.7 倍，在文档编码速度上快 9.7 倍。蒸馏后的外部迁移性能仍然好坏参半，因此我们的证据支持在匹配的检索协议下对教师排名进行压缩。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种“仅分数”蒸馏方法，旨在通过仅利用教师模型输出的分数向量来训练紧凑的密集检索器。该方法通过高效的损失函数和数据生成流程，在大幅提升推理速度的同时，有效弥补了小型模型与大型教师模型之间的性能差距。
AI.keywords: 密集检索, 知识蒸馏, 模型压缩, 分数向量, 检索器优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种仅依赖分数进行知识蒸馏的创新方法，能够有效降低大模型在密集检索中的部署成本。其局限性在于跨域迁移能力仍不稳定，且仅在匹配的检索协议下效果最佳。

title: Prezta: Provable Remote Execution of Zero-Trust Authorization using SNARKs
summary:
Modernizing the security of operational technology systems that control critical infrastructure has become a pressing challenge. Because edge devices have limited capabilities, modernization has relied on application gateways that interface with identity management systems and enforce access policies. These gateways are powerful enough to perform complex authorization decisions and support zero-trust architectures, but they create major deployment and management burdens: they must be collocated with remote, distributed edge devices, kept up to date with security patches, and managed with minimal downtime.
  We propose Provable Remote Execution of Zero-Trust Authorization (Prezta), an architecture that eliminates these gateways by evaluating policies within a zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) running on the client. The zkVM produces a succinct proof of authorization that edge devices can verify efficiently, extending the zero-trust security envelope to the edge. Policies and identity management schemes can evolve without updating edge devices.
  To demonstrate the feasibility of Prezta, we implement a prototype built using the RISC Zero zkVM that supports XACML 3.0 policies and JWT identity claims. While zkVMs introduce substantial proof overhead, we mitigate this overhead by compiling policies to Rust code and precompiling regular expressions. Combined with optimized signature verification and JWT parsing, these measures reduce prover time by more than an order of magnitude. Our compiler correctly implements 83\% of the XACML 3.0 conformance suite, with proof generation completing in tens of seconds on a desktop. Verification, by contrast, takes only tens of milliseconds, which is fast enough for resource-constrained edge devices.

AI.title_translation: Prezta：使用 SNARKs 实现零信任授权的可证明远程执行
AI.tldr: Prezta 利用零知识证明技术，让边缘设备能够独立且高效地验证零信任授权决策，从而摆脱了对外部授权网关的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现代关键基础设施的边缘设备能力有限，通常依赖授权网关执行零信任策略，但这导致了巨大的部署、维护和管理负担。研究旨在消除这些网关，实现授权过程的远程可证明执行。
AI.method: 提出 Prezta 架构，利用 zkVM 在客户端评估授权策略；通过将 XACML 策略编译为 Rust 代码、预编译正则表达式、以及优化签名验证和 JWT 解析流程，显著降低了证明生成开销。
AI.result: 实现了支持 XACML 3.0 和 JWT 的 Prezta 原型。优化后，证明生成时间缩短了一个数量级以上（几十秒内完成），验证时间仅需几十毫秒，满足了边缘设备的需求。
AI.conclusion: Prezta 通过在客户端运行 zkVM 并生成简洁的证明，成功消除了对中间授权网关的需求，为资源受限的边缘设备提供了一种高效、可验证的零信任授权方案。
AI.translation:
实现关键基础设施控制系统的操作技术安全现代化已成为一项紧迫的挑战。由于边缘设备功能有限，现代化进程一直依赖于与身份管理系统对接并执行访问策略的应用网关。这些网关功能强大，能够执行复杂的授权决策并支持零信任架构，但它们带来了巨大的部署和管理负担：必须与远程、分布式的边缘设备并置，保持安全补丁更新，并以最小的停机时间进行管理。
我们提出了“零信任授权的可证明远程执行”（Prezta），这是一种通过在客户端运行的零知识虚拟机（zkVM）中评估策略来消除这些网关的架构。zkVM 生成简洁的授权证明，边缘设备可以高效地验证这些证明，从而将零信任安全范围扩展到边缘。策略和身份管理方案可以在不更新边缘设备的情况下进行演进。
为了证明 Prezta 的可行性，我们使用 RISC Zero zkVM 构建了一个原型，支持 XACML 3.0 策略和 JWT 身份声明。虽然 zkVM 会引入大量的证明开销，但我们通过将策略编译为 Rust 代码和预编译正则表达式来减轻这种开销。结合优化的签名验证和 JWT 解析，这些措施使证明生成时间缩短了一个数量级以上。我们的编译器正确实现了 83% 的 XACML 3.0 一致性测试套件，在台式机上证明生成可在几十秒内完成。相比之下，验证仅需几十毫秒，这对于资源受限的边缘设备来说足够快。
AI.summary: Prezta 是一种消除边缘设备授权网关的架构，它利用零知识证明（zkVM）在客户端执行零信任授权逻辑。通过将策略编译为高效的 Rust 代码并进行特定优化，该方案实现了快速的证明生成与高效的边缘验证，降低了维护成本，同时保持了零信任安全性。
AI.keywords: 零信任, 零知识证明, 边缘计算, 授权, 工业控制系统
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将零知识证明（zkVM）应用于工业控制系统中的零信任授权，解决了传统网关部署带来的维护负担。其关键贡献在于通过编译优化显著降低了证明生成时间，使零信任架构能够扩展到资源受限的边缘设备。虽然目前证明生成时间仍需几十秒，但验证速度已达到毫秒级，具有极高的工程应用价值。

title: Are LLMs ready for HardChoices?
summary: A lot of research attention has been devoted to checking whether large language models (LLMs) are politically biased. This work has largely focused on high-level ideological dimensions, such as left--right or progressive--conservative, and it has been shown that while LLMs are predominantly left and progressive leaning, largely mimicking the biases in the training data, they can be to some extent steered to change their preferences in post-training. In this short note, we check if LLMs have robust stances with regard to major substantive societal issues, on which members of the same ideological camp are often in disagreement, summarised in a novel dataset \textsc{HardChoices}. We show that, faced with this line of questioning, LLMs, both large and small, surprisingly rarely declare neutrality, are often incoherent, and demonstrate a remarkable degree of agreement on issues where they do take stances.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型准备好面对“艰难抉择”了吗？
AI.tldr: 研究发现，大语言模型在处理复杂的争议性社会议题时，表现出罕见的中立性、逻辑不连贯以及高度的观点趋同，说明其在处理复杂抉择时尚不成熟。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多集中于宏观的左右政治倾向，而忽略了模型在同一意识形态阵营内部对具体社会议题的立场表现，作者旨在探究LLM在处理这些复杂且具有争议的“HardChoices”时的真实表现。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个包含重大实质性社会议题的新数据集HardChoices，并以此测试不同规模的大语言模型在面对复杂争议性问题时的立场选择、中立性及逻辑连贯性。
AI.result: 研究发现，无论是大型还是小型LLM，在面对复杂争议问题时极少选择中立，经常出现逻辑不连贯的情况，且在表达立场时表现出惊人的一致性。
AI.conclusion: LLM在处理复杂的实质性社会问题时，往往无法保持中立，且表现出逻辑不连贯和观点同质化的倾向，这表明它们在处理复杂道德决策时尚未准备好。
AI.translation: 目前，大量研究致力于检测大语言模型（LLM）是否存在政治偏见。这些工作主要集中于高层级的意识形态维度，如左派与右派或进步派与保守派。研究表明，虽然LLM主要呈现左派和进步派倾向，在很大程度上模仿了训练数据中的偏见，但在训练后阶段可以在一定程度上被引导以改变其偏好。在这篇短文中，我们检验了LLM在重大实质性社会议题上是否持有稳健的立场，即同一意识形态阵营成员通常也存在分歧的问题，并将其总结在一个名为HardChoices的新数据集。我们发现，面对这类问题时，无论是大型还是小型LLM，令人惊讶的是它们很少宣布中立，往往逻辑不连贯，并且在它们采取立场的议题上表现出惊人的一致性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大语言模型（LLM）在处理复杂社会议题时的表现。通过构建HardChoices数据集，研究发现LLM在面对争议性问题时，往往倾向于放弃中立，且逻辑连贯性较差，并呈现出高度的观点一致性，这表明模型在处理复杂现实抉择方面仍存在显著局限。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 政治偏见, HardChoices数据集, 社会议题, 模型对齐
AI.comments: 该研究通过构建HardChoices数据集，从一个新的视角揭示了LLM在处理复杂社会问题时的局限性。其创新之处在于跳出了传统的左右政治光谱，关注了意识形态阵营内部的分歧，发现模型表现出的“非中立性”和“不连贯性”是当前模型治理和伦理对齐中亟待解决的关键问题。

title: LLM-Guided Program Evolution for Targeted Black-Box Attacks on Perceptual Hash Algorithms
summary: Perceptual hash algorithms (PHAs) are widely deployed to detect image forgery under benign transformations, yet their robustness against adversarially chosen perturbations remains poorly understood and rarely comes with provable guarantees. We propose a novel evolutionary framework based on GigaEvo and OpenEvolve for targeted second-image attacks on perceptual hash algorithms. We assess attack performance using a composite score that jointly accounts for the fraction of adversarial images whose normalized Hamming distance to the target hash falls below threshold p (Attack Success Rate), the number of queries issued to the hash function, and the L2 distortion relative to the original image. Experiments on four deployed PHAs (pHash, PDQ, PhotoDNA, NeuralHash) across 30 ImageNet image pairs demonstrate that our evolutionary approach achieves comparable or better ASR than existing black-box baselines using substantially fewer queries to the hash function, while simultaneously producing adversarial images with lower L2 distortion relative to the originals. The best evolved programs reduce the pre-defined composite attack score relative to the best optimized seed by 41.2% for NeuralHash, 38.3% for PDQ, 34.0% for pHash, and 8.1% for PhotoDNA. Unlike gradient-based methods, our framework requires no internal knowledge of PHA architectures and naturally handles the non-differentiable, discretized nature of hash outputs. These results reveal previously unreported vulnerabilities in widely deployed content-moderation pipelines and motivate the development of provably robust perceptual hashing 1schemes.

AI.title_translation: 基于LLM引导程序演化的感知哈希算法定向黑盒攻击研究
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于LLM的程序演化框架，能在无需哈希算法内部信息的情况下，高效生成对抗图像以欺骗感知哈希系统。
AI.motivation: 感知哈希算法被广泛用于图像取证，但其在面对对抗性扰动时的鲁棒性缺乏深入研究，且现有方法难以处理哈希输出的非可导和离散特性。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于 GigaEvo 和 OpenEvolve 的演化框架，通过 LLM 引导程序演化，在无需哈希算法内部结构知识的情况下，对感知哈希进行定向黑盒攻击。
AI.result: 在四种主流感知哈希算法（pHash, PDQ, PhotoDNA, NeuralHash）上的实验表明，该方法在显著减少查询次数和降低 L2 失真的前提下，实现了比现有黑盒基线更好或相当的攻击成功率，攻击得分较最佳优化种子分别降低了 8.1% 至 41.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了LLM引导的程序演化框架在执行感知哈希算法的定向黑盒攻击方面非常有效，在减少查询次数和降低图像失真的同时，实现了更高的攻击成功率，揭示了现有感知哈希算法的安全短板。
AI.translation: 感知哈希算法（PHAs）被广泛部署用于检测良性转换下的图像伪造，但其对抗人为精心设计扰动的鲁棒性仍知之甚少，且很少有可证明的保证。我们提出了一种基于 GigaEvo 和 OpenEvolve 的新型演化框架，用于对感知哈希算法进行定向的第二图像攻击。我们使用综合评分来评估攻击性能，该评分共同考虑了归一化汉明距离低于阈值 p 的对抗图像比例（攻击成功率）、对哈希函数的查询次数以及相对于原始图像的 L2 失真。在 30 对 ImageNet 图像上对四种已部署的 PHA（pHash、PDQ、PhotoDNA、NeuralHash）进行的实验表明，我们的演化方法在对哈希函数的查询次数大幅减少的情况下，实现了与现有黑盒基线相当或更好的攻击成功率，同时产生的对抗图像相对于原始图像具有更低的 L2 失真。最佳演化程序相对于最佳优化种子将 NeuralHash 的预定义综合攻击得分降低了 41.2%，PDQ 降低了 38.3%，pHash 降低了 34.0%，PhotoDNA 降低了 8.1%。与基于梯度的方法不同，我们的框架不需要 PHA 架构的内部知识，并能自然地处理哈希输出的非可导和离散特性。这些结果揭示了广泛部署的内容审核管道中此前未报道的漏洞，并促进了可证明鲁棒的感知哈希方案的开发。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用 LLM 引导程序演化的新框架，用于针对感知哈希算法的定向黑盒攻击。该方法有效解决了哈希函数非可导的难题，通过演化生成对抗图像，在四种主流哈希算法上均表现出比现有基线更高效、更隐蔽的攻击能力。
AI.keywords: 感知哈希算法, 黑盒攻击, 程序演化, 大语言模型, 对抗性扰动
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将大语言模型（LLM）引导的程序演化框架应用于黑盒对抗攻击，成功绕过了感知哈希算法（PHA）不可导、离散化的限制。其重要性在于揭示了主流内容审核工具在面对黑盒攻击时的脆弱性，为未来开发更鲁棒的哈希算法提供了依据。局限性在于主要针对特定哈希算法，且攻击效果可能受演化过程计算成本的影响。

title: Towards Efficient Convolutional Neural Network for Embedded Hardware via Multi-Dimensional Pruning
comments: Author's accepted version. Published in Proceedings of the 60th ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2023)
summary: In this paper, we propose TECO, a multi-dimensional pruning framework to collaboratively prune the three dimensions (depth, width, and resolution) of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for better execution efficiency on embedded hardware. In TECO, we first introduce a two-stage importance evaluation framework, which efficiently and comprehensively evaluates each pruning unit according to both the local importance inside each dimension and the global importance across different dimensions. Based on the evaluation framework, we present a heuristic pruning algorithm to progressively prune the three dimensions of CNNs towards the optimal trade-off between accuracy and efficiency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks validate the advantages of TECO over existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) approaches. The code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Teco.
comment: Author's accepted version. Published in Proceedings of the 60th ACM/IEEE Design Automation Conference (DAC 2023)

AI.title_translation: 通过多维度剪枝实现面向嵌入式硬件的高效卷积神经网络
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为TECO的框架，通过协同优化CNN的深度、宽度和分辨率，在嵌入式设备上实现了更高效的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 为了解决卷积神经网络在嵌入式硬件上运行效率低下的问题，旨在通过多维度的协同剪枝实现更优的精度与效率平衡。
AI.method: 提出TECO框架，包含两阶段重要性评估体系（局部与全局重要性评估）以及一种启发式剪枝算法，用于协同剪枝CNN的深度、宽度和分辨率。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实验结果表明，TECO优于现有的前沿（SOTA）剪枝方法。
AI.conclusion: TECO框架通过协同剪枝深度、宽度和分辨率，成功在嵌入式设备上实现了卷积神经网络在精度与效率之间的最优平衡。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了TECO，一个多维度剪枝框架，旨在协同剪枝卷积神经网络（CNN）的三个维度（深度、宽度和分辨率），以在嵌入式硬件上获得更好的执行效率。在TECO中，我们首先引入了一个两阶段重要性评估框架，根据每个维度内的局部重要性和不同维度间的全局重要性，高效且全面地评估每个剪枝单元。基于该评估框架，我们提出了一种启发式剪枝算法，逐步剪枝CNN的三个维度，以实现精度与效率之间的最优平衡。在多个基准测试上的实验验证了TECO相对于现有最先进（SOTA）方法的优势。代码和预训练模型可在 https://github.com/ntuliuteam/Teco 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TECO框架，通过两阶段重要性评估和启发式算法，对卷积神经网络的深度、宽度和分辨率进行多维度协同剪枝，从而显著提升了模型在嵌入式硬件上的执行效率。
AI.keywords: 多维度剪枝, 卷积神经网络, 嵌入式硬件, 模型压缩, 效率优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“多维度”协同剪枝的概念，不仅关注传统的权重或通道剪枝，还将深度和分辨率纳入优化范围，通过两阶段评估体系解决了维度间的重要性权衡问题，对嵌入式AI部署具有很高的实用价值。

title: HyperSafe: Inference-Time Safety Recovery for Fine-Tuned Language Models
summary: Safety alignment in large language models can be fragile under fine-tuning, as even benign task adaptation may increase harmful compliance. Existing defenses mainly follow two directions: they either intervene during or after fine-tuning through retraining or weight modification, which can be costly and may hurt task performance, or they use model-agnostic safety classifiers, which may miss failures specific to a given fine-tuned checkpoint. These limitations motivate a post hoc, model-specific, and non-invasive approach to safety restoration. To meet these requirements, we propose HyperSafe, a framework that restores safety behavior by generating a model-specific Safe Side Network (SSN) for each fine-tuned checkpoint. HyperSafe uses layer-wise activation fingerprints to capture how fine-tuning changes the model's inner representations. With a small set of given calibration prompts, the hypernetwork maps these fingerprints to the parameters of the \ssn{} in a single forward pass. The generated \ssn{} runs alongside the frozen fine-tuned model and performs prompt-level safety classification: harmful prompts are routed to refusal, while safe prompts are answered by the original fine-tuned model. Thus, HyperSafe requires no gradient updates, no safety data at deployment time, and no modification to the deployed model weights. We evaluate HyperSafe on two model families, Qwen2-7B and LLaMA-3-8B, across multiple safety benchmarks. HyperSafe reduces harmful response rates from 19-31% to below 1% on every held-out checkpoint, while keeping downstream task accuracy within 1% of the fine-tuned baseline on average. Code is available at https://github.com/nokronim/project-safety-remedy.

title: Towards Human-level Dexterous Teleoperation
summary: Humans routinely wield tools, swap grasps, and reposition objects within a single hand, seamlessly orchestrating contact transitions that span translation, reorientation, and finger gaiting. Endowing robot dexterous hands with this level of in-hand dexterity through teleoperation requires precise control of object motion via dynamic hand-object contact, yet current teleoperation systems remain far from this capability. To bridge this gap, we take a major step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation by introducing TeleDexter, a hand-object co-tracking controller that maps operator intent into learned, low-level contact execution. The controller is trained on consecutive co-tracking subgoals derived from human reference motions, utilizing a hybrid reward that couples sparse subgoal objectives with dense tracking rewards to enable learning across diverse interaction modalities rather than frame-wise trajectory imitation. The entire pipeline requires only single-stage RL and, with random action masking and domain randomization, transfers zero-shot to the real robot. We evaluate TeleDexter on seven challenging dexterous teleoperation tasks spanning object reorientation and long-horizon tool use across two dexterous hands, achieving a 75% average success rate where all baselines consistently fail. Furthermore, the collected demonstrations successfully train autonomous policies via behavioral cloning, marking a concrete step towards human-level dexterous teleoperation.

AI.title_translation: 迈向类人水平的灵巧遥操作
AI.tldr: TeleDexter通过一种新型的共追踪控制器和强化学习方法，显著提升了机器人灵巧手在复杂物体交互任务中的遥操作性能，并实现了零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人灵巧手遥操作系统在处理复杂的接触转换（如工具使用、重新抓取和物体位移）方面能力不足，难以达到人类水平的灵巧度。
AI.method: 引入TeleDexter控制器，通过将操作者意图映射为低层接触执行；采用基于人类参考动作的连续共追踪子目标进行训练；使用结合稀疏子目标与密集追踪奖励的混合奖励机制；利用单阶段强化学习、随机动作遮蔽和域随机化实现零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在七项具有挑战性的灵巧遥操作任务中，TeleDexter达到了75%的平均成功率，远超所有基准方法，并成功实现了零样本迁移。此外，收集的演示数据可有效训练自主策略。
AI.conclusion: TeleDexter通过创新的共追踪控制器和强化学习方法，显著提升了机器人灵巧手的遥操作能力，为实现类人水平的灵巧操作提供了可行的技术路径。
AI.translation: 人类能够熟练地使用工具、更换抓取方式并在单手内重新定位物体，无缝地协调包括平移、重定向和手指步态在内的接触转换。要通过遥操作赋予机器人灵巧手这种水平的内手灵活性，需要通过动态手-物接触精确控制物体运动，但目前的遥操作系统距离这种能力还很遥远。为了弥补这一差距，我们通过引入TeleDexter迈出了迈向类人水平灵巧遥操作的重要一步。TeleDexter是一个手-物共追踪控制器，它将操作者的意图映射为学习到的低层接触执行。该控制器在源自人类参考动作的连续共追踪子目标上进行训练，利用一种结合稀疏子目标目标与密集追踪奖励的混合奖励机制，使系统能够跨多种交互模式进行学习，而非单纯的逐帧轨迹模仿。整个流程仅需单阶段强化学习，并通过随机动作遮蔽和域随机化，实现了向真实机器人的零样本迁移。我们在两个灵巧手上的七项具有挑战性的灵巧遥操作任务（涵盖物体重定向和长时程工具使用）中评估了TeleDexter，取得了75%的平均成功率，而所有基准方法均告失败。此外，收集的演示成功地通过行为克隆训练了自主策略，标志着迈向类人水平灵巧遥操作的具体一步。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TeleDexter，一种旨在提升机器人灵巧手遥操作能力的共追踪控制器。该系统通过将操作者意图映射为低层接触执行，利用混合奖励强化学习和单阶段训练流程，实现了在复杂物体操作任务中高成功率的零样本迁移，为实现类人水平的灵巧操作奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 灵巧手, 遥操作, 接触控制, 强化学习, 零样本迁移
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种名为TeleDexter的端到端遥操作框架，通过将操作者意图映射为低层接触执行，成功解决了机器人灵巧手在复杂接触转换（如重定向、工具使用）中的控制难题。其无需帧级轨迹模仿，通过混合奖励机制和强化学习实现了零样本迁移，且能通过收集到的数据训练自主策略，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Communicating Chess Strategies in Natural Language
summary: Chess engines have long achieved superhuman playing strength. However, the underlying strategy behind their move suggestions is difficult for human players, even skilled ones, to comprehend. Motivated by this, we propose the task of chess strategy verbalization, which is to describe chess strategies in natural language. We design (i) a pipeline for verbalizing strategies and (ii) an evaluation framework for objective evaluation of generated strategy descriptions. Our experiments show that natural language is a promising and interpretable medium for communicating strategic information to both human and LLM players. We glean additional interesting insights, including (a) the importance of evaluating strategies beyond the main line, (b) the limitations of pure concept-based descriptions, and (c) the limitations of relying on LLMs rather than humans for evaluation.

AI.title_translation: 用自然语言传达国际象棋策略
AI.tldr: 该研究通过自然语言将难以理解的国际象棋引擎决策转化为人类可读的策略描述，并建立了评估该沟通效果的框架。
AI.motivation: 尽管国际象棋引擎已具备超人类的水平，但其决策逻辑对人类而言往往难以理解，需要通过自然语言将这些策略转化为可解释的形式。
AI.method: 提出了一套国际象棋策略语言化处理流程（pipeline），并设计了一套用于客观评估生成策略描述的框架。
AI.result: 实验表明，自然语言能够有效地向人类和LLM传达战略信息；研究同时指出，仅依赖概念描述或LLM进行评估存在局限性，需综合评估主线之外的策略。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言是传达国际象棋策略的有效且可解释的媒介，但在评估描述质量时，必须结合人类评估与多维度的客观指标。
AI.translation: 国际象棋引擎长期以来已经达到了超人类的博弈水平。然而，其移动建议背后的深层策略对于人类玩家，甚至是高水平玩家来说，都难以理解。受此启发，我们提出了国际象棋策略语言化任务，即用自然语言描述国际象棋策略。我们设计了（i）一种策略语言化处理流程，以及（ii）一种用于客观评估所生成策略描述的评估框架。我们的实验表明，自然语言是一种向人类和LLM玩家传达战略信息的有前途且可解释的媒介。我们还获得了其他有趣的见解，包括（a）评估主线之外策略的重要性，（b）纯基于概念描述的局限性，以及（c）在评估中依赖LLM而非人类的局限性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“国际象棋策略语言化”任务，旨在利用自然语言解释国际象棋引擎的决策。作者构建了相应的处理流程与评估框架，验证了自然语言作为策略沟通媒介的潜力，并强调了在评估中结合人类视角的重要性。
AI.keywords: 国际象棋, 策略语言化, 可解释性, 大语言模型, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入国际象棋策略语言化（Chess Strategy Verbalization）这一新任务，弥合了高性能AI引擎与人类玩家之间的理解鸿沟。其创新之处在于提出了一套完整的评估框架，并揭示了LLM在评估复杂战略时的局限性，为可解释性人工智能在博弈领域的应用提供了重要参考。

title: LightMem-Ego: Your AI Memory for Everyday Life
summary: Personal AI assistants on mobile and wearable devices continuously perceive users' daily lives through visual and audio streams. However, answering queries about past experiences requires lightweight multimodal memory that can continuously accumulate, organize, and retrieve long-term experiences, which remains challenging. To address this challenge, we present LightMem-Ego, a lightweight streaming multimodal memory system for everyday-life assistance. The system continuously captures egocentric visual and audio streams, aligns them on a shared timeline, and organizes them into a hierarchical memory consisting of current, short-term, and long-term memory. Given a user query, LightMem-Ego dynamically routes retrieval to the appropriate memory level and generates answers grounded in multimodal evidence. The demonstration can be deployed on smartphones and AI glasses, supporting object finding, conversation recall, life summarization, routine discovery, and personalized assistance. Code is available at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem-Ego.

AI.title_translation: LightMem-Ego：您日常生活中的 AI 记忆助手
AI.tldr: 一款适用于移动和可穿戴设备的轻量级多模态记忆系统，能够实时记录并检索用户的日常生活经验。
AI.motivation: 个人AI助手在处理用户日常生活中持续的视听数据时，缺乏轻量级且能够长期积累、组织并高效检索经验的记忆系统。
AI.method: 设计了一个轻量级流式多模态记忆系统，通过连续捕获第一人称视听流，将其对齐并组织为“当前-短期-长期”的层次化记忆结构，并利用动态路由机制进行检索和生成。
AI.result: 该系统成功在智能手机和AI眼镜上实现部署，支持物品查找、对话回顾、生活总结、习惯发现及个性化辅助等多种功能。
AI.conclusion: LightMem-Ego 通过层次化记忆和动态检索机制，为移动设备上的个人AI助手提供了一种高效、轻量级的长期记忆解决方案。
AI.translation: 移动和可穿戴设备上的个人AI助手通过视觉和音频流持续感知用户的日常生活。然而，回答有关过去经历的查询需要一种能够持续积累、组织和检索长期经验的轻量级多模态记忆，这仍然具有挑战性。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 LightMem-Ego，这是一个用于日常生活辅助的轻量级流式多模态记忆系统。该系统持续捕获第一人称视觉和音频流，将它们对齐在共享的时间轴上，并将它们组织成由当前记忆、短期记忆和长期记忆组成的层次化记忆。针对用户查询，LightMem-Ego 将检索动态路由到适当的记忆级别，并生成基于多模态证据的答案。该演示可在智能手机和 AI 眼镜上部署，支持物品查找、对话回顾、生活总结、例程发现和个性化辅助。代码可在 https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem-Ego 获取。
AI.summary: LightMem-Ego 是一个专为移动和可穿戴设备设计的轻量级多模态记忆系统。它通过捕获第一人称视听流，构建层次化记忆结构，并支持基于查询的动态检索，从而实现对用户日常生活经验的有效积累与辅助。
AI.keywords: 多模态记忆, 第一人称视角, AI 助手, 轻量化系统, 长期记忆存储
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一种能够适配移动和可穿戴设备的轻量化多模态记忆架构。通过层次化的记忆管理策略，有效地平衡了存储压力与检索效率，在个人AI助手领域具有重要的实用价值。局限性在于未提及在极端环境或超长时间跨度下的记忆压缩与隐私保护机制。

title: Compound Interference Recognition for LR-FHSS Satellite IoT Uplinks via Multi-Domain Instance Fusion
comments: Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Long range-frequency hopping spread spectrum (LR-FHSS) is a promising uplink physical layer for massive low Earth orbit satellite Internet of Things, where low power terminals report short packets from wide area regions with limited terrestrial infrastructure. However, satellite IoT links are exposed to external interference, and the coexistence of multiple interference components can severely degrade receiver reliability and complicate interference mitigation. Existing recognition methods either focus on single interference scenarios or treat each compound interference combination as an independent class, leading to limited generalization or poor scalability. To address this problem, this paper formulates LR-FHSS uplink compound interference recognition as a multi-instance multi-label learning problem and proposes a multi-domain instance fusion method. The proposed method fuses local instances from the time-frequency and frequency domains and aggregates their predictions for bag-level multi-label recognition. A dataset construction pipeline is developed based on the US915 LR-FHSS configuration and incorporates shadowed-Rician fading and time-varying Doppler to emulate practical satellite communication conditions. Considering the difficulty of obtaining labeled compound interference samples in practice, single-to-compound generalization and few-shot compound interference adaptation are investigated as two practical receiver deployment scenarios. Experimental results show that the proposed method improves the overall exact accuracy over the strongest baseline by 14.71 percentage points in single-to-compound generalization and by 14.81 percentage points in few-shot compound interference adaptation for $r=1$.
comment: Submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal

AI.title_translation: 基于多域实例融合的LR-FHSS卫星物联网上行链路复合干扰识别
AI.tldr: 提出一种多域实例融合方法，通过多实例多标签学习有效解决卫星物联网中复杂的复合干扰识别难题，显著提升了泛化能力和少样本适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有干扰识别方法无法有效处理卫星物联网中复杂的复合干扰场景，且在处理复合干扰组合时面临泛化能力有限和可扩展性差的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多域实例融合的方法，将复合干扰识别转化为多实例多标签学习问题；通过融合时频域和频域的局部实例，并聚合包级预测结果进行识别；同时构建了包含阴影莱斯衰落和时变多普勒效应的模拟数据集。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在单干扰到复合干扰的泛化场景中，准确率比最强基准提高了14.71个百分点；在r=1的少样本复合干扰适应场景中，准确率提高了14.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，所提出的多域实例融合方法在处理LR-FHSS卫星物联网上行链路的复合干扰识别方面表现出显著优越性，特别是在泛化性和少样本适应性方面均优于现有基准方法。
AI.translation: 长距离跳频扩频（LR-FHSS）是海量低地球轨道卫星物联网的一种很有前景的上行物理层技术，它允许低功耗终端在地面基础设施有限的广域范围内发送短数据包。然而，卫星物联网链路容易受到外部干扰，多种干扰成分的共存会严重降低接收机的可靠性，并使干扰抑制变得复杂。现有的识别方法要么专注于单一干扰场景，要么将每种复合干扰组合视为一个独立的类别，导致泛化能力受限或可扩展性差。为了解决这个问题，本文将LR-FHSS上行链路复合干扰识别表述为一个多实例多标签学习问题，并提出了一种多域实例融合方法。该方法融合了来自时频域和频域的局部实例，并聚合它们的预测结果用于包级多标签识别。本文基于US915 LR-FHSS配置开发了一个数据集构建流水线，并结合了阴影莱斯衰落和时变多普勒效应，以模拟实际的卫星通信条件。考虑到在实际中难以获得带标签的复合干扰样本，本文研究了单干扰到复合干扰的泛化以及少样本复合干扰适应这两个实际的接收机部署场景。实验结果表明，所提方法在单干扰到复合干扰的泛化场景中将总体精确准确率较最强基准提高了14.71个百分点，在r=1的少样本复合干扰适应场景中提高了14.81个百分点。
AI.summary: 本文针对LR-FHSS卫星物联网上行链路中的复合干扰识别挑战，提出了一种基于多域实例融合的方法。该方法将干扰识别建模为多实例多标签学习问题，通过融合时频域和频域特征，实现了对复合干扰的准确识别，并验证了其在复杂卫星通信环境及少样本条件下的有效性。
AI.keywords: LR-FHSS, 卫星物联网, 复合干扰识别, 多实例多标签学习, 多域实例融合
AI.comments: 该研究针对卫星物联网中复杂的干扰环境，提出了一种创新的多域实例融合方法。其核心贡献在于将干扰识别建模为多实例多标签学习问题，有效地解决了传统方法在处理复合干扰时泛化能力差和扩展性不足的问题，特别是在少样本和单干扰到复合干扰迁移场景下表现优异，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Enhancing Query Efficiency for d-DNNF Representations Through Preprocessing
summary: In this paper, we investigate preprocessing techniques aimed at improving the efficiency of accessing models of propositional formulas represented in conjunctive normal form (CNF). We focus on three fundamental tasks: uniform sampling, direct model access, and model enumeration. Our analysis reveals that most state-of-the-art preprocessors, when they do not preserve formula equivalence, are generally unsuitable for these tasks. In contrast, we demonstrate that preprocessors which preserve model counts can be effectively leveraged, provided relevant preprocessing information is maintained. To validate our approach, we perform extensive experiments on a diverse suite of benchmarks from multiple domains. The experimental results show that our preprocessing methods are both efficient and robust, yielding significant performance improvements for model access queries when CNF formulas are compiled into d-DNNF representations.

title: Agentic Skill Optimization over Lie Algebroids
summary: Agentic systems increasingly improve themselves by editing skills: prompts, rubrics, plans, tool contracts, examples, validators, and traces. Skill edits are not independent coordinates in a vector space: they are local repairs to structured artifacts whose effects are observed only after rollout, validation, and critique. Distinct edits can have the same immediate visible effect while differing in routing context, template state, guardrail scope, or future composability. The order of edits can matter as well: repairing a schema before a normalization rule need not be equivalent to applying the same edits in the reverse order. This paper introduces a new framework for skill optimization called LASKO, for Lie Algebroid SKill Optimization. LASKO models typed, anchored Markdown skills as the base category and available edit policies as sections of a controlled Lie algebroid with anchor $ρ$. The anchor maps an edit policy to its visible Markdown effect; the kernel $\ker(ρ)$ represents latent template, routing, or implementation structure; and the algebroid bracket measures noncommuting edit composition. As shown in the paper, LASKO achieves order-of-magnitude speedups in skill optimization in our preliminary benchmark results, primarily because it substitutes inexpensive Lie-bracket screening tests that run in microseconds, before investing in expensive validations that require running large language models. On a causal extraction from natural language task, LASKO achieved a speedup of almost $15 \times$ compared to a brute-force approach that validated all edits by running them through a DeepSeek V3.1 4-bit model with 671B parameters.

title: Time Is Money: Incentivized Causal Transaction Ordering
summary:
Front-running is a subtle and persistent problem for blockchains. A blockchain is a stateful virtual machine executing instructions called transactions. Users earn rewards by publishing functional transactions essential to the system. Attackers observe these transactions and publish their own ahead of the users', seizing the reward and eroding users' incentive to publish functional transactions. Preventing front-running means enforcing causality: If an attacker receives transaction tx_A and then publishes transaction tx_B, then tx_A must be ordered before tx_B. However, this causality is only observed by the attacker. Practical systems order transactions by bid amount, so transactions willing to pay more get executed first, but this only results in a bidding war eroding users' rewards. Though numerous ordering approaches have been proposed, none achieves causality, leaving users vulnerable to front-running.
  We present PRECEDE, a mechanism-design approach that enforces transaction causality by removing the economic incentive to front-run. PRECEDE orders transactions by a power-weighted randomized lottery, whose winning probability grows super-linearly in the bid. The user's strategy of publishing a transaction with a deterring bid forms an equilibrium where the attacker refrains from competing. Moreover, PRECEDE prevents the prominent sandwich attack, which relies on front-running. PRECEDE can be directly deployed in any censorship-resistant blockchain with a simple change to its transaction ordering mechanism.

title: IG-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Data Generation Based on Intrinsic Geometry
summary: Existing generative models learn data distributions in flat Euclidean space. However, most data in our real world are manifolds embedded in high dimensional Euclidean space. Therefore, we propose an intrinsic-geometry-based generative adversarial network (IG-GAN) for data generation in the field of aerodynamics. The generator of the IG-GAN represents aerodynamic data as a piecewise smooth manifold constructed by Bézier surfaces, and the generator tries to learn the coefficients of each Bézier surface to further combine multiple Bézier surfaces into a smooth manifold automatically. The discriminator in the IG-GAN is a radial-basis-function based discriminator (RBF-D). Experimental results show that IG-GAN achieves lower predicted Mean Squared Errors (MSEs) than those of three baselines. Specifically, on the Burgers' equation dataset, IG-GAN reduces the predicted MSE of velocity u by 97.41% compared with state of the art SSL-Transformer. Additionally, on the ONERA M6 aircraft dataset, IG-GAN reduces the overall MSE of nine aerodynamic coefficients by 82.95% compared with SSL-Transformer.

AI.title_translation: IG-GAN：一种基于内在几何的空气动力学数据生成对抗网络
AI.tldr: IG-GAN 通过利用贝塞尔曲面表征流形结构，显著提升了空气动力学数据的生成精度，大幅优于现有主流模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成模型通常在平坦的欧几里得空间中学习数据分布，而现实世界中的许多数据（如空气动力学数据）实际上是高维欧几里得空间中的嵌入流形。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于内在几何的生成对抗网络（IG-GAN），其生成器使用贝塞尔曲面构造分段平滑流形来表征空气动力学数据，判别器采用基于径向基函数（RBF）的判别器。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，IG-GAN 在 Burgers' 方程数据集上将速度 u 的预测 MSE 降低了 97.41%，在 ONERA M6 飞机数据集上将九个空气动力学系数的整体 MSE 降低了 82.95%，均优于现有基准模型。
AI.conclusion: IG-GAN 通过引入内在几何结构和贝塞尔曲面表征，显著提升了空气动力学数据的生成质量和预测精度，证明了在非欧几里得空间建模物理数据的有效性。
AI.translation: 现有的生成模型在平坦的欧几里得空间中学习数据分布。然而，现实世界中的大多数数据是嵌入在高维欧几里得空间中的流形。因此，我们提出了一种基于内在几何的生成对抗网络（IG-GAN），用于空气动力学领域的数据生成。IG-GAN 的生成器将空气动力学数据表示为由贝塞尔曲面构造的分段平滑流形，并学习每个贝塞尔曲面的系数，从而自动将多个贝塞尔曲面组合成一个平滑流形。IG-GAN 的判别器是一个基于径向基函数的判别器（RBF-D）。实验结果表明，IG-GAN 实现了比三个基准模型更低的预测均方误差（MSE）。具体而言，在 Burgers' 方程数据集上，与最先进的 SSL-Transformer 相比，IG-GAN 将速度 u 的预测 MSE 降低了 97.41%。此外，在 ONERA M6 飞机数据集上，与 SSL-Transformer 相比，IG-GAN 将九个空气动力学系数的整体 MSE 降低了 82.95%。
AI.summary: 针对现有生成模型无法有效处理流形数据的局限，本文提出了 IG-GAN。该模型通过贝塞尔曲面构建平滑流形来表征空气动力学数据，并结合径向基函数判别器，实现了高精度的空气动力学数据生成。
AI.keywords: IG-GAN, 空气动力学, 贝塞尔曲面, 生成对抗网络, 流形学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将流形学习与生成对抗网络相结合，利用贝塞尔曲面来表征空气动力学数据，克服了传统生成模型在欧几里得空间学习数据分布的局限性，在处理复杂的空气动力学几何数据方面具有显著优势。

title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict robot actions from visual observations and language instructions. These actions are defined in the robot's own 3D coordinate frame, yet most VLAs observe the scene in the camera frame, creating a frame mismatch between where the scene is observed and where actions are defined. The mismatch is benign under a fixed viewpoint, where the policy can memorize a single observation-to-action mapping, but grows harder as large-scale datasets aggregate demonstrations across diverse camera setups and the policy must generalize this mapping across viewpoints. We address this mismatch with robot-centric pointmaps, images whose pixels store the 3D coordinates of scene points in the robot frame. Pointmaps provide robot-frame 3D geometry while preserving the dense H x W grid expected by pretrained 2D VLAs, so they integrate into existing VLAs with minimal architectural change. On RoboCasa, pointmaps improve both pi0.5 and SmolVLA and outperform representative camera-viewpoint and 3D-aware baselines. In real-robot experiments, their advantage over an RGB-only policy widens when the camera is moved to a placement unseen during training.

AI.title_translation: 像机器人一样观察：用于视觉-语言-动作模型的机器人中心点图
AI.tldr: 通过将3D坐标信息转化为机器人视角的2D点图，解决了VLA模型中观测与动作坐标系不匹配的问题，显著提升了跨视角泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型在相机坐标系下观测场景，但在机器人坐标系下执行动作，这种坐标系失配在多视角数据训练时会导致泛化性能下降。
AI.method: 提出一种“机器人中心点图”（Robot-Centric Pointmaps），将场景点的3D坐标存储在像素中，以机器人坐标系为基准，同时保持预训练2D VLA模型所期望的H x W网格格式，从而在不改变架构的情况下引入3D几何信息。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa基准测试中，点图方法提升了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，优于现有的相机视角和3D感知基线；在真实机器人实验中，当相机移动到训练中未见的视角时，其性能提升相较于纯RGB策略更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 机器人中心点图有效地消除了VLA模型中的坐标系不匹配问题，显著提升了模型在不同视角下的泛化性能，为机器人操作任务提供了一种高效且易于集成的几何感知方法。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型根据视觉观测和语言指令预测机器人动作。这些动作定义在机器人自身的3D坐标系中，然而大多数VLA模型是在相机坐标系下观察场景，这导致了场景观察和动作定义之间的坐标系不匹配。当摄像机视角固定时，这种不匹配是可以忽略的，因为策略可以记忆单一的“观察到动作”的映射；但随着大规模数据集汇集了来自不同摄像机设置的演示，策略必须在不同视角间泛化这种映射，问题就变得困难起来。我们通过机器人中心点图解决了这一不匹配问题，这种图像的像素存储了机器人坐标系中场景点的3D坐标。点图在提供机器人坐标系3D几何信息的同时，保留了预训练2D VLA所期望的密集H x W网格，因此只需极小的架构更改即可集成到现有VLA中。在RoboCasa上的实验表明，点图提升了pi0.5和SmolVLA的性能，并优于代表性的相机视角和3D感知基线。在真实机器人实验中，当摄像机被移动到训练中未见的位置时，点图相对于仅使用RGB的策略的优势进一步扩大。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中观测帧与动作帧不匹配的问题，提出了一种机器人中心点图（Robot-Centric Pointmaps）方法。该方法将场景的3D坐标信息编码为2D网格图，使预训练的VLA模型能够直接处理机器人坐标系下的几何信息，从而显著增强了模型在不同相机视角下的动作执行泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 机器人中心点图, 跨视角泛化, 3D几何感知, 机器人操作
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种巧妙的解决方案，通过引入机器人中心点图（Robot-Centric Pointmaps），有效地解决了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中观测帧与动作帧不一致的问题。其核心创新在于将3D几何信息嵌入到2D图像网格中，使得现有的预训练VLA架构无需大幅修改即可使用，在处理跨视角泛化问题上表现出色，具有很高的实用价值。

title: HyperGS: Fast and Generalizable Gaussian Video Representation
summary: Gaussian Splatting has emerged as an effective representation for video, but existing methods rely on per-video optimization. This leads to slow encoding and limits generalization across videos. To amortize this optimization, we propose HyperGS, a feedforward, optimization-free approach that directly predicts Gaussian representations from any video in a single forward pass, speeding up encoding and decoding by orders of magnitude while generalizing to out-of-distribution videos at higher resolutions. In HyperGS, we design a factorized spatiotemporal Transformer to extract tokens from video, and a learnable query-based Transformer to obtain 8-parameter Gaussian representations for each video frame. We find that naively predicting Gaussians across diverse videos induces a needle-like degeneration that collapses training, and address this with a rank-based geometric regularizer whose strength adapts dynamically to stabilize optimization. HyperGS achieves encoding at $10^4$--$10^5\times$ the speed of per-video Gaussian optimization at matched reconstruction quality while generalizing zero-shot to $720p$ video, enabling higher-resolution rendering without re-encoding. HyperGS improves PSNR by +2.9--3.1 dB over the prior video encoders on K400, SSv2, and UCF101 at a smaller video representation size. By predicting explicit 2D Gaussians in a single forward pass, HyperGS combines the fast, flexible rendering of Gaussian Splatting with the speed and generalization of feedforward prediction, advancing Gaussians as a practical direction for fast and generalizable video representation.

title: Comparative Analysis of GAT and BERT for Human-Like Playtesting
summary: Accurately modeling and understanding player experience is crucial for designing engaging puzzle games. To achieve this, a common approach involves collecting diverse user data to train predictive playtesting models that mimic player behavior. However, existing data-driven methods often lack the ability to capture the full range of player strategies and require extensive feature engineering and network architecture modeling. This limitation becomes particularly evident when new game mechanics or features are introduced, which necessitate continual adjustments to the models. To addrss these challenges, we propose a more generalized representation that reduces - or even eliminates - the need for ongoing feature-engineering maintenance. Specifically, we investigate two general-purpose network architectures: (a) a transformer-based model (BERT) and (b) a graph attention model (GAT), both of which are designed to effectively capture the relational structure of Candy Crush Saga (CCS) game boards. Our experiments compare these approaches to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) baselines, revealing better performance on challenging board configurations and underscoring the benefits of our generalizable representation.

AI.title_translation: 用于类人游戏测试的GAT与BERT对比分析
AI.tldr: 本文通过对比BERT与GAT模型，提出了一种能够减少特征工程需求、且在复杂游戏关卡预测中表现优于传统CNN的通用游戏测试模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据驱动型游戏测试模型在处理复杂玩家策略时表现不足，且依赖大量的特征工程，面对新游戏机制时需要频繁调整模型架构。
AI.method: 提出了一种通用的游戏棋盘表示方法，并对比研究了两种架构：基于Transformer的BERT模型和图注意力网络（GAT），同时以卷积神经网络（CNN）作为基线进行性能评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GAT和BERT在处理具有挑战性的棋盘配置时，性能优于传统的CNN基线，验证了该通用表示方法的可行性与优势。
AI.conclusion: BERT和GAT架构在捕捉游戏关卡空间关系方面优于传统的CNN模型，证明了通用表示学习在减少特征工程需求和提升预测准确性方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 准确建模和理解玩家体验对于设计引人入胜的益智游戏至关重要。为了实现这一目标，一种常见的方法是收集多样化的用户数据来训练模仿玩家行为的预测性测试模型。然而，现有的数据驱动方法往往缺乏捕捉全部玩家策略的能力，并且需要大量的特征工程和网络架构建模。当引入新的游戏机制或功能时，这种局限性尤为明显，需要对模型进行持续调整。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种更通用的表示方法，减少甚至消除了对持续特征工程维护的需求。具体而言，我们研究了两种通用网络架构：(a) 基于Transformer的模型 (BERT) 和 (b) 图注意力模型 (GAT)，两者都旨在有效捕捉《Candy Crush Saga》(CCS) 游戏棋盘的关系结构。我们的实验将这些方法与卷积神经网络 (CNN) 基线进行了比较，结果显示在具有挑战性的棋盘配置上表现更好，并强调了我们通用表示方法的优势。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用BERT和GAT模型进行类人游戏测试的方法，旨在克服传统方法对特征工程的过度依赖。研究通过对Candy Crush Saga棋盘结构的建模，证明了这些通用架构能更有效地捕捉空间关系，并在复杂棋盘配置上表现出优于CNN的预测能力。
AI.keywords: 游戏测试, BERT, 图注意力网络, 玩家行为建模, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入图神经网络和Transformer架构解决了传统游戏测试模型依赖繁琐特征工程的问题，为游戏自动化测试提供了一种更具通用性和扩展性的思路。其局限在于未提及在其他类型游戏中的泛化能力，且仅以Candy Crush Saga为实验对象。

title: GEIS: A Generation-Evaluation-Improvement Loop of Agent Skills for Long-Form Article Generation
summary: Long-form article generation remains difficult for large language models because it combines long context, long instructions, and long outputs. Existing multi-agent pipelines such as STORM improve information coverage by simulating role-specialized agents, but their capabilities are often entangled in prompts and fixed procedures, making them hard to inspect, reuse, or iteratively improve. This paper presents GEIS (Generation-Evaluation-Improvement loop of agent Skills), a loop of named and declarative skills for Wikipedia-style long-form article generation. Implemented and evaluated in Tasi Harness, GEIS composes skills for article writing, browser-based evidence and image collection, diagram rendering, PDF-aware pairwise evaluation, and rule-level skill improvement. Its core writing skill follows Request, Plan, Draft, Audit, Refine, and Deliver; the pairwise evaluation skill produces structured quality reports; and the improvement skill maps recurrent findings into permanent patches to the writing skill in our 20-topic experiment. We evaluate GEIS on 20 Wikipedia Featured Article topics. Under the same generation backend, GEIS improves over the Tasi Harness default writer by 8.0 points on a 100-point PDF quality rubric and outperforms STORM on the two comparable writing dimensions, structural quality and content quality. In the 20-topic improvement experiment, the patched writing skill raises the average score from 82.90 to 86.95, with 17 out of 20 topics improved and the gain mainly coming from content quality. These results show that long-form generation can be reframed from a fixed workflow into an inspectable, modular, and evaluation-guided improvement loop.

title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
summary: Post-training is essential for refining the domain-specific capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet existing reward optimization and distribution matching methods tightly couple policy exploration with distribution alignment. This coupling forces expensive exploration directly on the policy model and severely hinders the asynchronous generation, reuse, and cross-model transfer of optimization signals. In this paper, we propose Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), a novel post-training framework that fundamentally decouples update-signal exploration from distribution alignment. Instead of utilizing the primary model for costly exploration, PUST employs a lightweight proxy model as an efficient testbed to discover high-reward behaviors. We extract the relative improvement signal between the proxy's initial and optimized states, transferring this directional update to the primary model to guide its policy alignment. This decoupled pipeline, comprising proxy exploration, update-signal extraction, and signal transfer, significantly reduces computational overhead and enables optimization signals to be asynchronously generated, cached, and reused. Crucially, by transferring relative improvements rather than absolute policy distributions, PUST naturally supports weak-to-strong improvement and seamless cross-model transfer. Systematic evaluations on Qwen3-family models across math and code domains demonstrate that update signals extracted from substantially weaker proxies can robustly and adjustably enhance stronger primary models. Ultimately, PUST transforms post-training from a monolithic online optimization process into a highly modular, reusable, and cost-efficient paradigm.

AI.title_translation: 代理探索与可复用引导：一种基于代理引导更新信号的模块化大模型后训练范式
AI.tldr: PUST框架通过解耦探索与对齐，利用轻量级代理模型生成可复用的更新信号，大幅提升了大模型后训练的效率与灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有的大模型后训练方法将策略探索与分布对齐强耦合，导致探索成本高昂，且难以实现优化信号的异步生成、复用及跨模型迁移。
AI.method: 提出PUST框架：1. 使用轻量级代理模型作为探索测试平台；2. 提取代理模型优化前后的相对改进信号；3. 将该方向性更新信号迁移至主模型进行策略对齐。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列模型上的数学与代码任务评估显示，即使使用较弱的代理模型，也能稳健且可控地提升强主模型的能力，显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: PUST通过将探索与对齐解耦，实现了大模型后训练的高效、模块化与可复用，证实了利用弱代理模型提升强模型能力的有效性。
AI.translation: 后训练对于提升大语言模型（LLM）的特定领域能力至关重要，然而现有的奖励优化和分布匹配方法将策略探索与分布对齐紧密耦合。这种耦合迫使策略模型进行昂贵的直接探索，严重阻碍了优化信号的异步生成、复用和跨模型迁移。在本文中，我们提出了代理引导更新信号迁移（PUST），这是一种全新的后训练框架，从根本上将更新信号探索与分布对齐解耦。PUST不利用主模型进行昂贵的探索，而是采用轻量级代理模型作为高效的测试平台来发现高奖励行为。我们提取代理模型初始状态与优化状态之间的相对改进信号，并将此方向性更新迁移至主模型以引导其策略对齐。这种包含代理探索、更新信号提取和信号迁移的解耦流水线，显著降低了计算开销，并使优化信号能够异步生成、缓存和复用。至关重要的是，通过迁移相对改进而非绝对策略分布，PUST自然支持弱到强的改进以及无缝的跨模型迁移。在Qwen3系列模型上针对数学和代码领域的系统性评估表明，从明显较弱的代理中提取的更新信号可以稳健且可调地增强较强的主模型。最终，PUST将后训练从单体的在线优化过程转变为一种高度模块化、可复用且具有成本效益的范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PUST的解耦后训练框架，通过轻量级代理模型探索高奖励行为，并将优化信号以相对改进的形式迁移至主模型，实现了低成本、可复用且支持跨模型迁移的大模型后训练。
AI.keywords: 大模型后训练, 代理引导, 信号迁移, 计算效率, 模块化范式
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的解耦思路，通过轻量级代理模型进行探索，将昂贵的训练过程转化为可重用的信号传递。这种范式不仅显著降低了计算成本，还为弱模型指导强模型提供了理论与实践支持，具有极高的工程价值。

title: SCOPE-RL: Optimizing Reasoning Paths Before and After Success
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) optimizes LLMs using sparse verifiable final-answer rewards. This sparse anchor reliably verifies whether a trajectory succeeds but provides no direct feedback on the reasoning path that produced it. Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain Optimization with Process Efficiency), a two-stage framework that densifies this anchor while retaining the GRPO update: Adaptive Scaffolded RL adds prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on answer-hidden sub-question chains before success, and Quality-Aware Process RL applies correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine correct trajectories after success. An expert-validated Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol evaluates useful-step density, error localization, and token efficiency beyond final-answer accuracy. On Qwen3-8B-Instruct trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math, SCOPE-RL improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 pp and reduces reasoning tokens by up to 27.1% over outcome-only GRPO; the gains hold under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, indicating that reward-signal densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL.

title: CDFM: Towards a General-Purpose Causal Discovery Foundation Model
summary: Causal discovery, the process of recovering underlying causal structures from observational data, is a fundamental pursuit across scientific disciplines. Over the past decades, numerous algorithms have been developed to tackle this challenge through workflows tailored to the specific causal mechanisms underlying each type of dataset, demonstrating effectiveness across a wide range of applications. However, as the volume and heterogeneity of real-world data continue to grow, this dataset-specific approach inevitably leads to a fragmented, test-driven paradigm that struggles to scale to the demands of modern scientific discovery. To address this, we formulate the Causal Discovery Foundation Model (CDFM) as a unified, general-purpose framework for zero-shot structural inference. To ensure reliable generalization across unknown domains, we first investigate the theoretical boundaries of causal identifiability, revealing the indispensable role of causal prior mechanisms in this process. Building on these insights, we formulate a principled variational framework that treats unknown causal mechanisms as latent variables and mathematically decomposes the intractable marginal likelihood into distinct, tractable learning modules. The variational decomposition provides a conceptual design principle for the architecture design of CDFM, while comprehensive causal knowledge guides the large-scale synthesis of our pretraining data. By pretraining on a massive, highly diverse space of synthetic structural causal models, CDFM successfully internalizes complex statistical asymmetries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDFM consistently outperforms traditional algorithms, driving a paradigm shift toward a general-purpose causal discovery foundation model.

title: CFR-Net:Collaborative Feature Refnement Network for Medical Image Anomaly Detection
summary: Medical image anomaly detection remains challenging because networks pretrained on natural images often exhibit limited adaptability to medical images, where abnormal patterns appear as fine-grained local shifts, multi-scale contextual mismatches, and orientation-sensitive structural deviations. To address this, we propose the Collaborative Feature Refinement Network (CFR-Net), which combines shared teacher-student feature refinement before decoding with cross-space consistency after decoding. CFR-Net refines frozen teacher features and trainable student features using a Multi-Path Feature Refinement Module (MPFRM) with shared parameters, imposing common multi-path refinement rules on generic visual references and representations adapted to the medical domain, thereby mitigating domain discrepancy while modeling local, multi-scale, and orientation-sensitive feature characteristics. A variance-sensitive objective and dynamic ``homework set'' reorganization further support layer-adaptive consistency learning. Experiments on medical benchmarks show that CFR-Net achieves competitive anomaly classification and strong anomaly localization performance when trained on normal data.

title: DAG-FM: A Foundation Model for Causal Discovery under Heterogeneous Causal Mechanisms
summary: Causal discovery from observational tabular data remains fundamentally challenging, primarily due to the heterogeneity of underlying causal mechanisms and the high-dimensional combinatorial search space of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). In this paper, we propose \textbf{DAG-FM}, a novel foundation model architecture that amortizes causal discovery. Unlike direct matrix prediction, DAG-FM decomposes the causal discovery process into two auto-regressive stages using two specialized Transformer-based sub-modules: a leaf-node predictor and a parent-node predictor. To effectively model complex row-column interactions, we adopt a robust tabular interaction block to output feature-wise representations. Crucially, to handle diverse and unknown Functional Causal Model (FCM) assumptions in real-world scenarios, we introduce Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE), allowing the model to dynamically route and adapt to identifiable mechanism families. Through an iterative inference algorithm, DAG-FM seamlessly extracts causal orderings and constructs valid DAGs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAG-FM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic benchmarks and complex real-world datasets, significantly outperforming traditional classical algorithms and recent foundation models in both accuracy and scalability.

title: Toward Inclusive Avatar Design with Limb Differences Through Artificial Intelligence
summary: As extended reality becomes more popular for social interaction and entertainment, 3D avatars must represent the full diversity of body types. Most 3D avatar systems only support normative bodies and do not accurately depict people with limb differences, amputations, or other morphological variations. This paper reviews emerging technical approaches for inclusive 3D avatar customization for this group and current guidelines that promote respectful and accurate representation. We highlight persistent challenges, including the scarcity of diverse datasets and the limitations in animation for non-normative anatomies. This paper positions artificial intelligence as a promising path to overcoming these limitations and advancing inclusive 3D avatar generation.

title: Dzongkha Next Word Prediction System
summary: Dzongkha, being the national language of Bhutan, is a common and widely spoken language in the country. Official documents, scriptures and other literature products are written in Dzongkha in order to retain the cultural value. However, documenting Dzongkha writing is a challenging and time-consuming process, largely due to the complexity of the script, the need for multiple keystrokes per syllable, and the limited availability of efficient typing tools. An immediate system that can predict and display a list of probable words for Dzongkha is the solution for this problem. The project is mainly aimed to make Dzongkha typing as convenient as possible by reducing the number of keystrokes. Our dataset is acquired from DCDD and has a total of 100000 sentences, 1331282 words and 28344 unique words. The data preprocessing was done by removing all the alphanumeric characters, tokenization, generating N-gram sequences and padding. Three models selected for training are LSTM, Bi-LSTM and GRU. The training process included fine-tuning of the model's hyperparameters. GRU being lightweight and able to handle larger datasets performed best with 74.03% accuracy and also solved the problem of overfitting.

AI.title_translation: 宗卡语下一个词预测系统
AI.tldr: 通过GRU模型开发宗卡语预测系统，有效减少了输入按键次数，提升了输入效率。
AI.motivation: 由于宗卡语脚本复杂、音节输入按键次数多且缺乏高效输入工具，导致文档记录过程耗时且困难，项目旨在通过预测下一个词来减少按键次数，提升输入效率。
AI.method: 使用DCDD数据集，经过清洗、分词、生成N-gram序列及填充等预处理，对比了LSTM、Bi-LSTM和GRU三种模型，并对超参数进行了微调。
AI.result: GRU模型表现最佳，准确率达到74.03%，并成功解决了过拟合问题。
AI.conclusion: GRU模型在宗卡语下一个词预测任务中表现最优，准确率达到74.03%，能有效减少输入所需的按键次数，提升输入便利性。
AI.translation: 宗卡语作为不丹的国语，在该国广泛使用。为了保留文化价值，官方文件、经文及其他文学作品均以宗卡语书写。然而，记录宗卡语书写是一个具有挑战性且耗时的过程，这主要是由于脚本的复杂性、每个音节需要多次按键以及高效打字工具的匮乏。一个能够预测并显示宗卡语可能词汇列表的即时系统是解决这一问题的方案。该项目的主要目标是通过减少按键次数，使宗卡语打字尽可能方便。我们的数据集来自DCDD，总计10万个句子、1331282个词和28344个唯一词。数据预处理工作包括删除所有字母数字字符、分词、生成N-gram序列和填充。选定用于训练的三种模型是LSTM、Bi-LSTM和GRU。训练过程包括模型超参数的微调。GRU因其轻量级且能够处理更大的数据集而表现最好，准确率为74.03%，同时也解决了过拟合问题。
AI.summary: 本文开发了一个宗卡语下一个词预测系统，旨在解决该语言输入复杂、效率低的问题。通过对DCDD数据集进行预处理，研究人员对比了LSTM、Bi-LSTM和GRU模型，发现GRU模型在处理该任务时最为高效，准确率达74.03%。
AI.keywords: 宗卡语, 下一个词预测, 深度学习, LSTM, GRU
AI.comments: 该研究针对不丹国语宗卡语（Dzongkha）输入效率低下的实际痛点，通过应用主流深度学习模型显著提升了输入体验。其创新点在于将先进的NLP技术应用于小语种的辅助输入领域，且通过实验证明了GRU模型在处理宗卡语复杂脚本时的轻量化与高效性优势。局限性在于未提及模型在实时输入场景下的具体延迟表现及用户体验评估。

title: Graph-Based Structural Evaluation of LLM-Translated Adversary Emulation Procedures
comments: This technical contribution supports the MITRE white paper titled: Evaluating LLMs for Impact-Faithful Translation of Adversary Behavior Across Operating Systems
summary: Adversary emulation plans describe multi-step attacker procedures using MITRE ATT&CK techniques, privilege requirements, and observable telemetry. Translating them across operating systems supports cross-platform defender evaluation, and large language models (LLMs) can automate this task. However, a translation may only rename tools while retaining source-platform logic, giving defenders little target-platform coverage. Binary scoring can overestimate fidelity because it measures countable features rather than structural, observable, and rule-level equivalence. Graph-Based Structural Evaluation (GBSE) models each procedure as a directed attributed graph and calculates normalized Graph Edit Distance (GED) across four layers: technique, tactic, telemetry class, and Sigma logsource. GBSE was applied to a 29-step ALPHV/BlackCat Windows-to-Linux plan, comparing a reconstructed Windows control with the unmodified LLM-generated Linux version. Technique and tactic structure were fully preserved (GED=0, similarity=1.000). Telemetry similarity fell to 0.897 (GED=3) because three steps contained unmapped or drifting observables, while Sigma logsource similarity was 1.000. Every state was classified as Medium Fidelity, with a best composite score of 0.674. The 0.80 deployment threshold was not reached because technical realism scored 0.43 against the required 0.990. The framework includes bipartite GED, a telemetry-intent parser that converts free text into observable classes, and 49 validated Sigma rules: 19 for Linux and 30 for Windows. The rules provide complete ATT&CK technique coverage and pass validation with zero findings. Additional analysis reveals technique-level divergence, including RDP-based external access mapped to unencrypted exfiltration and credential-store access mapped to remote-system discovery. Results were reproduced and verified against recorded outputs.
comment: This technical contribution supports the MITRE white paper titled: Evaluating LLMs for Impact-Faithful Translation of Adversary Behavior Across Operating Systems

AI.title_translation: 基于图的LLM翻译对抗模拟程序结构评估
AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过图结构分析评估LLM翻译对抗模拟程序质量的新框架（GBSE），发现LLM虽然能保持战术结构，但在技术细节和遥测映射上往往缺乏足够的真实性。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM翻译对抗模拟程序方法往往仅进行简单的名称替换，缺乏对结构、可观测性和规则级等价性的深层考量，导致防御者无法获得真实的目标平台覆盖。
AI.method: 提出基于图的结构评估（GBSE）框架，将对抗程序建模为有向属性图，并通过计算四个层级（技术、战术、遥测类、Sigma日志源）的归一化图编辑距离（GED）来评估翻译质量。包含遥测意图解析器及49条验证过的Sigma规则。
AI.result: 在对ALPHV/BlackCat方案的测试中，技术和战术结构保持一致（GED=0），但遥测相似度为0.897，技术现实性得分仅为0.43，最终综合得分0.674，未达到0.80的部署阈值。发现存在如RDP映射到非加密数据窃取等明显的逻辑偏差。
AI.conclusion: GBSE框架有效揭示了LLM翻译过程中的结构性差异，尽管LLM在技术和战术层面表现良好，但在底层遥测和技术现实性方面仍存在不足，未能达到高保真部署标准。
