AI.translation: 对抗模拟计划使用MITRE ATT&CK技术、权限要求和可观察的遥测数据描述多步骤攻击者程序。跨操作系统翻译这些计划有助于跨平台防御者评估，而大语言模型（LLMs）可以自动化此任务。然而，翻译可能仅重命名工具而保留源平台逻辑，导致防御者无法获得目标平台的覆盖。二元评分可能会高估保真度，因为它测量的是可计数特征，而不是结构、可观察和规则级的等价性。基于图的结构评估（GBSE）将每个程序建模为有向属性图，并计算四个层级（技术、战术、遥测类和Sigma日志源）的归一化图编辑距离（GED）。GBSE被应用于一个29步的ALPHV/BlackCat Windows到Linux计划，比较了重建的Windows对照组与未经修改的LLM生成的Linux版本。技术和战术结构被完全保留（GED=0，相似度=1.000）。遥测相似度下降到0.897（GED=3），因为三个步骤包含未映射或漂移的可观察项，而Sigma日志源相似度为1.000。每个状态都被归类为中等保真度，最佳综合得分为0.674。未达到0.80的部署阈值，因为技术现实性得分为0.43，而要求为0.990。该框架包括二分GED、将自由文本转换为可观察类的遥测意图解析器，以及49条经过验证的Sigma规则：19条用于Linux，30条用于Windows。这些规则提供了完整的ATT&CK技术覆盖，并通过了零缺陷验证。进一步分析揭示了技术层面的差异，包括将基于RDP的外部访问映射为未加密的渗透，以及将凭据存储访问映射为远程系统发现。结果已根据记录的输出进行了复现和验证。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM翻译对抗模拟程序的问题，提出了一种基于图的结构评估框架（GBSE）。通过将程序建模为有向属性图，并利用四层级GED评估其结构和语义一致性，该研究揭示了LLM在翻译过程中虽然保持了高层战术一致性，但在底层遥测和技术现实性上存在显著偏差。
AI.keywords: 对抗模拟, 大语言模型, 图编辑距离, 网络安全, 遥测分析
AI.comments: 该研究填补了评估LLM自动化安全任务生成质量的空白，超越了简单的二元评分，利用图结构分析提供了更深层的语义和结构一致性评估。这对于确保自动化网络安全防御演练的可信度至关重要。

title: Vinci2: Providing Proactive Assistance in Continuous Egocentric Videos
summary: When should an intelligent assistant speak up without being asked? Continuous egocentric video offers rich, evolving context that enables a new form of assistance: one that is proactive rather than merely reactive. Yet existing approaches either wait passively for user queries or treat every detected event as requiring a response, without considering the user's history, current activity, or whether assistance would actually be welcome. We reframe proactive assistance as a context-dependent decision problem: the agent must not only perceive what is happening, but reason over accumulated temporal context to determine when and whether to intervene. To this end, we present Vinci2, a proactive egocentric assistance system that advances the on-device assistant Vinci from reactive response toward proactivity. On the evaluation side, we present EgoServe, the first large-scale benchmark for proactive assistance in continuous egocentric video. EgoServe comprises over 3,000 service instances organized along 4 temporal memory horizons, ranging from immediate safety alerts to long-term habit coaching, across 10 service categories. On the modeling side, we propose EgoMemo, a training-free, memory-augmented agent that maintains three complementary memory representations: multi-scale temporal summaries, a semantic knowledge graph, and visual embedding archives. At each timestep, EgoMemo performs retrieval-augmented reasoning to determine whether assistance is warranted and, if so, produces contextually grounded responses. Experiments demonstrate that EgoMemo establishes strong baselines on EgoServe while remaining competitive on existing egocentric benchmarks. Our benchmark and code are publicly available at \href{https://sitonggong.github.io/EgoServe-page/}{Vinci2}.

AI.title_translation: Vinci2：在连续第一人称视频中提供主动辅助
AI.tldr: Vinci2引入了EgoMemo系统和EgoServe基准，使智能助手能够基于长短期记忆上下文，智能判断何时在第一人称视角下提供主动辅助。
AI.motivation: 现有的智能助手多为被动响应或盲目干预，缺乏对用户历史、当前活动及辅助必要性的综合判断。研究旨在解决如何基于连续的第一人称视频上下文，智能化地决定何时及是否提供主动辅助。
AI.method: 提出了EgoMemo模型，这是一种训练无关的记忆增强代理，利用多尺度时间摘要、语义知识图谱和视觉嵌入档案三种记忆表示，通过检索增强推理来决定是否提供辅助及提供何种辅助。
AI.result: EgoMemo在EgoServe基准测试中建立了强有力的基准表现，并证明了其在现有第一人称视频基准上的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: Vinci2通过EgoMemo模型和EgoServe基准，证明了在连续第一人称视频中通过综合多维度历史上下文进行主动辅助的可行性与有效性。
AI.translation: 智能助手应该在何时无需被询问就主动提供帮助？连续的第一人称视频提供了丰富的演进上下文，使一种新的辅助形式成为可能：主动辅助而非仅仅是被动响应。然而，现有方法要么被动等待用户查询，要么将每个检测到的事件都视为需要响应，而没有考虑用户的历史、当前活动或辅助是否真正受欢迎。我们将主动辅助重构为一个上下文相关的决策问题：智能体不仅要感知正在发生的事情，还要对积累的时间上下文进行推理，以确定何时以及是否进行干预。为此，我们提出了Vinci2，这是一个主动的第一人称辅助系统，它将设备端助手Vinci从被动响应推向了主动。在评估方面，我们提出了EgoServe，这是第一个用于连续第一人称视频主动辅助的大规模基准。EgoServe包含超过3000个服务实例，按4个时间记忆跨度组织，范围从即时安全警报到长期习惯辅导，涵盖10个服务类别。在建模方面，我们提出了EgoMemo，这是一个无需训练的记忆增强智能体，它维护三种互补的记忆表示：多尺度时间摘要、语义知识图谱和视觉嵌入档案。在每个时间步，EgoMemo执行检索增强推理，以确定是否需要辅助，如果需要，则产生基于上下文的响应。实验表明，EgoMemo在EgoServe上建立了强大的基准，同时在现有的第一人称视频基准上保持竞争力。我们的基准和代码已公开。
AI.summary: Vinci2是一个针对连续第一人称视频的主动辅助系统，它通过EgoMemo模型利用多维度记忆进行上下文推理，从而智能判断是否介入。同时，论文发布了EgoServe数据集，涵盖了从即时安全提醒到长期习惯辅导等多种场景。
AI.keywords: 第一人称视频, 主动辅助, 记忆增强, EgoServe, 上下文推理
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入EgoServe基准测试和EgoMemo模型，成功将第一人称视觉助手从被动响应提升为主动辅助。其创新点在于将主动辅助定义为上下文相关的决策问题，并通过多模态记忆增强实现了训练无关（training-free）的推理，这在处理复杂、长周期的第一人称视频任务时具有重要的研究价值。

title: AutoMatBench: An Automatic Optimization Toolkit for the Acceleration of Material Properties Prediction Benchmarking
summary: Material property prediction (MPP) infers key properties from chemical composition and structure, accelerating the discovery and optimization of novel materials. In the realm of MPP, MatBench is a widely accepted benchmarking tool that defines over ten significant problems and provides the paradigm of performance evaluation for AI prediction models. Even though MatBench works well in benchmarking the performances of prediction models on in-distribution (ID) tasks and datasets, it lacks the ability to reflect their performances on out-of-distribution (OOD) material data, resulting failure in new material discovery. By combining the pipelines of MatBench and the existing researches on OOD performance evaluation, this study enables a huge space of benchmarking configurations, comprehensively reflecting the performances, abilities, and disadvantages of various AI prediction models. This work reports that the discrepancy of performances at different configuration values is huge and can be illustrated with prior knowledge and novel insights, therefore consideration of causal effect of configurations on performance results is necessary. In case of the impossibility of enumerative benchmarking at every configuration, this work further proposes AutoMatBench, an automatic toolkit with Bayesian optimization. Experiments with AutoMatBench reports that, within twelve steps of optimization, the similar results with MatBench and former OOD research can be accessed while more than half of the cost are saved. Besides, this tool also yields more essential findings on MPP benchmarking, positively contributing to the cost and efficiency of new material discovery.

title: HermesHFL: Incentive-Compatible Hierarchical Federated Unlearning for Dynamic LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Hierarchical federated unlearning (HFUL) for large language model (LLM) fine-tuning faces significant challenges due to hierarchical aggregation, dynamic client participation, and strong parameter coupling in LLM adaptation. Selectively removing client contributions is particularly difficult because model updates propagate across multiple aggregation stages while unlearning requests may coincide with client departures and rejoining. To address these issues, we propose **HermesHFL**, a hierarchical federated learning framework that supports selective unlearning, dynamic client participation, and client reintegration for scalable LLM fine-tuning via parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) with LoRA. We formulate a unified optimization problem that jointly models client participation, edge association, incentive allocation, and unlearning under heterogeneous client behaviors. To solve this problem efficiently, we develop **Neogen**, a neural-guided bilevel evolutionary optimization framework that combines CMA-ES for continuous incentive optimization with a CHC-based evolutionary mechanism for discrete participation and association decisions. A neural surrogate further accelerates optimization and improves search efficiency. Extensive experiments on LLM fine-tuning tasks demonstrate that HermesHFL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in model utility, unlearning effectiveness, convergence stability, and resource efficiency.

AI.title_translation: HermesHFL：面向动态 LLM 微调的激励兼容层级联邦遗忘机制
AI.tldr: HermesHFL 是一个创新的联邦学习框架，通过 Neogen 进化算法解决了大模型微调中复杂的选择性遗忘与动态参与问题。
AI.motivation: 解决层级联邦学习中大模型微调时，因层级聚合、动态参与和参数耦合导致的难以实现选择性遗忘的问题。
AI.method: 提出 HermesHFL 框架，基于 LoRA 进行参数高效微调；构建联合优化问题模型；开发 Neogen 框架（结合 CMA-ES 和 CHC 算法）并引入神经代理加速搜索。
AI.result: 实验表明，HermesHFL 在模型效用、遗忘有效性、收敛稳定性和资源效率方面均优于现有基准方法。
AI.conclusion: HermesHFL 成功实现了一个支持动态参与和选择性遗忘的层级联邦学习框架，并通过 Neogen 算法有效解决了复杂的联合优化问题，在 LLM 微调任务中表现优异。
AI.translation: 针对大语言模型（LLM）微调的层级联邦遗忘（HFUL）由于层级聚合、动态客户端参与以及 LLM 适应中的强参数耦合，面临巨大挑战。由于模型更新在多个聚合阶段传播，且遗忘请求可能与客户端的离线与重连同时发生，选择性地移除客户端贡献变得异常困难。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 HermesHFL，这是一个通过 LoRA 进行参数高效微调（PEFT）的层级联邦学习框架，支持选择性遗忘、动态客户端参与和客户端重连，适用于可扩展的 LLM 微调。我们制定了一个统一的优化问题，在异构客户端行为下联合建模了客户端参与、边缘关联、激励分配和遗忘过程。为了高效解决该问题，我们开发了 Neogen，这是一个神经引导的双层进化优化框架，将用于连续激励优化的 CMA-ES 与用于离散参与和关联决策的基于 CHC 的进化机制相结合。神经代理进一步加速了优化并提高了搜索效率。在 LLM 微调任务上的大量实验表明，HermesHFL 在模型效用、遗忘有效性、收敛稳定性和资源效率方面始终优于现有的最先进基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 HermesHFL，一种用于动态大模型微调的层级联邦遗忘框架。该框架支持选择性遗忘与动态客户端管理，并通过 Neogen 进化优化算法解决了包含激励分配与参与决策在内的复杂联合优化问题，显著提升了系统性能。
AI.keywords: 层级联邦学习, 机器遗忘, 大语言模型, 激励机制, 进化优化
AI.comments: 该论文针对联邦学习中极具挑战性的“机器遗忘（Unlearning）”问题，特别是在大模型微调场景下，创新性地结合了层级架构、激励机制和高效的进化优化算法。其核心贡献在于平衡了模型性能与遗忘需求，并解决了动态参与带来的复杂性。限制在于其依赖于神经代理的近似，可能在极端复杂场景下的泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Parse, Search, and Confirmation: Training-Free Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning and Structured Spatial Memory
summary: In this paper, we tackle the Aerial Vision-and-Dialog Navigation (AVDN) task in the training-free setting for resource-efficient high-altitude UAV navigation.Naively applying MLLMs leads to unreliable navigation due to weak directional grounding and the lack of explicit spatial memory.To address these issues, we propose PSC-AVDN, a training-free framework that tightly couples a three-stage Parsing-Search-Confirmation reasoning pipeline with a Structured Spatial Memory (SSM).The parsing stage uses an LLM to convert ambiguous dialogue instructions into stable geometric directional and destination cues.A Search Chain-of-Thought (S-CoT) then performs stepwise target exploration under high-altitude observations, and a Confirmation Chain-of-Thought (C-CoT) conducts fine-grained verification around candidate regions to resolve visual ambiguity.Meanwhile, SSM integrates three complementary sources of spatial cues, including multi-scale visual observation, spatial visual memory, and structured geometric memory to provide global spatial context and long-horizon consistency.Extensive experiments on ANDH and ANDH-Full show that PSC-AVDN establishes new state-of-the-art performance in the training-free setting, matching or surpassing several finetuned methods.Code will be publicly available at: https://github.com/QY6616/PSC-AVDN

AI.title_translation: 解析、搜索与确认：基于思维链推理与结构化空间记忆的免训练航空视觉与对话导航
AI.tldr: PSC-AVDN 是一种无需训练的无人机导航框架，通过思维链推理和结构化空间记忆技术，解决了传统多模态模型在空间感知上的局限，显著提升了导航性能。
AI.motivation: 针对航空视觉与对话导航（AVDN）任务，现有直接应用多模态大模型（MLLM）的方法存在方向定位能力弱和缺乏显式空间记忆的问题，导致导航不可靠。
AI.method: 提出了 PSC-AVDN 框架，包含：1. 解析-搜索-确认（Parsing-Search-Confirmation）三阶段推理流程；2. 搜索思维链（S-CoT）用于目标探索；3. 确认思维链（C-CoT）用于区域验证；4. 结构化空间记忆（SSM）整合多尺度观测、视觉记忆及几何记忆以提供全局上下文。
AI.result: 在 ANDH 和 ANDH-Full 数据集上的实验表明，PSC-AVDN 在免训练设置下建立了新的 SOTA 性能，甚至超越了部分经过微调的方法。
AI.conclusion: PSC-AVDN 框架通过结合三阶段推理流程与结构化空间记忆，有效提升了无人机在无需训练场景下的导航准确性，达到了与微调方法相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们针对资源高效型高空无人机导航，探讨了免训练设置下的航空视觉与对话导航（AVDN）任务。直接应用多模态大模型（MLLM）由于方向定位能力弱且缺乏显式空间记忆，导致导航不可靠。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 PSC-AVDN，这是一个免训练框架，将三阶段的“解析-搜索-确认”推理流程与结构化空间记忆（SSM）紧密结合。解析阶段使用大语言模型将模糊的对话指令转换为稳定的几何方向和目的地提示。随后，搜索思维链（S-CoT）在高空观测下执行逐步目标探索，确认思维链（C-CoT）在候选区域周围进行细粒度验证以解决视觉歧义。同时，SSM 集成了多尺度视觉观测、空间视觉记忆和结构化几何记忆三种互补的空间提示源，以提供全局空间上下文和长程一致性。在 ANDH 和 ANDH-Full 上的广泛实验表明，PSC-AVDN 在免训练设置下建立了新的最先进性能，达到或超越了多种微调方法。代码将公开在：https://github.com/QY6616/PSC-AVDN
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 PSC-AVDN 的免训练框架，旨在解决高空无人机在视觉与对话导航任务中的方向定位与空间记忆缺失问题。该框架通过解析-搜索-确认的三阶段思维链推理，配合结构化空间记忆模块，实现了在复杂环境下的精准导航。
AI.keywords: 航空视觉与对话导航, 思维链推理, 结构化空间记忆, 无人机导航, 免训练框架
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入思维链推理（CoT）和结构化空间记忆（SSM），成功在无需额外训练的情况下提升了无人机在复杂环境下的导航性能，不仅解决了多模态大模型（MLLM）在空间感知上的弱点，还证明了推理框架在资源受限场景下的巨大潜力。

title: Learning Residual Kinematic Corrections for Continuous Neural Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Decoding continuous three-dimensional (3D) motor imagery (MI) using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG)-based brain--computer interfaces (BCIs) remains challenging due to signal variability and residual decoding errors. Deep learning architectures such as convolutional neural network--long short-term memory (CNN--LSTM) models can capture spatial and temporal dynamics for continuous kinematic decoding; however, systematic residual errors persist in predicted trajectories. We propose a two-stage decoding framework that applies reinforcement learning (RL) to perform residual kinematic correction on the outputs of a CNN--LSTM decoder (CNN--LSTM--RL). The RL agent is trained offline without direct EEG input and instead operates on predicted kinematic trajectories to optimize movement accuracy relative to target trajectories. Decoding performance was quantified using Pearson correlation coefficients ($r$) and Root Mean Square Errors (RMSE) along the $x, y$, and $z$ axes. Compared to CNN--LSTM applied alone, CNN--LSTM--RL improved the mean correlation from $0.5076$ to $0.7181$ ($p = 0.0005$) in 2D and from $0.6420$ to $0.7780$ ($p = 0.0059$) in VR, with relative gains of $41.5\%$ and $21.2\%$, respectively. Correspondingly, RMSE was reduced from $0.0890$ to $0.0532$ (2D, $p < 0.0001$) and from $0.0714$ to $0.0441$ (VR, $p < 0.0001$), representing relative reductions of $40.2\%$ and $38.2\%$. These findings demonstrate that this scalable framework enhances 3D BCI MI decoding by correcting kinematic errors via offline residual RL without extra neural data, advancing neurorehabilitation, prosthetics, and virtual interaction.

AI.title_translation: 通过强化学习学习连续神经解码的残差运动学修正
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合CNN-LSTM与离线强化学习的两阶段框架，通过对神经解码结果进行残差修正，显著提升了脑机接口对连续三维运动想象的解码精度。
AI.motivation: 非侵入式脑机接口在进行连续三维运动想象解码时，受信号变异性和系统性残差误差的影响，解码性能仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段解码框架（CNN-LSTM-RL）：第一阶段利用CNN-LSTM模型进行基础的运动轨迹解码；第二阶段引入强化学习（RL）代理，在离线状态下对CNN-LSTM的输出进行残差运动学修正，以优化运动轨迹的准确性。
AI.result: 实验表明，CNN-LSTM-RL框架在2D和虚拟现实（VR）任务中均优于单一的CNN-LSTM模型。在2D任务中，平均相关系数从0.5076提升至0.7181，RMSE显著降低；在VR任务中，平均相关系数从0.6420提升至0.7780，RMSE同样大幅下降。
AI.conclusion: CNN-LSTM-RL框架通过引入离线强化学习进行残差修正，显著提升了连续三维运动想象解码的准确性，为脑机接口的实际应用提供了更优的解决方案。
AI.translation: 使用非侵入式脑电图（EEG）脑机接口（BCI）解码连续三维（3D）运动想象（MI）由于信号变异性和残差解码误差，仍然具有挑战性。卷积神经网络-长短期记忆（CNN-LSTM）模型等深度学习架构可以捕获连续运动学解码的空间和时间动态；然而，预测轨迹中仍然存在系统性残差误差。我们提出了一个两阶段解码框架，应用强化学习（RL）对CNN-LSTM解码器的输出进行残差运动学修正（CNN-LSTM-RL）。RL代理在没有直接EEG输入的情况下离线训练，而是根据预测的运动学轨迹进行操作，以优化相对于目标轨迹的运动准确性。解码性能通过x、y和z轴上的皮尔逊相关系数（r）和均方根误差（RMSE）进行量化。与单独应用CNN-LSTM相比，CNN-LSTM-RL在2D环境中的平均相关系数从0.5076提高到0.7181（p = 0.0005），在VR环境中的平均相关系数从0.6420提高到0.7780（p = 0.0059），相对增益分别为41.5%和21.2%。相应地，RMSE从0.0890降低到0.0532（2D，p < 0.0001），从0.0714降低到0.0441（VR，p < 0.0001），分别代表了40.2%和38.2%的相对降低。这些发现表明，该可扩展框架通过离线残差RL校正运动学误差，在无需额外神经数据的情况下增强了3D BCI MI解码，推动了神经康复、假肢和虚拟交互的发展。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于两阶段解码的CNN-LSTM-RL框架，旨在解决脑机接口中连续三维运动想象解码的残差误差问题。该方法通过在CNN-LSTM解码器后增加一个离线训练的强化学习代理来修正预测轨迹，有效提升了解码精度，为神经康复和虚拟交互领域提供了更稳健的技术支持。
AI.keywords: 脑机接口, 运动想象, 强化学习, 残差校正, 连续解码
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地通过两阶段架构解决了脑机接口（BCI）中常见的残差解码误差问题。其创新之处在于利用离线强化学习（RL）对深度学习模型的输出进行后处理，而无需增加额外的神经数据采集负担，这为提升非侵入式BCI的实用性提供了一种高效且可扩展的思路。

title: Adaptive Routing for Efficient Diffusion Transformer-Based PNI Prediction
summary: Perineural invasion (PNI) is a critical prognostic factor in cholangiocarcinoma. However, its preoperative prediction from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains challenging due to subtle imaging features that extend beyond tumor boundaries into surrounding regions. Conventional convolutional neural networks are limited in capturing long-range spatial dependencies. Transformer-based architectures improve global modeling of volumetric MRI by aggregating spatially distributed contextual cues, yet capturing subtle and noise-sensitive patterns in peritumoral regions remains challenging. Diffusion-based classifiers offer an alternative formulation by leveraging denoising-based class scoring to better capture such subtle patterns. However, these approaches introduce substantial computational overhead due to the combination of transformer-based modeling and iterative denoising processes. To address these challenges, we formulate PNI prediction as a diffusion-based classification problem and implement the denoising network using a transformer-based representation. To improve computational efficiency, we introduce adaptive routing across attention heads, spatial tokens, and MLP width. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an AUC of 0.731 with 257.57 GFLOPs.

title: Evidence Subspace Projection: Measuring How Much Evidence Explains Deepfake Detection in Self-Supervised Speech Models
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) models are widely used as feature extractors for state-of-the-art audio deepfake detection, but it remains unclear how to directly and quantitatively connect what SSL models capture to detection decisions. To address this gap, we propose Evidence Subspace Projection, a method that represents both evidence factors (e.g., attack category, codec, gender, transmission) and authenticity labels in a shared space constructed from SSL models' neuron activation patterns. By projecting the decision vector onto each evidence subspace, we obtain a scalar ratio that quantifies the explanatory power of each evidence type. We evaluate SSL models in raw, fine-tuned, and post-trained settings on multiple datasets. The results confirm findings from established studies, validating the proposed method, and reveal new insights into model behavior.

AI.title_translation: 证据子空间投影：衡量证据在自监督语音模型中对深度伪造检测的解释程度
AI.tldr: 提出一种量化方法，通过将SSL模型的决策映射到特定的证据子空间，从而解释模型在深度伪造检测中关注的特征因素。
AI.motivation: 尽管自监督学习模型在音频深度伪造检测中表现出色，但目前缺乏一种直接且定量的手段来解释模型内部特征捕获内容与最终检测决策之间的联系。
AI.method: 提出了一种“证据子空间投影”方法，通过SSL模型的神经元激活模式构建证据因素（攻击类别、编解码器、性别等）与真实性标签的共享空间，并将决策向量投影到各证据子空间中，从而计算各证据类型的解释力比率。
AI.result: 通过在原始、微调和后训练设置下的多数据集评估，该方法成功验证了既有研究结论，并揭示了关于模型行为的新见解。
AI.conclusion: 证据子空间投影（ESP）方法有效量化了不同证据因素对深度伪造检测决策的影响，为评估和分析SSL模型行为提供了一个稳健的工具。
AI.translation: 自监督学习（SSL）模型被广泛用作最先进音频深度伪造检测的特征提取器，但目前尚不清楚如何将SSL模型捕获的内容与检测决策直接、定量地联系起来。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了证据子空间投影方法，该方法在由SSL模型神经元激活模式构建的共享空间中表示证据因素（如攻击类别、编解码器、性别、传输）和真实性标签。通过将决策向量投影到每个证据子空间上，我们获得了一个量化每种证据类型解释力的标量比率。我们在原始、微调和后训练设置下的多个数据集上评估了SSL模型。结果证实了既有研究的发现，验证了所提方法，并揭示了关于模型行为的新见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“证据子空间投影”的方法，旨在量化自监督学习（SSL）模型在音频深度伪造检测中的决策依据。通过将模型神经元激活模式映射到共享的证据子空间，研究人员能够计算并量化不同证据因素对检测结果的解释贡献度。
AI.keywords: 自监督学习, 深度伪造检测, 可解释性, 证据子空间投影, 特征提取
AI.comments: 该研究通过提供一种可量化的解释性框架，弥补了自监督学习（SSL）模型在深度伪造检测领域“黑盒”特性的不足。其创新之处在于利用神经元激活模式构建共享子空间，为理解模型决策提供了直观的量化指标，具有很高的可解释性研究价值。

title: Tropical Circuits with Scalar Multiplication Gates
summary: We study tropical circuits with scalar multiplication gates, that is, algebraic circuits whose gates implement $\max$, $+$, or multiplication with a positive constant. For such circuits, we prove exponential size lower bounds for computing maximum weight directed spanning trees and maximum weight bipartite perfect matchings. As a corollary, we obtain an exponential size separation between monotone and non-monotone maxout neural networks, which generalize the popularly used ReLU neural networks. One conclusion from this is that neural network models with enforced convexity constraints, such as input-convex neural networks (ICNNs), sometimes need to be exponentially larger than their unrestricted counterparts in order to express the same functions.

AI.title_translation: 带标量乘法门的热带电路
AI.tldr: 研究证明，受凸性约束的神经网络在表达能力上远弱于无约束网络，在特定任务中可能面临指数级的规模爆炸。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究热带电路模型下，单调性（凸性）约束对计算复杂度和模型表达能力的影响，特别是针对ReLU及maxout类神经网络。
AI.method: 通过分析包含max、+及正标量乘法门的热带电路，证明了计算最大权重有向生成树和最大权重二分完美匹配问题存在指数级大小下界。
AI.result: 证明了热带电路计算特定组合问题存在指数下界，并由此推导出单调与非单调maxout神经网络之间存在指数级规模差距。
AI.conclusion: 强制凸性约束（如ICNN）的神经网络在表达特定函数时，相比无约束网络可能需要指数级的规模增长。
AI.translation: 我们研究了带有标量乘法门的热带电路，即门函数实现max、+或与正标量乘法的代数电路。对于此类电路，我们证明了计算最大权重有向生成树和最大权重二分完美匹配存在指数级规模下界。作为一个推论，我们得到了单调与非单调maxout神经网络之间的指数级规模分离，这些网络推广了广泛使用的ReLU神经网络。由此得出的一个结论是，具有强制凸性约束的神经网络模型（如输入凸神经网络，ICNN）有时需要比其无约束对应模型大指数倍，才能表达相同的函数。
AI.summary: 本文研究了包含标量乘法门的热带电路，证明了其在计算最大权重有向生成树和最大权重二分完美匹配时存在指数级规模下界。该结论揭示了单调神经网络与非单调神经网络之间的指数级差距，表明凸性约束会显著增加神经网络的规模需求。
AI.keywords: 热带电路, 神经网络, 凸性约束, 指数下界, 计算复杂性
AI.comments: 该研究通过热带电路这一理论模型，揭示了单调性约束（如凸性约束）在神经网络表达能力上的局限性。其创新点在于将复杂的神经网络问题转化为热带电路的组合优化问题，为理解输入凸神经网络（ICNN）的效率问题提供了坚实的理论基础。

title: Random Label Prediction Heads for Studying Memorization in Deep Neural Networks
summary: We introduce a straightforward yet effective method to empirically study memorization in deep neural networks for classification tasks. Our approach augments each training sample with auxiliary random labels, which are then predicted by a random label prediction head (RLP-head). RLP-heads can be attached at arbitrary depths of a network, predicting random labels from the corresponding intermediate representation and thereby enabling analysis of how memorization capacity evolves across layers. By interpreting the RLP-head performance as an empirical estimate of Rademacher complexity, we obtain a direct measure of both sample-level memorization and model capacity. We leverage this random label accuracy metric to analyze generalization and overfitting in different models and datasets. Building on this approach, we further propose a novel regularization technique based on the output of the RLP-head, which demonstrably reduces memorization. Interestingly, our experiments reveal that reducing memorization can either improve or impair generalization, depending on the dataset and training setup. These findings challenge the traditional assumption that overfitting is equivalent to memorization and suggest new hypotheses to reconcile these seemingly contradictory results. The source code is available at https://github.com/MarlonBecker/RandomLabelHeads

AI.title_translation: 用于研究深度神经网络记忆机制的随机标签预测头
AI.tldr: 通过在神经网络中添加随机标签预测头来量化记忆能力，研究发现减少记忆并不总是能改善泛化，挑战了记忆与过拟合的传统关联。
AI.motivation: 为了实证研究深度神经网络中的记忆机制，理解记忆能力如何在网络层间演变，并探索记忆与模型泛化、过拟合之间的关系。
AI.method: 在神经网络的任意深度添加辅助随机标签预测头（RLP-head），通过预测随机标签来估计Rademacher复杂度，从而衡量样本级记忆能力和模型容量，并提出了一种基于RLP-head输出的正则化技术。
AI.result: 该方法能有效衡量样本级记忆与模型容量；提出的正则化技术能显著降低记忆；实验发现减少记忆对泛化的影响取决于数据集和训练设置，这表明记忆并不总是与过拟合直接相关。
AI.conclusion: 通过RLP-head量化记忆能力揭示了记忆与泛化之间的复杂关系，表明减少记忆并不总是能提升泛化性能，从而挑战了过拟合等同于记忆的传统认知。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了一种直接且有效的方法，用于实证研究深度神经网络在分类任务中的记忆机制。我们的方法通过辅助随机标签增强每个训练样本，并由一个随机标签预测头（RLP-head）进行预测。RLP-head可以附加在网络的任意深度，从相应的中间表示中预测随机标签，从而能够分析记忆能力如何在各层之间演变。通过将RLP-head的性能解释为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，我们获得了衡量样本级记忆和模型容量的直接指标。我们利用该随机标签准确率指标来分析不同模型和数据集的泛化与过拟合情况。基于此方法，我们进一步提出了一种基于RLP-head输出的新型正则化技术，该技术可显著减少记忆。有趣的是，我们的实验表明，减少记忆既可以改善也可以损害泛化，具体取决于数据集和训练设置。这些发现挑战了过拟合等同于记忆的传统假设，并提出了新的假设来调和这些看似矛盾的结果。源代码可在 https://github.com/MarlonBecker/RandomLabelHeads 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用辅助随机标签预测头（RLP-head）来量化深度神经网络记忆能力的方法。通过在网络不同深度引入RLP-head，研究者能够分析记忆容量的演变，并据此提出一种新型正则化技术。研究发现，记忆与泛化之间的关系比预想的更为复杂，挑战了过拟合等同于记忆的传统观点。
AI.keywords: 深度神经网络, 记忆机制, 随机标签预测头, 泛化能力, 过拟合
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种通过辅助随机标签预测头（RLP-head）来量化深度神经网络记忆能力的方法，不仅为理解模型内部表征的记忆演变提供了可视化工具，还挑战了过拟合等同于记忆的传统观点，为理解泛化性提供了新的视角。

title: Condition-Stratified Robustness Analysis of Post-Hoc Calibration Methods for Probabilistic Classifiers
summary: Post-hoc calibration is widely adopted to correct probability estimates from trained classifiers, yet most evaluations report aggregate performance without testing whether that performance holds across distinct operating conditions within a single dataset. We present a pre-registered, condition-stratified robustness analysis comparing temperature scaling (TEMP) and isotonic regression (ISO) across four controlled conditions (C1--C4). Four hypothesis groups are evaluated: discrimination deltas with Holm-corrected multiplicity control (H1), Brier score differences (H2), calibration slope outcomes (H3), and AUROC differences under best-condition setups (H4). TEMP-minus-ISO discrimination deltas remain small across all conditions (-0.0155 to 0.0139), with Holm-adjusted p-values of 0.9895 everywhere. TEMP Brier differences are consistently negative (C1: -0.0002 through C4: -0.0074), while ISO shows sign reversals. TEMP calibration slopes stay closer to unity in every condition (range 0.7597--0.9493) than ISO slopes (0.1364--0.2726). AUROC differences shift from near zero in C1 (-0.0004) to positive in C4 (0.0264). These results establish that in-dataset robustness is condition-dependent and metric-specific. No claim of external transportability is made.

title: Training-Free Off-Screen Player Imputation for Broadcast-Based Spatial Football Analytics
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nowayfootball/offscreen-impute
summary: Spatial football metrics such as pitch control assume access to the positions of all 22 players, yet the most widely available source of positional data -- the broadcast main camera -- shows only 10-16 of them at any moment. We quantify the resulting distortion with an open, reproducible benchmark: a simulated broadcast viewport applied to open full-pitch tracking data (Metrica Sports; three matches, one held out from method development). Ignoring off-screen players -- the visible-only baseline implied whenever a video-based game-state-reconstruction (GSR) pipeline adds no imputation layer -- inflates hidden-zone pitch-control error to 25.1-26.9 percentage points and a mean absolute control-share error of 11.1-13.4 points across the three matches. We then evaluate a ladder of training-free, online imputation baselines that use only observations from the match being analysed. The best overall on these decision-relevant metrics, role-anchored centroid voting (each visible player votes for the full-team centroid by subtracting its running role offset, attenuating the viewport-induced subset bias), roughly halves hidden-zone error (to 12.2-13.8 points) and cuts control-share error to 28-48% of the ignore policy at every viewport width from 36 m to 60 m in all three matches. For occlusions <=9.6 s -- the regime of the closest learned prior work -- it reaches binwise median position errors of 3.3-8.9 m; but 50-57% of hidden-player observations lie beyond that regime. Integrated end-to-end into a broadcast-video GSR pipeline, imputation moves a downstream possession-quality score (Space-Creation Index) by 15.6 and 17.2 points on two real World Cup broadcast windows, flipping the verdict class in one.
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/nowayfootball/offscreen-impute

AI.title_translation: 用于基于广播的空间足球分析的免训练屏幕外球员插值方法
AI.tldr: 针对广播视频中部分球员缺失的问题，提出了一种无需训练的“角色锚定质心投票”插值法，显著提高了足球空间分析的准确度。
AI.motivation: 现有的足球空间度量（如球场控制）依赖于所有球员的位置，但广播视频通常只能捕捉到部分球员，导致数据缺失和度量结果严重失真。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的在线插值基准方法——“角色锚定质心投票”（role-anchored centroid voting），即每位可见球员通过减去其运行角色偏移量来为全队质心投票，从而缓解视口引起的子集偏差。
AI.result: 该方法将隐藏区域的球场控制误差降低了约一半，并将控制份额误差削减至忽略缺失策略的 28%-48%。在实际世界杯广播视频的应用中，该方法显著改变了空间创造指数的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色锚定质心投票法进行屏幕外球员插值，能有效降低数据缺失带来的度量偏差，显著提升基于广播视频的足球空间分析质量。
AI.translation: 空间足球度量（如球场控制）通常假设可以获取所有 22 名球员的位置，然而最广泛可用的位置数据来源——广播主摄像头——在任何时刻通常只显示其中的 10-16 名球员。我们通过一个开放且可复现的基准测试量化了由此产生的失真：将模拟广播视口应用于开放的全场追踪数据（Metrica Sports；三场比赛，其中一场用于方法开发）。如果不考虑屏幕外的球员（即当基于视频的游戏状态重建流水线未添加任何插值层时隐含的“仅可见”基准），隐藏区域的球场控制误差会膨胀至 25.1-26.9 个百分点，三场比赛的平均绝对控制份额误差为 11.1-13.4 个点。随后，我们评估了一系列免训练的在线插值基准，这些基准仅使用当前分析比赛的观测数据。在这些决策相关指标上，表现最好的方法是“角色锚定质心投票”（每位可见球员通过减去其运行角色偏移量来为全队质心投票，从而减轻视口引起的子集偏差），该方法将隐藏区域的误差大约减半（降至 12.2-13.8 个点），并将控制份额误差在所有视口宽度（36 米至 60 米）下削减至忽略策略的 28%-48%。对于遮挡时间小于等于 9.6 秒的情况（这是最接近的已学习先前工作的范围），其分箱中位位置误差达到 3.3-8.9 米；但 50-57% 的隐藏球员观测处于该范围之外。将该插值方法集成到广播视频游戏状态重建流水线中，在两个真实的世界杯广播片段中，空间创造指数（Space-Creation Index）分别变动了 15.6 和 17.2 个点，并在其中一个片段中改变了结论分类。
AI.summary: 本文针对广播视频无法捕捉所有球员位置导致的足球空间分析误差问题，提出了一种无需训练的在线球员插值方法。通过角色锚定质心投票策略，该方法有效校正了视口偏差，显著提升了球场控制和空间创造指数等下游分析指标的准确性。
AI.keywords: 足球分析, 球员位置插值, 广播视频, 空间度量, 角色锚定
AI.comments: 该研究针对足球分析中常见的“屏幕外球员缺失”问题，提出了一种无需训练的插值方法。其创新之处在于利用“角色锚定质心投票”策略，不仅简单高效，而且在处理视频数据时显著提升了空间度量（如球场控制权和空间创造指数）的准确性。这对于仅依赖广播摄像头的足球数据分析具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Machines that Predict Trajectories from Templates
comments: Abridged version submitted for journal publication
summary: We study trajectory prediction from libraries of stored output templates. Given the past of an unknown trajectory, the goal is to predict its future without identifying the state-space model that generated it. We show that libraries of trajectories generated by one or more dynamical systems define behavioral spaces that can be used as prediction mechanisms. For linear systems, we characterize exact prediction in terms of continuation maps, behavioral containment, and spectral conditions on output-visible eigenvalues. We also analyze robustness to noisy observations and noisy libraries, derive error bounds for out-of-library trajectories, and show how interconnection constraints can compose template libraries into new behavioral spaces with emergent modes. Finally, we extend the framework to nonlinear systems whose output trajectories are contained in, or immersed into, finite-dimensional linear behaviors. These results provide a theory of template-based prediction machines capable of generalizing beyond the stored trajectories and, in some cases, beyond the systems that generated them.
comment: Abridged version submitted for journal publication

AI.title_translation: 基于模板的轨迹预测机器
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需显式建模，直接利用存储的轨迹模板库来预测未知系统未来行为的新方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的轨迹预测通常依赖于识别生成轨迹的状态空间模型，这在模型复杂或未知时非常困难。因此，作者旨在探索一种无需显式建模，直接基于已知轨迹模板库进行未来预测的方法。
AI.method: 利用存储的轨迹库定义行为空间，通过延续映射（continuation maps）、行为包含关系（behavioral containment）以及输出可见特征值（output-visible eigenvalues）的谱条件进行预测；并引入互联约束实现模板组合，将框架扩展至部分非线性系统。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在特定条件下可实现精确预测，推导了对噪声观测和噪声模板的鲁棒性，给出了库外轨迹的误差界限，并展示了通过模板组合生成新行为模式的能力。
AI.conclusion: 该论文构建了一套基于行为模板的轨迹预测理论体系，证明了利用存储的模板库可以在无需显式建模的情况下实现对复杂动力系统轨迹的有效预测。
AI.translation: 我们研究了基于存储输出模板库的轨迹预测问题。给定未知轨迹的过去，目标是在不识别生成该轨迹的状态空间模型的情况下预测其未来。我们证明了由一个或多个动力系统生成的轨迹库定义了可用作预测机制的行为空间。对于线性系统，我们通过延续映射、行为包含关系以及输出可见特征值的谱条件来刻画精确预测。我们还分析了对噪声观测和噪声库的鲁棒性，推导了库外轨迹的误差界限，并展示了互联约束如何将模板库组合成具有涌现模式的新行为空间。最后，我们将该框架扩展到输出轨迹包含在或嵌入到有限维线性行为中的非线性系统。这些结果提供了一种基于模板的预测机器理论，能够超越存储的轨迹进行泛化，在某些情况下甚至能超越生成这些轨迹的原始系统。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于存储模板库的轨迹预测框架，无需识别生成轨迹的状态空间模型。通过利用动力系统的行为空间特性，该方法实现了对线性系统和部分非线性系统的精确预测，并具备处理噪声、评估误差界限及组合模板生成新行为的能力。
AI.keywords: 轨迹预测, 动力系统, 行为空间, 模板库, 线性系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的轨迹预测范式，跳过了传统的系统建模过程，直接利用已知的行为模板库进行预测。这种方法在处理复杂或未知的动力系统时具有显著的实用价值，特别是在处理线性系统和特定非线性系统时，提供了严谨的数学理论支持。其局限性在于对模板库的覆盖范围及质量有一定依赖。

title: Advancing Optimal Subset Oracle via Learning Relaxation of Neural Set Functions
summary: Learning neural set functions is pivotal to a wide range of important applications, including compound selection in AI-driven drug discovery and product recommendation. Recent work has introduced optimal subset oracles to implicitly learn set functions under practical weakly supervised settings, where model parameters are optimized through mean-field variational inference. However, these frameworks rely on Monte Carlo sampling to estimate gradients of the evidence lower bound when updating the variational distribution. Repeated sampling across iterations incurs substantial computational overhead, while the resulting stochasticity can destabilize the optimization trajectory. In this work, we reinterpret the evidence lower bound as a continuous relaxation of the set function and learn a surrogate objective that replaces sampling-based ELBO gradient estimation during variational optimization. The learned surrogate provides stable and efficient gradients throughout the continuous domain, thereby reducing computational overhead and accelerating inference. Furthermore, we establish an approximation guarantee for the proposed framework under submodular maximization and characterize its connection to variational free energy. Experiments on a variety of real-world tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing baselines.

title: Single-Teacher View Augmentation: Enhancing Knowledge Distillation with Student-Guided Perturbations
summary: Knowledge distillation (KD) typically relies on the fixed perspective of a single teacher, limiting the diversity of supervisory signals. While multi-teacher distillation addresses this by aggregating knowledge from multiple models, it incurs prohibitive computational and storage costs. To balance efficiency and diversity, recent research has focused on generating virtual views from a single teacher. However, existing methods face a trade-off: random perturbation approaches offer efficiency but lack controlled diversity, while structured augmentation methods require multi-stage training and incur linear parameter growth. We observe that this trade-off stems from a common design choice: using the teacher's strong but static features to generate views. Instead, we propose Shift-Augmented Knowledge Distillation (SAKD), a simple yet effective framework that leverages the student's evolving features as a dynamic condition for perturbation generation. This shift in perspective enables single-stage training while producing adaptive, diverse views through a parameter-free cyclic shift. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet demonstrate that SAKD consistently outperforms random perturbation methods and achieves accuracy on par with two-stage approaches, while using significantly fewer parameters and eliminating pre-training requirements.

AI.title_translation: 单教师视图增强：利用学生引导的扰动增强知识蒸馏
AI.tldr: SAKD通过利用学生模型特征动态生成教师视图，在无需增加额外参数和多阶段训练的情况下，显著提升了单教师知识蒸馏的效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的知识蒸馏方法在多样性与效率之间存在权衡：多教师蒸馏成本过高，而单教师的随机扰动缺乏受控的多样性，结构化增强则需要昂贵的多阶段训练。作者旨在解决这一权衡，通过改变视角，利用学生模型的动态特征来指导增强。
AI.method: 提出了“移位增强知识蒸馏”（SAKD）框架。该方法利用学生模型不断演化的特征作为动态条件，通过参数无关的循环移位（cyclic shift）技术，为单教师模型生成多样化的虚拟视图，从而在单阶段训练中实现知识蒸馏。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明，SAKD的性能优于现有的随机扰动方法，且在参数量显著减少、无需预训练的情况下，达到了与两阶段蒸馏方法相当的准确率。
AI.conclusion: SAKD通过学生引导的动态扰动，在保持单阶段训练高效性的同时，实现了与复杂多阶段蒸馏方法相当的性能，是一种高效且鲁棒的蒸馏框架。
AI.translation: 知识蒸馏（KD）通常依赖于单一教师的固定视角，这限制了监督信号的多样性。虽然多教师蒸馏通过聚合多个模型的知识来解决这一问题，但它会产生高昂的计算和存储成本。为了平衡效率和多样性，近期的研究集中于从单一教师生成虚拟视图。然而，现有方法面临权衡：随机扰动方法虽然高效但缺乏受控的多样性，而结构化增强方法则需要多阶段训练并导致参数线性增长。我们观察到这种权衡源于一个共同的设计选择：使用教师强大但静态的特征来生成视图。相反，我们提出了移位增强知识蒸馏（SAKD），这是一个简单而有效的框架，它利用学生不断演化的特征作为扰动生成的动态条件。这种视角转换实现了单阶段训练，并通过参数无关的循环移位产生自适应、多样的视图。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet上的大量实验表明，SAKD始终优于随机扰动方法，并达到了与两阶段方法相当的准确率，同时显著减少了参数使用并消除了预训练需求。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为SAKD的知识蒸馏框架，旨在通过利用学生模型的动态演化特征来引导单教师模型的视图生成。该方法通过参数无关的循环移位技术，在单阶段训练中实现了高效且多样化的知识蒸馏，显著优于传统的随机扰动方法，并兼顾了计算效率与预测准确性。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 视图增强, 学生引导, 动态扰动, 性能优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的视角，即利用学生模型的动态特征来引导教师模型的视图增强，而非仅依赖教师模型本身。这种方法巧妙地平衡了知识蒸馏中多样性与计算效率之间的矛盾，避免了复杂的多阶段训练，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Technical Report on the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge
summary: Vision-language agents (VLAs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support safety-critical reasoning. This report presents the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge on adversarial multimodal attacks against autonomous-driving VLAs. Built on DriveLM-style multi-view visual question answering, the challenge represents each scene with six synchronized camera images and a structured collection of driving-related question-answer pairs. Participants generate adversarial images and suffix-only textual perturbations that induce model responses to deviate from reference answers while preserving image fidelity and limiting textual cost. The competition comprises two phases, with Phase II adding a hidden black-box model to assess transferability. We describe the task design, submission rules, evaluation protocol, and leaderboard results, and then examine five leading submissions for which technical reports were available. Across these reports, several recurring patterns emerge: image-side attacks are favored by the suffix penalty; scene-level, multi-view optimization is more effective than treating views in isolation; QA types and graph structure provide useful priors for allocating attack budget; feature-space objectives can improve black-box transfer; and typographic content embedded in camera images exposes a persistent vulnerability in driving VLAs. These findings provide a practical reference for future robustness evaluation and defense design in multimodal autonomous-driving systems.

title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
summary: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining strategy that jointly learns image-to-text generation and pixel-level document reconstruction: the former aligns visual representations with textual content, while the latter preserves character strokes and layout details. Extensive experiments are conducted on five representative document analysis tasks, including text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation. Replacing the original encoders with MonkeyOCRv2 consistently improves performance across all five tasks. Finally, we validate its effectiveness as the vision encoder of multimodal large language models on the more challenging tasks of document parsing and document understanding. Kept frozen and paired with a lightweight language model, it yields a 0.7B document parsing model that sets a new open-source state-of-the-art on MDPBench, a recent benchmark spanning digital-born and photographed documents across 17 languages, surpassing the previous best 3B dots.mocr by 2.8% absolute with a vision encoder roughly 11$\times$ smaller. The frozen encoder also powers a document understanding model that outperforms counterparts built on CLIP, DINO, and SAM across eight benchmarks under identical training settings. These results suggest that document-oriented visual pretraining can serve as a foundation for document intelligence in its own right.

AI.title_translation: MonkeyOCRv2：面向文档 AI 的视觉-文本基础模型
AI.tldr: MonkeyOCRv2 通过专门的文档视觉预训练，以更小的模型规模在多项文档分析与理解任务中实现了领先性能，是文档智能领域的强大基础模型。
AI.motivation: 主流视觉编码器主要在自然图像上预训练，缺乏对文档图像中密集文本和细粒度字符特征的感知能力，难以直接应用于文档 AI 任务。
AI.method: 1. 构建了包含 1.13 亿张图像的超大规模文档预训练数据集 MonkeyDoc v2；2. 采用联合预训练策略，同时进行图像到文本的生成学习（对齐视觉与文本）和像素级文档重建（保留字符与布局细节）。
AI.result: 在五项文档分析任务中均实现性能提升；作为多模态大模型的视觉编码器，在 MDPBench 上以 1/11 的参数规模超越了之前的最佳模型，并在八个文档理解基准测试中优于 CLIP、DINO 和 SAM 等模型。
AI.conclusion: MonkeyOCRv2 证明了专门针对文档图像的视觉预训练能够显著提升文档 AI 任务的性能，并可作为多模态大模型的强大视觉编码器，为文档智能提供了高效的基础架构。
AI.translation: 主流视觉编码器是在自然图像上进行预训练的，如果没有针对文档的适应，就不能有效地应用于文档图像，因为密集的文本和细粒度的字符笔画需要字符级的视觉感知。我们提出了 MonkeyOCRv2，这是一种用于文档 AI 的视觉-文本预训练模型。首先，我们构建了 MonkeyDoc v2，据我们所知，这是最大的文档图像预训练语料库，包含跨越 17 种语言的 1.13 亿张图像。其次，我们提出了一种联合学习图像到文本生成和像素级文档重建的预训练策略：前者将视觉表征与文本内容对齐，后者保留字符笔画和布局细节。我们在五项代表性的文档分析任务上进行了广泛的实验，包括文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测和重叠文本分割。用 MonkeyOCRv2 替换原始编码器，在所有五项任务中都持续提升了性能。最后，我们在更具挑战性的文档解析和文档理解任务中验证了其作为多模态大模型视觉编码器的有效性。在保持冻结并与轻量级语言模型配对的情况下，它产生了一个 0.7B 的文档解析模型，在 MDPBench（一个涵盖 17 种语言的数字原生和拍摄文档的最新基准）上设定了新的开源最先进水平，比之前最好的 3B dots.mocr 模型高出 2.8% 的绝对值，而视觉编码器体积缩小了约 11 倍。该冻结编码器还驱动了一个文档理解模型，在相同的训练设置下，其在八个基准测试中的表现优于基于 CLIP、DINO 和 SAM 的对应模型。这些结果表明，面向文档的视觉预训练本身就可以作为文档智能的基础。
AI.summary: MonkeyOCRv2 是一款专为文档 AI 设计的视觉-文本基础模型。通过使用大规模文档数据集 MonkeyDoc v2 和独特的联合生成与重建预训练策略，该模型显著增强了对文档细节的感知能力，并在多项文档分析与理解任务中展现出优于通用视觉编码器的性能及极高的参数效率。
AI.keywords: 文档 AI, 视觉预训练, 多模态大模型, 文档解析, 字符感知
AI.comments: MonkeyOCRv2 创新性地提出了针对文档领域的视觉预训练方法，通过构建大规模数据集 MonkeyDoc v2 和联合生成式与重建式的预训练策略，解决了通用视觉模型在处理密集文本和细粒度字符时的不足。其在多项任务中表现出的强大通用性和轻量化优势，证明了领域专用视觉基础模型在文档 AI 领域的重要性。

title: Linux disk encryption and self-encrypting drives -- A case study on Opal2 drives security
summary: Opal2 self-encrypting drives provide hardware-based disk encryption serving as an additional layer of protection, or a replacement, for software-based solutions. This paper presents a case study of real-world Linux integration of Opal2 drives and the security of Opal2 firmware. The study was conducted on a testbed of 38 commercial off-the-shelf Opal2 drives from various vendors using a black-box approach. We identified several firmware security issues and incompatibilities, which we responsibly disclosed to respective vendors. Our findings led to improvements in Linux disk encryption tools used across all major Linux distributions. To enable independent evaluation for the public, we release our test scenarios for Opal2 drives as an open-source toolset.

title: PaperRouter-Agent: A Content-Grounded LLM Agent for Personalized Hierarchical Paper Routing
summary: Researchers organize the papers they collect into personal folder hierarchies in reference managers, and route each new paper into the folder where it belongs. This task differs from standard hierarchical text classification. A user's folder hierarchy is not a fixed, shared taxonomy but a private and evolving folksonomy whose folder meanings may be topical, shorthand, venue-based, or process-oriented, and are often defined by the papers already stored inside them. We formalize this setting as personalized hierarchical paper routing (PHPR): assigning an incoming paper to folders in a user-specific hierarchy without per-user training. We propose PaperRouter-Agent, a training-free LLM agent that grounds routing decisions in folder members rather than folder names alone. The agent first narrows the candidate hierarchy, retrieves folder-specific evidence, verifies fit by inspecting member papers, and incorporates similarity-gated feedback from past user rejections. A formative study on real personal libraries shows that PaperRouter-Agent raises overall Recall@1 from 0.39 to 0.61 and Recall@3 from 0.57 to 0.83, with the largest gains on organizational folders defined by metadata such as venue or year, where single-shot methods collapses (Recall@1 0.09 to 0.50). On the public LaMP-2 benchmark, the same approach improves accuracy from 44.5% to 51.5% (+9.0 macro-F1) over a single-shot baseline, while remaining low-cost for practical use.

title: Heuristic Learning for Active Flow Control Using Coding Agents
summary: Active flow control involves nonlinear dynamics, partial observations, and computationally expensive simulations, making controller design particularly challenging. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a powerful framework for such problems, but its success typically relies on large numbers of simulator interactions and produces neural-network policies whose decision process often remains difficult to interpret. In this work, we investigate a different paradigm: instead of optimizing neural-network parameters, we use modern coding agents to search directly for explicit executable feedback laws. We introduce a constrained heuristic-learning protocol in which an agent iteratively proposes, evaluates, and revises controller implementations while interacting exclusively through the public benchmark interface. The proposed framework is evaluated on 13 active flow-control benchmarks spanning one, two, and three-dimensional problems and compared against the strongest available DRL baselines under identical simulation budgets. The discovered heuristic controllers match or outperform the best DRL policy in 10 of the 13 environments while remaining compact, interpretable, and directly inspectable. Beyond aggregate performance, the resulting controllers reveal physically meaningful feedback mechanisms, transfer successfully across more challenging configurations, and remain competitive under varying Reynolds and Rayleigh numbers, actuator counts, and observation sparsity. These results suggest that heuristic learning through coding agents constitutes a credible and complementary alternative to conventional reinforcement learning, combining competitive performance with physically interpretable controller representations. Prompts and source code are available at https://github.com/DonsetPG/fluid-heuristic-learning.

AI.title_translation: 利用编码智能体进行主动流控的启发式学习
AI.tldr: 通过编码智能体直接编写可执行的控制代码，在主动流控任务中实现了比深度强化学习更具可解释性和鲁棒性的性能表现。
AI.motivation: 针对主动流控中深度强化学习训练成本高且神经网络策略难以解释的问题，探索一种能够直接生成可解释、可执行反馈律的替代方案。
AI.method: 引入一种受限的启发式学习协议，利用编码智能体通过与基准测试接口交互，迭代地提出、评估和修改显式的可执行反馈控制律，而非优化神经网络参数。
AI.result: 在13个主动流控基准测试中，所生成的启发式控制器在10个环境中达到或超过了最强深度强化学习基线的表现，且具备更好的可解释性、物理洞察力及跨配置迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过编码智能体进行启发式学习，在主动流控任务中能够产生比深度强化学习更具可解释性、紧凑且性能相当的控制策略，证明了该方法作为传统强化学习替代方案的可行性与优势。
AI.translation: 主动流控涉及非线性动力学、部分观测和计算昂贵的模拟，使得控制器设计极具挑战性。深度强化学习（DRL）已成为此类问题的强大框架，但其成功通常依赖于大量的模拟器交互，且生成的神经网络策略决策过程往往难以解释。在这项工作中，我们研究了一种不同的范式：我们不优化神经网络参数，而是使用现代编码智能体直接搜索显式的可执行反馈律。我们引入了一种受限的启发式学习协议，智能体在其中仅通过公共基准测试接口进行交互，迭代地提出、评估和修改控制器实现。所提框架在涵盖一维、二维和三维问题的13个主动流控基准测试中进行了评估，并在相同的模拟预算下与现有的最强DRL基线进行了比较。在13个环境中的10个中，发现的启发式控制器匹配或超过了最佳DRL策略，同时保持了紧凑、可解释和可直接检查的特性。除了总体性能外，生成的控制器揭示了具有物理意义的反馈机制，在更具挑战性的配置中成功迁移，并在不同的雷诺数、瑞利数、执行器数量和观测稀疏度下保持竞争力。这些结果表明，通过编码智能体进行的启发式学习构成了传统强化学习的一种可靠且互补的替代方案，将竞争性性能与物理可解释的控制器表示相结合。提示词和源代码可在 https://github.com/DonsetPG/fluid-heuristic-learning 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用编码智能体进行启发式学习的主动流控新范式，通过迭代生成显式反馈控制律代替神经网络优化。实验表明，该方法在保持高性能的同时，实现了控制器的高度可解释性与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 主动流控, 启发式学习, 编码智能体, 可解释性, 深度强化学习
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地提出了一种利用大语言模型（编码智能体）直接生成可执行控制代码的方法，而非依赖传统的深度强化学习训练神经网络。其重要性在于解决了控制策略“黑盒”不可解释的问题，并展现了出色的泛化能力和物理可解释性。局限性在于高度依赖编码智能体的推理能力和所设计的启发式协议。

title: Geometric Scaling of Battery Cells and Its Effect on Key Performance Indicators
summary: This paper presents a computationally lightweight scaling model for cylindrical lithium-ion battery cells, intended for early-stage battery design-space exploration. The model maps selected geometric and electrode-level design variables, including cell height, cell diameter, cathode active loading, and cathode porosity, to cell-level performance indicators such as capacity, DC internal resistance, mass, volume, and winding length. The scaling model is validated against available cylindrical cell data by comparing predicted capacity, internal resistance, and winding length. The validated model is subsequently used in a single-cell design-space exploration and global sensitivity analysis to evaluate capacity, internal resistance, gravimetric energy density, and volumetric energy density. The results identify the dominant design variables, favourable parameter directions, and key trade-offs between cell geometry, electrode loading, resistance, and energy density. The proposed model provides a basis for future integration into higher-level battery system and vehicle optimization frameworks.

title: Algebraic Invariant Quadratization Schemes for Cahn--Hilliard Equations
summary: In this paper, we propose the Algebraic Invariant Quadratization (AIQ) framework for rational-like energy functions by introducing auxiliary variables, which are interpreted as Casimir functions of the extended system. Combining AIQ with symplectic Runge--Kutta (SRK) methods in time and Fourier pseudo-spectral discretization in space, we obtain fully discrete schemes. The resulting schemes are applied to Cahn--Hilliard equations in both the isotropic and anisotropic cases. We analyze the discrete dispersion relation, spinodal instability, coarsening behavior, and missing-orientation phenomena. Numerical comparisons demonstrate the improved performance superiority of the proposed method over the stabilized invariant energy quadratization (S-IEQ) and scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) methods in preserving the original energy evolution and capturing the underlying physical phenomena.

title: ERR@HRI 3.0 Challenge: Multimodal Detection of Errors and Anticipation in Human-Robot Interactions
summary: As robots become increasingly integrated into human environments, their ability to detect and respond to errors remains critical for maintaining user trust and interaction quality. While recent advances in machine learning have improved error detection capabilities, most approaches are limited to specific contexts, controlled settings, or pre-extracted features, limiting their generalizability and applicability to real-world conditions. To address this challenge, the third edition of the ERR@HRI Challenge (ERR@HRI 3.0) provided researchers with two complementary datasets that enable end-to-end innovation in methods for both detecting and preventing errors in human-robot interaction. The challenge offered raw, non-anonymized video data from naturalistic settings: (1) the Bystander Affect Detection (BAD) dataset, containing webcam recordings of 45 participants' spontaneous reactions to robot and human failure scenarios; and (2) the Bad Idea dataset, featuring 29 participants' anticipatory facial responses while predicting action outcomes before failures occur. Both datasets were collected via crowdsourcing, capturing the inherent variability of real-world conditions. This naturalistic variability, while challenging, provides an authentic testbed for developing robust error detection systems. Participants developed multimodal machine learning models for bystander reaction detection (Track 1) and anticipatory outcome prediction (Track 2), with an optional cross-dataset generalization track (Track 3). Three teams submitted valid models, all of which surpassed our convolutional neural network baselines. This paper describes the datasets, tasks, baselines, and results of ERR@HRI 3.0, and discusses implications for building generalizable, context-aware, and anticipatory error detection systems for human-robot interaction.

AI.title_translation: ERR@HRI 3.0 挑战赛：人机交互中错误检测与预期行为的多模态分析
AI.tldr: ERR@HRI 3.0 通过提供两个真实场景下的多模态数据集，挑战并成功提升了人机交互中错误检测与行为预测模型的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有错误检测方法多局限于特定场景或受控环境，缺乏在复杂、真实的现实世界条件下的泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用了多模态机器学习方法，通过两个数据集（BAD 和 Bad Idea）进行训练，并与卷积神经网络（CNN）基线模型进行对比。
AI.result: 所有参赛的三个团队的模型表现均优于挑战赛设定的卷积神经网络基线模型。
AI.conclusion: ERR@HRI 3.0 挑战赛成功地促进了多模态错误检测与预测模型的发展，其提供的数据集为未来构建更具通用性和上下文感知能力的人机交互系统奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 随着机器人日益融入人类环境，其检测并响应错误的能力对于维护用户信任和交互质量至关重要。尽管机器学习的最新进展提高了错误检测能力，但大多数方法仅限于特定上下文、受控设置或预提取特征，限制了其在现实世界条件下的泛化能力和适用性。为了应对这一挑战，第三届 ERR@HRI 挑战赛（ERR@HRI 3.0）为研究人员提供了两个互补的数据集，旨在实现人机交互中检测和预防错误方法的端到端创新。该挑战赛提供了来自自然场景的原始、非匿名视频数据：（1）旁观者情绪检测（BAD）数据集，包含 45 名参与者对机器人和人类失败场景的自发反应的网络摄像头记录；以及（2）坏主意（Bad Idea）数据集，包含 29 名参与者在预测动作结果时的预期面部反应。两个数据集均通过众包收集，捕捉了现实世界条件固有的变异性。这种自然主义的变异性虽然具有挑战性，但为开发鲁棒的错误检测系统提供了真实的测试平台。参赛者开发了用于旁观者反应检测（轨道 1）和预期结果预测（轨道 2）的多模态机器学习模型，并设有可选的跨数据集泛化轨道（轨道 3）。三个团队提交了有效模型，所有模型均优于我们的卷积神经网络基线。本文介绍了 ERR@HRI 3.0 的数据集、任务、基线和结果，并讨论了为人机交互构建可泛化、上下文感知和预期性错误检测系统的意义。
AI.summary: ERR@HRI 3.0 挑战赛旨在通过提供两个基于真实场景的原始多模态数据集（Bystander Affect Detection 和 Bad Idea），解决人机交互中错误检测与预防的泛化问题，并推动开发更具鲁棒性的预测系统。
AI.keywords: 人机交互, 错误检测, 行为预测, 多模态学习, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该挑战赛通过提供真实场景下未经处理的原始数据，填补了实验室环境与真实世界应用之间的鸿沟，对于推动鲁棒性人机交互系统的发展具有重要意义。

title: Knowledge-Guided Synthetic Bug Feedback for LLM-Based Unit Test Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have opened new opportunities for unit test generation, but executable tests do not necessarily reveal real defects. This paper studies how historical real-bug mechanisms can be transformed into executable feedback targets for LLM-based unit test generation. The proposed framework constructs structural and semantic representations of real-bug records, retrieves mechanisms applicable to a focal method, and instantiates them as synthetic bugs that guide iterative test enhancement. We evaluate the approach on method-level real-bug detection tasks from Defects4J and show that mechanism-guided synthetic-bug feedback improves real-bug detection over execution-, coverage-, mutation-, knowledge-, and search-based baselines. The results suggest that organizing real-bug mechanisms as retrievable and executable feedback targets is an effective way to guide generated tests toward bug-triggering inputs and behavioral oracles.

title: A Twin gradient method for unconstrained optimization
summary: We propose a new strategy for gradient-based unconstrained optimization, involving two parallel sequences of iterates that cooperate to determine their stepsizes via a \textit{Twin-Step} principle. Rather than minimizing the objective function individually, the algorithm selects steplengths that minimize the Euclidean distance between the two gradient based processes occurring simultaneously at each iteration. The theoretical analysis shows that the convergence of the mutual distance is governed by the angle between the search directions. In particular the effectiveness of the overall process degrades as the directions approach parallelism. To ensure robustness against collinearity, we introduce a hybrid framework, Twin-ABB$_{\min}$, which switches to the Adaptive Barzilai--Borwein method when the geometric cooperation becomes ineffective. Extensive and very promising numerical results evidence that the Twin phase creates favorable initial conditions for subsequent BB-type iterations.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for the High-Resolution Reconstruction of Flow Measurement Indicators in Fluid Dynamics
summary: Accurate, spatially resolved flow field measurements are essential for the reliable assessment of hemodynamic quantities in cardiovascular research and clinical practice. Experimental techniques, such as 4D flow MRI, PIV, or Doppler ultrasound, often yield data that are sparse, noisy, or under-resolved, particularly near vessel walls and in regions of complex flow. This limits the fidelity of distributed or derived hemodynamic indicators such as the wall shear stress and the clinical utility of such measurements. To address these challenges, we propose a physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework that integrates the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations with velocity measurements coming from experimental flow field data. By embedding physical laws into data, PINN enhances the reconstruction of velocity fields, enables the estimation of unmeasured quantities such as pressure and wall shear stress, and improves the spatial resolution of hemodynamic indicators. We show the effectiveness of our approach using both in silico and experimental data. First, we apply our method to the FDA nozzle benchmark, leveraging both control particle image velocimetry (PIV) measurements and computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations. Next, we apply our method to the more complex case of blood flow in an aneurysm model, exploiting in vitro 4D flow MRI data. In both cases, the synergy between data-driven learning and physics-based regularization yields results that align more closely with ground truth observations than standard CFD or pure data-driven approaches. Our findings highlight the potential of PINNs to improve the fidelity of under-resolved flow field measurements and yield spatially resolved hemodynamic indicators.

title: Structure-Feature Aligned Graph Learning via Alternating Constrained Optimization
summary: We introduce a constrained two-view framework for node prediction that aligns structure-conditioned GNN embeddings with a structure-free feature prior learned by an anchor model. Conventional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) couple feature transformation and neighborhood aggregation, which renders them vulnerable to topology noise and heterophilous connections. To decouple this dependency, our framework utilizes an independent anchor network to capture intrinsic attribute features via a self-supervised reconstruction objective. Furthermore, we propose a Channel-Split Adaptive Gated GNN (CSAG-GNN) that dynamically routes representations between global spectral smoothing and local spatial discrimination through a node-wise gating mechanism. We propose a stable cyclic alternating optimization strategy to solve the resulting coupled bi-level objective, preventing mutual representation drift during training. Empirical results on both homophilous and heterophilous benchmarks show balanced performance gains and structural robustness over competitive baselines.

title: DiffEEG: A Self-Supervised Denoising Diffusion Model for Learning EEG Generic Representations
summary: Deep learning for EEG-based seizure detection faces critical challenges: severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, where ictal events comprise less than 10\% of clinical recordings. We present DiffEEG, a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that addresses both limitations through denoising diffusion pre-training and reinforcement learning (RL)-based fine-tuning. Pre-trained on 1.3M unlabeled segments from the Temple University Hospital Seizure Corpus (TUHSZ), DiffEEG learns generic neural representations via a 1D U-Net with multi-head self-attention. For downstream adaptation, a reinforced decision layer employs policy gradient optimization to directly maximize F1-score, prioritizing sensitivity to rare seizure events over overall accuracy. Under strict patient-wise evaluation (279 patients, Leave-One-Fold-Out), DiffEEG achieves 61\% accuracy and 59\% F1 for 4-class seizure subtyping, and 81\% accuracy with 85\% weighted F1 for binary detection, maintaining clinically viable seizure recall (59\%) despite extreme imbalance (6.7\% prevalence). Segment-level evaluation establishes an upper bound of 97.6\% accuracy, confirming strong architectural capacity. DiffEEG demonstrates that diffusion-based pre-training combined with metric-aware reinforcement learning enables clinically deployable seizure monitoring with minimal labeled data requirements.

title: MemExchange: Cloud-Scale Memory Trading
summary: To handle unpredictable workloads, cloud providers typically over-provision memory to meet peak demand, resulting in substantial underutilization across datacenter clusters. At the same time, memory-constrained tenants may suffer elevated cache miss rates, even when idle capacity remains stranded elsewhere in the infrastructure. MemExchange is a cluster-wide, multi-tenant memory management system that dynamically right-sizes in-memory caching tenants according to workload demand. Leveraging marginal-utility-based allocation derived from online Miss Ratio Curve (MRC) estimation, MemExchange redistributes idle memory between tenants across physical nodes using RDMA. This approach transforms the dedicated caching memory scattered across servers into a logically aggregated pool, enabling cross-node memory exchange without centralized coordination or forced tenant co-location. To support efficient remote access, we design the MemExchange Tracker Communication (MTC) protocol, an application-layer mechanism that coordinates memory reallocation and enables one-sided RDMA operations without involving remote CPUs. We implement MemExchange in Memcached and evaluate it through microbenchmarks, medium and rack-scale deployments of up to 100 CloudLab servers. Our results show up to 2.3x lower remote-access overhead compared to TCP-based designs, a 13% increase in cluster-wide memory utilization at rack scale, and up to 63% reduction in miss rate for memory-constrained tenants under skewed workloads.

title: Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO
summary: This paper introduces Actor as Its Own Critic, a unified reinforcement learning framework, Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization (CycleGRPO), that jointly optimizes region understanding and localization for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike existing separate pipelines, we leverage the inherent duality between the two tasks to construct a self-evaluating reinforcement learning paradigm: "region $\to$ text $\to$ region''. Specifically, a single MLLM first acts as the actor to generate region captions, then immediately transitions to a critic to ground its generated text back in the spatial domain. Therefore, CycleGRPO requires only region inputs, e.g., masks or bounding boxes, entirely bypassing the need for textual ground truths. A quality-aware token-level cycle-consistency reward is employed to assess the semantic discriminability of text captions via their physical localization accuracy. Empirically, built upon SAMTok, our CycleGRPO framework successfully bootstraps both capabilities simultaneously. Without any task-specific fine-tuning, the framework yields consistent performance gains across a wide range of benchmarks, including region captioning, region VQA, grounded dialogue, and referring segmentation. Overall, CycleGRPO offers a straightforward and scalable way to advance pixel-level capabilities in MLLMs. Code and models are released at https://github.com/devinxzhang/CycleGRPO.

title: A Separation Logic for Parallel Time Complexity with Work and Span Credits
summary:
We present Parcas, a concurrent separation logic for verifying the parallel time complexity of fork-join programs. In order to abstract from the specifics of the machine, time complexity for parallel programs is given in terms of two metrics: the work, measuring the total number of operations, and the span, measuring the longest chain of sequential dependencies. Together, these two metrics determine the running time on any number of processors. For proving bounds on the work and span, Parcas is equipped with work credits and span credits, logical devices that represent permissions to incur costs.
  Work credits are a straightforward adaptation of time credits, a standard tool for bounding time complexity of sequential programs, and can be split additively between parallel tasks. Span credits, however, require a fundamentally different treatment. Indeed, the span of the parallel composition of two tasks is the maximum of the span of the two tasks. To account for this, we propose a rule for duplicating span credits at fork points, with each copy tagged by a logical task identifier that restricts which task may spend them. A transfer rule allows unused span credits to be forwarded across sequential compositions to subsequent tasks. The logic is expressive enough to give modular, higher-order specifications for common parallel primitives such as a parallel for loop and a tabulate function. We demonstrate Parcas on several case studies, including parallel prefix sums, parallel merge sort, and a variant of Treiber's lock-free stack that mixes concurrency with parallelism. All the presented results are mechanized in the Rocq prover using the Iris separation logic framework.

title: GB-SVFBP: Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant FBP neural network
comments: Accepted for poster presentation at the 18th International Meeting on Fully Three-Dimensional Image Reconstruction in Radiology and Nuclear Medicine (Fully3D 2025), Shanghai, China, May 27-30, 2025
summary: This paper proposes a Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant filtered backprojection (FBP) neural network, which is designed for the efficient reconstruction of non-circular trajectory cone beam computed tomography. The traditional differentiable shift-variant FBP model consists of a filtering component and a backprojection process. The filtering component includes operations such as weightings, differentiations, a 2D Radon transform, and a 2D backprojection. The proposed methods build on this framework by introducing a trainable 2D Gaussian model to represent the trajectory-related part in the filtering process, achieving a substantial reduction in the number of trainable parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model reduces the parameter count by 99%, while only sacrificing a slight amount of reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the training time for each trajectory is reduced to one-fourth of the original, significantly accelerating convergence. These enhancements demonstrate a considerable augmentation in the model's practicality and effectiveness, making it a valuable asset for real-world applications.
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the 18th International Meeting on Fully Three-Dimensional Image Reconstruction in Radiology and Nuclear Medicine (Fully3D 2025), Shanghai, China, May 27-30, 2025

title: HCRMap: Pressure-Aware Hot-Expert Residency Mapping for 3.5D MoE Chiplet Inference
summary:
Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language models (LLM) activate only a small number of experts during inference, but token routing introduces persistent expert hotness skew: a small set of hot experts continuously receives most tokens, while the remaining experts are lightly loaded. On 3.5D multi-chiplet systems, this skew not only causes compute imbalance but also amplifies pressure on communication, memory bandwidth, I/O, and execution queues. Therefore, the core problem is not simply to reduce token movement, but to dynamically place and reuse hot expert replicas across different memory tiers.
  This paper proposes HCRMap, a hot expert residency mapping framework for pressure-aware expert replica management in 3.5D MoE inference. Based on expert hotness, weight loading cost, migration overhead, and runtime resource pressure, HCRMap dynamically determines which experts should be promoted, retained, demoted, or evicted. It then maps routed token groups to suitable resident replicas, thereby jointly mitigating communication, memory, and queue bottlenecks.
  Experimental results show that HCRMap reduces end-to-end latency by 43.6% and 43.0% over Hydra in the prefill and decode stages, respectively; by 34.5% and 33.1% over MoEntwine; and by 46.7% and 46.0% over PIMoE.

title: FoundationGeo: Learning Spatial Pixel-Wise Fields for Monocular Metric Geometry
comments: 28 pages, 8 figures. Accepted to ECCV 2026. Muxin Liu and Xiaoyang Lyu contributed equally. Shaoshuai Shi and Xiaojuan Qi are corresponding authors. Project page: https://mx-liu6.github.io/FoundationGeo-web/
summary: We present FoundationGeo, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges relative and metric prediction via spatial calibration and principled data design. Stage 1 learns a high-fidelity, affine-invariant geometry model by initializing with DINOv3 and training on a curated 10.2M-sample multi-domain corpus with complementary local-detail supervision, yielding sharp boundaries and strong cross-domain generalization. Stage 2 moves beyond global scaling by introducing lightweight pixel-wise calibration fields for metric estimation: a scale field for spatially varying metric alignment and a ray-direction correction field that mitigates directional bias in point-map geometry, together producing metrically consistent 3D point maps. Beyond model design, we identify camera intrinsic coverage, especially focal length distribution mismatch between training and test data, as a key bottleneck for zero-shot metric generalization: performance drops sharply when test intrinsics fall outside the training distribution. To address this, we synthesize additional training data across diverse focal lengths using a Blender-based data engine, repairing under-covered focal regimes and improving robustness under intrinsic shift. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven benchmarks show that FoundationGeo significantly strengthens cross-domain robustness, staying near the top across diverse domains while avoiding the sharp cross-domain performance drops observed in other methods. This consistency translates into the best overall performance, surpassing heavier baselines by over 5.2% on average.
